other.summary: MatterGen is a generative model for inorganic materials design. MatterGen is a generative model for inorganic materials design. It is a diffusion model which jointly predicts a material’s atomic fractional coordinates, elements, as well as unit cell lattice vectors. Besides unconditional generation of material candidates, MatterGen can also be trained or fine-tuned for conditional generation based on target property values, e.g., bulk modulus, chemical system, or magnetic density. - **Developed by:** Materials Design Team, Microsoft Research AI for Science - **Model type:** Diffusion model - **License:** MIT - **Repository:** https://github.com/microsoft/mattergen - **Paper:** https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-025-08628-5 1. Generate inorganic materials candidates without property...
other.summary_zh: MatterGen 是 Microsoft Research AI for Science 材料設計團隊開發的無機材料生成模型,成果發表於 Nature。新材料開發傳統上依賴高成本的實驗試錯,或僅能從既有資料庫篩選已知結構;MatterGen 改採生成式取徑,直接產出全新的候選晶體結構。其核心是一個擴散模型(diffusion model),可同時預測材料的原子分數座標、元素種類與單位晶格向量,亦即完整生成一個週期性晶體結構。除了無條件生成材料候選,MatterGen 亦可透過訓練或 fine-tuning 達成條件式生成,依目標性質引導輸出,例如指定體積模數(bulk modulus)、化學系統或磁密度等,提升材料搜尋的可控性。就證據面而言,本頁面僅提供摘要層級資訊,論文中詳細的實驗結果、與既有方法的基準比較及事後驗證細節在此無法完整查核,讀者應參閱原文;生成結構的合成可行性與實際性質表現,仍須仰賴後續計算與實驗驗證把關。模型以 MIT 授權釋出,程式碼可於 GitHub 存取,有利於重現與延伸研究。整體而言,MatterGen 展示了擴散生成模型在材料科學的應用潛力,將無機材料探索由「篩選既有資料」推向「依性質主動生成」的新典範,對能源、磁性材料等領域的開發具有指標性意義。

other.summary: **SQuadGen** is a diffusion-based generative framework for synthesizing simple quad layouts on 3D shapes. It introduces **Chart Distance Fields (CDF)**, a continuous surface-based representation that makes quad-layout generation amenable to neural learning while preserving structure useful for downstream modeling and editing. This repository hosts the pretrained checkpoints and matching configuration files used by the official inference scripts. It is intended as the model release page; installation, data preparation, training, evaluation, and full inference instructions are maintained in the GitHub repository. - **Developed by:** Youkang Kong, Yang Liu, Yue Dong, Xin Tong, Heung-Yeung Shum - **Affiliation:** Tsinghua University, Microsoft Research Asia - **Model Type:** Latent diffusion...
other.summary_zh: SQuadGen針對三維形狀上的四邊形網格(quad)布局自動化問題:傳統上,quad layout的規劃高度依賴人工操作,現有自動化方法則難以兼顧布局簡潔性與下游建模、編輯所需的結構品質。為此,作者提出一套以擴散模型(diffusion)為基礎的生成式框架,並引入Chart Distance Fields(CDF)作為核心表示:CDF是一種連續的曲面表示方式,使四邊形布局的合成得以轉化為可透過神經網路學習的問題,同時保留對下游建模與編輯有用的結構資訊。依據模型卡,此模型屬於latent diffusion類型,由清華大學與微軟亞洲研究院(Microsoft Research Asia)團隊開發。此頁面定位為模型發布頁,提供預訓練權重(checkpoints)與對應設定檔,搭配官方推論腳本使用;摘要層級的內容並未呈現量化評估、基準比較或消融實驗等具體證據,安裝、資料準備、訓練、評估與完整推論流程均維護於GitHub儲存庫,讀者應以該處文件為準。整體而言,本研究展示了將離散、結構化的四邊形布局問題轉換為連續表示後交由生成模型學習的可行性,對3D內容創作、遊戲與動畫資產製作等下游應用具有潛在價值,但實際效能與限制仍需參閱原論文與程式碼方能確認。

other.summary: Hugging Face | Launch Blog | Documentation | Technical Report License: Apache 2.0 | Authors: Google DeepMind > This model card is for the Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) drafters for the Gemma 4 models. MTP is implemented by extending the base model with a smaller, faster draft model. When used in a Speculative Decoding pipeline, the draft model predicts several tokens ahead, which the target model then verifies in parallel. This results in significant decoding speedups (up to 3x) while guaranteeing the exact same quality as standard generation, making these checkpoints perfect for low-latency and on-device applications. Gemma is a family of open models built by Google DeepMind. Gemma 4 models are multimodal, handling text and image input (with audio supported on E2B, E4B, and 12B) and...
other.summary_zh: 這份 Hugging Face 模型卡介紹 Google DeepMind 為 Gemma 4 系列開放模型所釋出的 Multi-Token Prediction（MTP）草稿模型（drafter）檢查點，gemma-4-12B-it-assistant 即為其中之一。其欲解決的問題是：大型語言模型推論時須逐一生成 token，解碼速度常成為低延遲應用的瓶頸。方法上，團隊在基礎模型之外延伸出更小、更快的草稿模型；在 Speculative Decoding（推測解碼）流程中，草稿模型先預測數個後續 token，目標模型再並行驗證並接受正確者，一次即可推進多個 token。主要證據為官方宣稱最高可達 3 倍解碼加速，且因輸出仍經目標模型驗證，可保證與標準生成完全相同的品質，屬於無損加速。Gemma 為 Google DeepMind 打造的開放模型家族，Gemma 4 具多模態能力，支援文字與影像輸入，E2B、E4B 與 12B 版本另支援音訊，模型以 Apache 2.0 授權釋出。限制方面：本頁僅為摘要層級內容，詳細的基準測試、速度量測條件與硬體配置須參考其技術報告，實際加速幅度亦會依應用場景與部署環境而異，且草稿模型須與對應目標模型搭配使用方能發揮效益。整體而言，這類 MTP 草稿模型對低延遲與裝置端（on-device）應用極具價值，讓開發者在完全不犧牲輸出品質的前提下顯著提升生成反應速度。

other.summary_zh: TIPS（Text-Image Pre-training with Spatial awareness）是 Google 於 ICLR 2025 發表的對比式視覺—語言模型家族，針對 CLIP 類模型影像特徵偏重全域語意、空間資訊不足的問題，在文字—影像對比預訓練中導入空間感知，使影像特徵既保有豐富的空間結構，又能與文字嵌入對齊，讓語意與空間資訊在同一組特徵中並存。本次釋出的是 v1 系列的 g/14 版本，由官方 checkpoints 轉換而來：視覺端約 1.1B 參數、文字端約 389M 參數，嵌入維度 1536、輸入解析度 448；同一家族另有 S/14、B/14、L/14、So400m/14 與低解析度 g/14 等規模，可依運算資源選用，並可透過 transformers、torch 等套件載入。限制方面，本頁僅提供摘要與模型卡層級資訊，未附完整基準測試數字與訓練細節，實際效能應以原論文為準；g/14 屬大型模型，推論與部署成本較高，低解析度版本雖省資源但可能損失細節。整體而言，TIPS 提供語意對齊且空間豐富的影像特徵，對影像檢索與需要空間定位的應用深具潛力，是視覺—語言研究值得關注的基礎模型選項。

other.summary_zh: TIPS（Text-Image Pre-training with Spatial awareness）是 ICLR 2025 發表的對比式視覺—語言模型系列，研究動機來自一個已知問題：如 CLIP 一類的對比式預訓練所產生的影像特徵雖與文字嵌入對齊，卻缺乏空間資訊，難以支援需要定位或結構感知的下游應用。TIPS 透過加入空間感知的預訓練方式，讓影像特徵同時具備空間豐富性，並維持與文字嵌入的對齊，使單一表示能服務更廣泛的視覺—語言任務。本次釋出為原始 v1 的 g/14 低解析度版本：視覺端 1.1B 參數、文字端 389M 參數、嵌入維度 1536、輸入解析度 224，較標準 g/14 的 448 更低，可降低運算與記憶體成本；同系列亦含 S/14、B/14、L/14、So400m/14 等規模。模型由官方 checkpoint 轉換，可搭配 transformers、torch、torchvision、sentencepiece、scikit-learn 與 requests 等套件載入使用。限制方面，本頁僅為模型卡摘要，未附基準測試數字，實際效能與訓練細節應以原始論文為準；低解析度輸入雖節省運算成本，但在細小物件或精細結構的辨識上可能有所取捨。其價值在於提供空間感知的大型多模態骨幹，讓研究者能以對比式模型特徵處理更廣泛的下游任務，並以不同規模與解析度版本彈性權衡效能與成本。

other.summary_zh: 本篇導讀對象為 google/tipsv1-s14，即 ICLR 2025 論文 TIPS（Text-Image Pre-training with Spatial awareness）系列中的 S/14 版本。TIPS 屬於對比式視覺—語言預訓練模型，針對一般 CLIP 式特徵雖擅長整體語意比對、卻較缺乏空間結構資訊的問題而設計：其訓練目標使影像特徵在與文字嵌入對齊之餘，仍保有豐富的空間感知能力，讓同一組特徵可望同時支援影像分類、檢索，以及需要定位能力的密集預測應用。就規格而言，S/14 為系列中最輕量的變體，視覺端約 22M 參數、文字端約 34M 參數、嵌入維度 384、輸入解析度 448，並由官方 checkpoints 轉換而來，可透過 transformers、torch、sentencepiece 等套件載入使用。同一模型家族另提供 B/14、L/14、So400m/14 與 g/14（視覺端最高約 1.1B 參數），以及解析度 224 的 g/14 low-res 變體，便於研究模型規模與輸入解析度對空間感知能力的影響。需留意的是，目前僅能取得摘要與模型卡內容，論文的完整實驗結果、與相關基準模型的具體比較，以及空間感知能力的量化證據均無法在此核實，讀者應以原文為準；此外，S/14 屬最小規模版本，效能上限可能不及較大變體。整體而言，TIPS 為需在單一骨幹上兼顧語意理解與空間定位的應用提供輕量起點，具研究與實務價值。

other.summary_zh: 本模型卡介紹 google/tipsv2-so400m14-dpt，這是在凍結的 TIPSv2 SO400m/14 骨幹之上加裝 DPT（Dense Prediction Transformer）密集預測頭的模型，支援三種密集預測任務：深度估計、表面法線預測與語意分割。其核心方法是將 TIPSv2 骨幹凍結、僅訓練任務專用的 DPT 頭，藉此保留骨幹於大規模預訓練中習得的通用視覺表徵，並以較低成本適配多個下游任務；載入模型時骨幹會自動一併載入。依官方說明，深度與法線預測頭在 NYU Depth V2 資料集上訓練，語意分割頭則在 ADE20K 資料集（150 類）上訓練。模型卡另列出 B/14、L/14、SO400m/14 與 g/14 等變體，視覺參數量約 86M 至 1.1B、嵌入維度介於 768 至 1536，可透過 transformers 函式庫搭配 torch、torchvision 與 sentencepiece 使用。需要強調的是，此摘要並未提供 RMSE、mIoU 等定量結果或與其他方法的比較，實際效能仍須查閱完整文件或自行實測驗證。限制方面，目前僅有摘要層級資訊，訓練細節、授權與偏誤說明尚未呈現；凍結骨幹雖具效率優勢，在領域差異較大的資料上可能不如完整 fine-tuning。整體而言，本模型的價值在於以單一強大骨幹快速支援深度、法線與分割等多種視覺任務，對需要通用密集預測能力的應用深具參考價值。

other.summary_zh: TIPSv2（Text-Image Pre-training with Spatial awareness）是一系列以對比式學習訓練的視覺—語言模型，針對一般對比式預訓練產生的影像特徵缺乏空間結構、難以直接支援密集預測任務的問題，提出強調空間感知的預訓練方式。TIPSv2 的影像特徵除了保有與文字嵌入（text embedding）的對齊能力，也蘊含更豐富的空間資訊，因此可直接應用於零樣本分割（zero-shot segmentation）等下游任務。本頁收錄 SO400m/14 變體：視覺端約 412M 參數、文字端約 448M 參數、嵌入維度 1152，並搭配 SO400m/14-dpt 的 DPT 頭部以輸出空間特徵；整個系列另含 B/14、L/14 與 g/14 等規模，嵌入維度介於 768 至 1536，可依運算資源與應用需求選用。官方在模型卡中提供 transformers、torch、torchvision 等套件的程式碼範例，並有 GitHub 專案收錄更多用法與視覺化展示，降低研究者上手門檻。需要留意的是，此頁面僅為摘要層級資訊，並未呈現完整的基準測試數字、訓練資料組成或消融實驗結果，其相較於 CLIP、SigLIP 等既有模型的具體優劣，仍須查閱原始論文才能確認。整體而言，TIPSv2 展示了將空間感知融入對比式預訓練的可行性，對需要同時處理影像分類、分割與定位的應用場景具有實用參考價值。

other.summary_zh: TIPSv2（Text-Image Pre-training with Spatial awareness）是 Google 推出的對比式視覺—語言模型家族，針對傳統 CLIP 類模型影像特徵缺乏空間資訊、難以支援稠密預測任務的痛點而設計。其核心做法是在文字—影像對比預訓練中導入空間感知，使產出的影像特徵既與文字嵌入對齊，又保留豐富的空間結構，因而可直接用於零樣本分割（zero-shot segmentation）等下游應用。本模型為 Base（B/14）變體，視覺端約 86M 參數、文字端約 110M 參數、嵌入維度 768，並搭配 B/14-dpt 的 DPT head 輸出稠密特徵；同系列另提供 L/14、SO400m/14 與 g/14 等規模，嵌入維度介於 1024 至 1536，可透過 transformers 程式庫載入，官方 GitHub 亦提供視覺化與使用範例。須留意的是，目前僅有模型卡與摘要層級的資訊，尚未公開完整論文的定量實驗，例如在各分割或檢索基準上的具體表現，效能證據仍待後續資料補充，讀者宜以官方釋出內容為準。整體而言，TIPSv2 的價值在於縮短影像層級對比預訓練與稠密預測之間的落差，讓單一模型同時支援分類、檢索與分割，對需要空間理解的多模態系統深具參考意義。

evidence: Abstract: 'With unrestricted action execution, the attacks achieve all 13 objectives on all six harnesses. Under automatic permission review, the attacks achieve all 13 objectives on all three harnesses that provide this mode.'
§5.3 Escalation Definition: formalizes IPE(c)=1 for tool-to-user and tool-to-system escalation via context-construction operations R_delegate and R_install.
§8.2 Table 5: tool-level baselines MCPTox/CoT Forgery/ChatInject reach at most 7/13 (Gemini CLI) and 0/13 on Claude Code and Codex, including under Auto PR.
§8.3 Table 7: success after escalation is 86.7%-100.0% across harnesses and permission regimes; overall attack success rates 31.7%-100%.
§8.4 Table 10: hidden-script variant achieves 65.0%-100% (full access) and 61.9%-76.5% (Auto PR); §8.4 text states 70.0% for Codex Auto PR vs 72.2% in Table 10, a minor inconsistency.
§8.5 Table 12: persistent-goal and scheduled-task paths achieve 13/13 objectives, supporting generality beyond delegation.
No code, dataset, or artifact availability statement appears anywhere in the document; reproducibility rests only on harness versions (Table 4) and included prompt snippets (§7.1).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent security paper: attacks on six coding-agent harnesses (Codex, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, Kimi, OpenCode) directly match high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use 2.5, AI Safety 2.0, Red Teaming & Evaluation 1.8). Novelty is real: 'instruction privilege escalation' differs from prompt injection/role confusion because the harness itself relabels tool-level content as user/system-effective during context reconstruction, formalized in §5.3 with IPE(c)=1 and a clear threat model in §6. Rigor is good but not maximal: 13 objectives, two permission regimes, three baseline attacks (§8.2 Table 5 shows near-zero baseline success, isolating the escalation effect), plus generality tests via goals/scheduled tasks (§8.5); however attempts are capped at 10, sample sizes per cell are modest (13-21, Table 10), the workload is a single TODO-app scenario, there is a minor text/table inconsistency (Codex Auto PR 70.0% in §8.4 text vs 72.2% in Table 10), and no defense or mitigation analysis is offered. Evidence strength is strong internally (abstract's 97.3%/80.3% means reconcile with Tables 7 and 10), but no code, artifact release, or independent verification is stated. Generalizability is demonstrated across mechanisms and harnesses yet confined to coding-agent/repo settings. Reproducibility is limited by proprietary harnesses/models and absence of an artifact-availability claim.

papers.summary: Instruction hierarchy is a model-side defense that assigns instructions different levels of privilege according to their sources. These levels constrain which content may direct model behavior. During agent execution, however, agent harnesses construct context for each model invocation. This construction can elevate low-level content to a higher instruction level and grant it greater model-facing privilege. We introduce instruction privilege escalation. In this attack, an attacker induces an age
papers.summary_zh: 本論文探討 LLM 代理框架的指令安全問題：框架每次呼叫模型時會重建上下文，此過程可能將原本屬於 tool 層級的外部內容，重新標記為 user 或 system-effective 等較高指令層級。作者據此提出新攻擊典範「指令特權提升」（instruction privilege escalation），並以統一指令階層 tool < user < system-effective 進行形式化。與提示注入或角色混淆攻擊不同，此攻擊不靠偽造角色標記欺騙模型，而是利用多代理委派、自訂子代理安裝、持續性目標與排程任務等框架機制，由框架本身把攻擊者控制的內容提升至更高層級，使工作代理與自動權限審查（Auto PR）都將其視為可信的使用者或系統指令。評估涵蓋 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Qwen Code、Kimi 與 OpenCode 六種編碼代理框架，以及橫跨機密性、完整性、可用性與遠端程式碼執行的 13 項攻擊目標：在完全存取模式下六個框架全部達成；支援 Auto PR 的三個框架上亦全數繞過審查成功，其中 tool-to-user 提升後平均成功率為 97.3%，tool-to-system 為 80.3%；相形之下，MCPTox、CoT Forgery、ChatInject 等工具層基線攻擊幾乎全數失敗，凸顯層級提升才是關鍵。研究限制包括僅針對編碼代理情境、惡意程式以明文提供而未混淆以隔離變因、部分提升路徑須在完全存取模式下驗證，且 Claude Code 需採間接誘導策略。此研究證明指令階層與權限審查共同依賴的「角色標記忠實反映內容出處」假設並不成立，對代理系統的防禦設計提出重要警示。

evidence: Sec. 3.4 'Experimental scale': 58 configurations per family over 500 SWE-bench Verified instances yielding 58,000 agent runs, 2M LLM API calls, and 36B tokens processed.

Tab. 1 (Sec. 4): Raw escalation recovers QRec=47% (Claude) and 36% (GPT) of the LC-HC quality gap; Traj-drop raises QRec to 64% and 84%; Raw downshift retains 80%/14% cost savings at 50%/79% quality recovery.

Appendix A.3 Tab. 8: task-clustered bootstrap 95% CIs (10,000 resamples) show the central reversal excludes zero in both families — escalation Traj-drop−Raw +3.1 [+1.3,+5.0] Claude, +12.2 [+9.2,+15.4] GPT; downshift −4.7 [−7.3,−2.1] and −5.6 [−8.6,−2.6].

Appendix A.1 'Accounting' and 'Pricing and audit': cost reconstruction from provider usage with cache-aware price cards, exact reconciliation audits, and verbatim handoff prompts; switch steps given in Tab. 11.

Limitations section: single episode per task per configuration, interface findings established primarily in the coding setting, hard-stratum cells N̄≈24–27 treated as exploratory, and dollar-cost conclusions dependent on provider pricing and cache rates.
Sec. 5 Tabs. 2–3: extensions show information dynamics modulate the tax — LiC escalation QRec=86%, BrowseComp GPT escalation QRec=95.8% but CSRet=−30.0%, worse than abort+restart (−8.5%).
llm_evaluation.rationale: A large-scale empirical study of mid-trajectory model handoffs in LLM coding agents, directly matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, agents & tool use, code). Novel contribution: systematic characterization of the 'handoff tax' across direction (escalation/downshift), timing, and interface (raw/compact/traj-drop), with a cross-family directional duality finding. Rigor is strong: matched switched subsets, difficulty-calibrated switch percentiles, restart controls, a disclosure ablation, and task-clustered bootstrap CIs for the central reversal. Evidence is quantitatively supported at scale (58,000 runs, 36B tokens), though single-episode-per-task runs, descriptive (non-inferential) cost mechanics, and a small hard-task stratum (N̄≈24–27, self-flagged as exploratory) temper confidence. Generalizability is limited by two model families, one primary benchmark for interface findings (LiC/BrowseComp use Raw only), fixed switch points, and pricing-dependent cost conclusions. Reproducibility benefits from verbatim prompts, calibration tables (Tab. 11), and audit accounting, but rests on commercial models, a pinned local price card, and only a vague artifact-availability claim rather than an explicit public release.

primary_link.title: The Handoff Tax: Continuing Non-Native Trajectories in LLM Agents

papers.summary: Coding agents perform long-running tasks spanning dozens of model calls, tool uses, and code edits. As these runs unfold, users face a practical cost-quality trade-off: escalating to a stronger model when a cheaper one struggles, or downshifting once the hard reasoning is complete. Each switch requires the receiver to continue a non-native trajectory produced by another model. We study how this handoff affects quality and cost, and how varying the trajectory information inherited by the receiver changes the outcome. Using pairs of low-cost, low-capability (LC) and high-cost, high-capability (HC) models from the Claude and GPT families, we vary handoff direction, timing, and interface, comparing full-trajectory transfer, compaction, and trajectory removal while preserving the repository state. Across both model families, full-trajectory escalation recovers less than half of the LC-to-HC quality gap while incurring a substantial cost premium. We term this cost-quality penalty the handoff tax. By contrast, downshift offers a favorable cost-quality point. Interestingly, the preferred interface also reverses with direction: reducing LC-model trajectory information improves escalation quality, whereas removing the HC-model trajectory reduces downshift quality.
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討長時程編程代理（coding agent）任務中，中途更換模型所付出的「handoff tax」（交接稅）。使用者在便宜模型（LC）卡關時升級到強大模型（HC），或完成艱難推理後降級省錢，但接手模型必須延續另一個模型產生的非原生軌跡。作者在 SWE-bench Verified 上，以 Claude（Haiku 4.5/Opus 4.7）與 GPT-5.6（Luna/Sol）兩組配對，變換切換方向、時機與介面：Raw（完整軌跡）、Compact（摘要壓縮）與 Traj-drop（移除軌跡但保留程式碼編輯），合計每族 58 種設定、58,000 次代理執行與 360 億個 token。核心結果：Raw 升級僅收回不到一半的品質差距且成本高昂，Claude 案例中甚至比重跑 HC 更貴更差；降級則提供有利的成本與品質中間點。軌跡資訊的價值具有方向性：減少 LC 軌跡可提升升級品質（Traj-drop 品質最佳、Compact_pre 最省），移除 HC 軌跡則損害降級品質。機制上，Raw 升級使 HC 每步更貴；Traj-drop 降級使 LC 多走 1.6 至 2 倍步驟以重建遺失脈絡。LiC 與 BrowseComp 延伸實驗顯示資訊動態會翻轉結論，遲到的需求有利於升級。限制：僅兩組模型、單一基準、固定切換點、每任務單次執行，且困難子集樣本小。本研究指出模型交接應視為獨立的推論問題，交接介面需與模型選擇及切換時機共同最佳化，對代理系統的路由與成本管理極具實務意義。
papers.title: The Handoff Tax: Continuing Non-Native Trajectories in LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: 交接稅：LLM 代理延續非原生軌跡的代價

links.title: Large language models simulate intersectional synthetic identities with a budget of one to two dimensions

evidence: Results, 'Two features: collapse, not combination': best single feature beats additive combination in 78.4% of pair cells for GPT-4o-mini (95% CI [77.8, 79.0], wave-cluster bootstrap), 75.3-81.2% across eight models including frontier GPT-5.5 (79.1%) and Claude Sonnet 5 (77.8%) on a two-wave subset (Table 1).

Methods, 'Noise floor and noise corrections': empirical split-half TV floors of 0.079/0.120/0.147 at depths 1/2/3, closed-form multinomial expectation certified within 0-4% down to n=20, and exact squared-distance decomposition for the 2.5x distinctiveness growth claim.

Methods, 'Human additivity contest and contest calibration': calibration endpoints measured rather than assumed (additive-truth 40.3%, collapse-truth 84.3%; depth-3 endpoints 67.2%/6.6%), with self-calibrated indices 0.83-0.95 and a noise-scaling sweep (0.5x unchanged at 0.86; 2x softens to 0.74).

Methods, 'Base-versus-tuned contrast': race deficit -10.8 points and religion -5.3 points present in Llama-3.1-8B base weights, with tuning shifts of +0.6 and -0.6 against minimum detectable effects of 5.9 and 2.7 points; Mistral-7B replicates.

Methods, 'Data/Code availability': all 21.1M simulated records and artifacts on Zenodo (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21267988) with regeneration script run_all_figures.sh on GitHub; snapshots pinned for flagship models, with GPT-4o and Claude Sonnet 5 queried via unversioned aliases flagged as reproducibility caveats that carry no load-bearing result.

Discussion: claims explicitly scoped to 'demographic-feature conditioning and the US English-language ATP context (2017-2021)' with portability elsewhere untested, tempering generalizability despite the eight-model, two-generation replication.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A methodological audit of LLM synthetic survey respondents demonstrating that demographic personas collapse to a one-to-two feature 'identity budget'. Directly in scope: the objects of study are eight LLMs, and the work engages persona prompting, chain-of-thought controls, bias/fairness, and evaluation methodology rather than being a pure domain application. Novelty is high: the compositional question at distribution level against real intersectional ground truth, the near-additivity-plus-growing-distinctiveness characterization, and the measured calibration-endpoint machinery appear genuinely new relative to the cited audits. Rigor is exceptional: human sampling-noise floors, null calibration (random-dimension cosine 0.84), per-model self-calibrated collapse indices, cluster/wild bootstrap, permutation nulls, minimum detectable effects for null contrasts, feature-order and framing controls, three elicitation paradigms, base-vs-tuned decomposition, and a memorization-confound analysis. Evidence is strong with CIs and cross-model replication (75.3-81.2% best-single win rates, Index_self 0.83-0.95), bounded by reliance on measured-noise endpoint modeling (sensitivity-swept) and two-wave coverage for frontier models. Generalizability is explicitly scoped to US English ATP closed-form items 2017-2021. Reproducibility is high: 21.1M records on Zenodo, code with seeds and run_all_figures.sh, pinned snapshots for load-bearing models with two unpinned aliases honestly flagged as non-load-bearing.

primary_link.title: Large language models simulate intersectional synthetic identities with a budget of one to two dimensions

papers.summary: Large language models are increasingly used as synthetic survey respondents, promising cheap access to rare intersectional populations. We test standard demographic-persona methods against every real intersectional subgroup across 15 waves of Pew's American Trends Panel -- 21 million simulated response distributions from eight models. In real respondents, subgroup opinion is approximately the additive sum of its single-identity components, yet grows 2.5x more distinctive as identities intersect.
papers.summary_zh: 本研究檢視大型語言模型（LLM）作為合成問卷受訪者時，能否真正整合多重人口身分。作者以Pew美國趨勢小組（ATP）15波調查的微資料建立真實交叉次群體基準，讓八個模型（GPT-4o-mini、GPT-5.5、Claude Sonnet 5與開放權重模型等）以一到三個特徵的身分設定模擬回答分布，共約2,100萬筆，並以「組成競賽」檢驗：用餘弦相似度判定模型的誤差向量較貼近兩單一特徵偏誤之和（加法）或單一特徵偏誤（塌縮），搭配以模型自身重複執行雜訊建立的校準端點、人類抽樣雜訊下限與分割樣本複製。結果顯示，真實次群體的方向近似加法，且隨身分交織更趨鮮明（平方距離增至2.5倍）；模型卻在75–82%的雙特徵細格中由最佳單一特徵勝出，塌縮指標達0.83–0.95，第三特徵幾乎無貢獻；保留哪個維度近乎盲目，並系統性捨棄真實意見最強驅動因素種族與宗教，族裔與宗教少數身分最易被丟棄；個別取樣、log-probability讀出與各種提示策略皆無法緩解。限制在於僅涵蓋美國英語封閉式題項（2017–2021）、未預先註冊、僅為行為層次描述而未探究表徵機制，且基礎與微調對比僅限開放權重模型。對欲以矽取樣（silicon sampling）廉價補足稀少交叉人口的應用而言，這是明確警示：準確度缺口主要來自單一特徵校準失準，塌縮則是結構性缺陷；作者建議以雜訊下限、零假校準及多層次回歸事後分層（MRP）為基準，並以實測群體差異進行校準。

links.title: EVOMAL: Self-Poisoning in Self-Evolving Coding Agents

evidence: Abstract/§6.3: 'Across six models on 153 tool-relevant SWE-bench Verified tasks, ASPR ranges from 20.3% to 41.8%' with libraries containing '4.9 to 9.0 times as many malicious skills as were initially planted'.
Table 2: banner ablation on DS-V4 shows full three-layer banner at 41.8% ASPR vs 11.1% no-banner control; layer removals cost 13.0/19.6/30.7 pp.

§6.5/Figure 4b: under the removed condition Qwen3 reaches 68% ASPR at round 5, demonstrating persistence after seed withdrawal; replacement-rate sweep shows critical transition (r=0.25 decay, r=0.75 reaches 60.1% and rising).

Table 5: existing detectors evaluated — Bandit catch falls from 85% to 7% after one-line egress swap, injection classifier has 47% benign FP, name blocklist catches 0 of 275 authored infections; Theorem 1 formalizes submission-side defense limits.

§9.2/Figure 8: counter-prompt reduces headline ASPR to ≤1.8% (worst residual 6.7% on Devstral's 15-task pytest family) with zero callbacks and no statistically significant task-completion drop; Table 7 shows robustness to token renaming and adaptive banners (≤1.3%).

Appendix D.5/Table 11: honest model-fit failure — reproduction-number proxy overshoots observed growth ~10x and misorders DS-V4 and Devstral; post-hoc analysis attributes collapse to in-cascade descendant retrieval (0/765 opportunities for DS-V4 and MiniMax).

Table 12 (Appendix E.1): locked headline configuration (8 planted skills, 232-skill benign pool, top-k=5 BGE-M3/ChromaDB, N=153, 15-step limit) enabling exact reproduction; Appendix E.5 reports pooled two-proportion z-tests with RQ1 lift p<0.001 for all six models.

Open Science section: commits six artifact sets (planted-skill generators, agent integration, sandbox wrapper, defenses, evaluation framework, per-task JSONs) with Zenodo DOI; Ethical Considerations describes env-i sandbox with fake FAKE_* credentials and 127.0.0.1-bound C2.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Near-perfect topical fit for this preference profile: LLM coding agents, agent/tool security, red-teaming and defense evaluation, with retrieval-based skill selection and a prompt-based defense. The core contribution — identifying the unguarded authoring-and-storing ('create-path') by which self-evolving agents re-author planted payloads into their own skill libraries, plus a self-propagating worm demonstration and a counter-prompt/signed-quarantine defense set — is a genuine increment over prior reuse-path poisoning work, though adjacent to concurrent work (SkillJack, OEP) and the banner mechanism is simple. Rigor is high: formal threat model and objective, locked configuration with one-factor ablations, Wilson CIs and two-proportion z-tests (E.5), banner-layer and payload ablations, adaptive-attack robustness tests, and unusually honest reporting of model-fit failures (the branching proxy overshoots ~10x and misorders DS-V4/Devstral, D.5) and small-N family cells. Evidence is instrumented (sandboxed C2 callback logging, per-task logs) and internally consistent across decomposition tables, but all results are synthetic sandbox experiments rather than real deployments, and ASPR is measured by matching the authors' own banner signature. Generalizability is strong within scope (6 models, 2 benchmarks, 3 scaffolds, 3 tool languages, 5 payload classes), though confined to Voyager-style executable-skill loops. Reproducibility support is detailed (locked config, full setup appendix, committed artifact release with per-task JSONs), pending actual availability. Score reflects elite preference alignment with strong but not flawless empirical and external-validity grounding.

primary_link.title: EVOMAL: Self-Poisoning in Self-Evolving Coding Agents

papers.summary: Self-evolving LLM coding agents write their own tools by imitating retrieved skills from shared skill libraries. We identify a vulnerability in this loop: during authoring, a retrieved malicious skill can become the template for a new skill that preserves the payload. We call this self-poisoning: the agent authors, stores, and runs the resulting malicious skill. papers.summary_zh: 此論文揭露自我演化 LLM 編碼代理的新型安全弱點:這類代理會把自寫工具存為「技能」,並從共享技能庫擷取相似技能當範本模仿改寫。攻擊者只需在庫中植入外觀正常的惡意技能,無須被代理呼叫;即使不含誘導橫幅,DeepSeek-V4-Pro 仍有 11.1% 的自我污染率,顯示弱點源自模仿式創作本身。EvoMal 以三層「橫幅」結構(逐字複製註解、裝飾器、匯入時註冊)包覆可替換的惡意酬載,誘使代理在改寫新技能時複製酬載並存回庫中,即「自我污染」;新副本再被後續任務擷取與再創作,形成自我傳播的蠕蟲。在 153 個 SWE-bench Verified 工具相關任務上,六種模型的代理自我污染率(ASPR)為 20.3% 至 41.8%,庫中惡意技能增至初始植入的 4.9 至 9.0 倍;僅改寫技能描述鎖定任務族群可將 ASPR 推升至 86.7%。移除植入技能後,Qwen3 第五輪仍達 68%,感染可自我維持。名稱封鎖、程式碼掃描與注入分類器皆難偵測代理自創的惡意技能;作者提出 counter-prompt 防禦,將 ASPR 壓至主要情境 ≤1.8%(個別情況 6.7%)且任務完成率無統計顯著下降,另建議簽章隔離閘門阻斷再擷取,並以分支過程 ρ=c·q·φ 說明傳播需兼具複製意願與技能可及性。限制:counter-prompt 屬軟性、依模型而異的緩解,分支模型預測與實測級聯仍有落差。此研究將安全邊界由攻擊者提交物轉向代理自創技能,對自演化代理的技能庫治理與供應鏈安全極具警示價值。

links.title: Would this change your answer? Evaluating Explanations of LLM Behavior In The Wild with Counterfactual Experiments

evidence: Abstract/Contributions (Section 1): 'We show that three activation-reading interpretability tools, all of which provide uplift in prior auditing games on fine-tuned models, provide no uplift on our evaluation.'
Appendix C.3, Table 5: transcript-only baselines 0.819 (GPT-5.5), 0.793 (Gemini-3.1-Pro), 0.814 (Opus 4.8); 'No tool beats its own baseline for any agent; Gemini is actively hurt by the NLA and SAE.'
Section 4.4/Figure 6: 'Both trained models improve substantially over the base model (Figure 6) and land within ±0.03 AUROC of the Opus reference on every set.'

Section 2.2: claim labeling thresholds 'true if its edit moved the behavior rate by at least 50 percentage points and false if it moved the rate by at most 15', 30pp prediction threshold in claim template (Appendix B.4).
Appendix F: unfiltered deltas over Opus reference '+0.015 [+0.002, +0.027]' (Qwen3-8B) and '+0.033 [+0.021, +0.044]' (Qwen3.5-397B), showing filters do not create the result.
Appendix D.4: 'In neither direction does the self predictor beat the cross predictor (Figure 8)' — no evidence of privileged access with size-matched 23,944-example training sets.
Section 5/Appendix A.1: explicit limitation that the evaluation is a proxy since 'anyone with sampling access to the target model could answer our evaluation by running the counterfactual directly.'
Appendix B.5, Table 3: per-investigation cost $1.9 (evaluation) and $0.9 (training), total run costs $3.3k and $26k, supporting cost/scale claims.
Release claim (Section 1): 'We release all code, models, and datasets, including investigation runs on five target models... https://github.com/adamkarvonen/chive' — supports reproducibility.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper squarely on-topic: agentic pipelines, interpretability tool evaluation (SAEs, activation oracles, NLAs), counterfactual simulatability, CoT faithfulness, and AI-safety auditing. Novel contribution is CHIVE, which moves counterfactual explanation evaluation from planted-hint settings to naturally-occurring behaviors at scale. Rigor is high: two-three target models, three predictor families, hyperparameter sweeps (Table 4), bootstrap CIs, filter ablations on the unfiltered dataset (Appendix F), a self-vs-cross privileged-access control (D.4), and a KL-regularization control (D.5). Evidence is quantitative and mostly in-text (e.g., baseline AUROC 0.814 vs tool 0.808-0.812 in C.3; unfiltered deltas +0.015/+0.033 with CIs). Limitations are honestly discussed, including the proxy argument that anyone with sampling access can run the counterfactual directly, and the read-only ceiling. Main weaknesses: some headline results live in figures without full numeric tables, LLM-judge dependence for screening/filters (mitigated by labels coming from resampling, not judge judgment), and the interpretability null result may partially reflect tool design rather than inherent limits. Reproducibility is strong with released code, models, datasets, costs, and verbatim formats.

primary_link.title: Would this change your answer? Evaluating Explanations of LLM Behavior In The Wild with Counterfactual Experiments

In this work, we evaluate explanations through the lens of counterfactual simulatability-whether the explanation is useful for predicting model behaviors on related counterfactual inputs. To this end, we introduce CHIVE (Counterfactual Hypothesis Investigation Via Edits), a novel agentic pipeline that identifies unexpect
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討一個根本問題:什麼才算對語言模型行為的「好解釋」?作者採用反事實可模擬性(counterfactual simulatability)的觀點:好的解釋應能幫助預測模型在相關反事實輸入上的行為。他們提出 CHIVE,一個代理式流程,自動在真實對話(WildChat)中取樣數萬個提示詞、篩選非預期行為,以反事實提示詞編輯調查並驗證成因,產生數千筆附反事實證據的行為解釋。這些資料有兩種應用。第一,評估三種讀取激活值的可解釋性工具(activation oracles、自然語言自動編碼器、稀疏自動編碼器)能否提升預測代理判斷反事實結果的能力;在兩個目標模型與三個預測模型家族上,皆無工具優於僅讀對話紀錄的基線,主因是工具輸出鮮少明確陳述因果關係。第二,以 CHIVE 資料訓練模型預測自身行為,能泛化到 held-out 的植入線索情境(MMLU 線索、AITA 諂媚測試)與分布外的 PETRI 來源,表現接近 Opus 參考基準;但訓練開放式自我解釋成效好壞參半,常出錯的自信陳述反而誤導強大的模擬器。此外未見自我訓練優於交叉訓練的特權存取證據。主要限制在於:能取樣目標模型者本可直接執行反事實實驗,故此評估只是代理指標,且工具僅限唯讀存取激活值。整體而言,此工作展示反事實調查可大規模產生真實多樣的行為成因資料,對 AI 安全中評估與改進行為解釋方法深具價值。

links.title: Fool's Gold: Defensive Deception Against Safety-Removal Attacks on Open-Weight Models

evidence: Abstract & §I: defense concedes the refusal strip and poisons its payoff; decoys trained inside a differentiable simulation of the attack; instantiated on seven models from five families (9B–122B, dense and MoE).

§IV-B Eq.(2)-(3): the attacked surface is Arditi-style directional ablation orthogonalizing write matrices; §IV-D Eq.(4)-(8): seed SFT plus on-policy DPO evaluated through the attack simulation, with refusal pin and benign KL leash.

§V 'Protocol status': experimental protocol is prospectively registered and amendment-logged; §V-B requires registered attack acceptance (refusal ≤0.2, judged compliance) before any defense metric is read.

Table I (§VI-A): validation fatal 0.508–0.899 on six gate-passing models with defense-attributable Δ +0.274 to +0.839; Qwen3.5-9B disclosed as a gate-failing boundary case excluded from pooled ranges.
Table VIII (Appendix F) and §VI-A: frozen-split replication within ±.05 of Table I values; untouched n=100 strata replicate on gemma-4 (Δ +0.755) and gpt-oss-20b (Δ +0.135).

Appendix G: blinded single-expert audit confirms 85.7% of judge fatal verdicts (FNR .404); sensitivity analysis compresses defense-attributable Δ to roughly half its pipeline value yet remains positive on every gate-passing model.

§VII-C Table XVI: 64-draw element-consensus attack recovers fully usable procedures on 0.083–0.625 on instrument-covered models vs. 0.58–0.96 undefended, with consensus precision unobservable to the attacker.
§VII-H: defense is inert against in-context jailbreaks by design (clean defended fatal 0.186 ≈ M0 calibration 0.200); §III scopes out fine-tuning attacks and public-twin diffing.

Open Science & Ethics: code, evaluation harnesses, and numeric verdict artifacts released; decoy corpora, payloads, attacked/defended checkpoints, and private attack specs withheld; rubric text and worked examples in a gated appendix.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-safety/alignment work: a release-time defense against safety-removal (abliteration) attacks on open-weight language models, matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, AI safety, alignment/RLHF via DPO, red teaming/evaluation). Novelty is strong: 'decoy hardening' transplants defensive deception (honeypots) into weights, training falsified decoy behavior to express only in the attacked state via differentiable attack simulation, distinct from refusal-hardening defenses and DDO (§II-D). Rigor is exceptional: prospectively registered amendment-logged protocol, attack acceptance gates before any defense metric, strongest-found-attack policy, ablations of both training stages, honest boundary cases (9B fails gate). Evidence is multi-model (7 models, 5 families), replicated on frozen/untouched strata, with blinded expert audit and second-judge checks; main residual weakness is judge-only content verdicts with a shared-vendor residue (both gate-passing judge families are OpenAI) and a single-expert human anchor. Generalizability is decent across architectures/scales and to adjacent harm domains, but scoped to first releases, CBRNE-operational hazards, and excludes in-context jailbreaks, fine-tuning attacks, and several unmeasured attacker classes. Reproducibility is partial: code, harnesses, and numeric verdict artifacts are released, but decoy corpora, payloads, checkpoints, and private attack specs are withheld and key material is gated.

primary_link.title: Fool's Gold: Defensive Deception Against Safety-Removal Attacks on Open-Weight Models

papers.summary: Safety alignment in open-weight language models is trivially removable: abliteration projects a refusal-mediating direction out of the weights in minutes, and no release-time defense we are aware of prevents it durably. What cannot be prevented can be deceived. Our defense, decoy hardening ("Fool's Gold"), concedes the refusal strip and poisons its payoff: once refusal is stripped, most answers to hazardous operational requests are confident, fluent decoys whose critical elements are falsified.
papers.summary_zh: 開放權重模型的安全對齊可在數分鐘內被 abliteration 之類的權重編輯移除，而現有防禦皆無法持久抵擋。本文提出「誘餌強化」：承認拒絕機制終將被剝除，轉而欺騙攻擊者。方法上，作者把可微分的模擬攻擊放進訓練迴圈，先攻擊原模型取得真實危險答案，再逐元素偽造出表面流暢、關鍵數值（如試劑、劑量、溫度）為假的誘餌，配合拒絕錨定與 KL 約束將乾淨狀態行為釘回原模型，並以攻擊狀態下的 on-policy DPO 收斂逃逸率。防禦套用於五個家族、七個模型（9B–122B，含 MoE）；六個通過註冊關卡的模型在從未訓練的提示上，有 0.51–0.90 的受攻擊回應為誘餌，其中 +0.27–0.84 可歸因於防禦，且一般行為與 MMLU、GSM8K、WMDP 等能力維持在註冊預算內。面對 64 次取樣的元素共識攻擊，完全可用率降為 0.08–0.62（未防禦 0.58–0.96），而攻擊者在缺乏真值標籤下無從區分誘餌與真解；以合規為獎勵的 RL 消融反而把模型更深推入誘餌流形，良性資料 SFT 修復也無法找回真實內容。限制包括 10–49% 的殘餘逃逸尾巴、內容判決高度依賴單一評判模型（僅輔以人工盲測校準）、白箱線性探針在充足標籤與儀器化推論下可過濾答案、防禦對 in-context 越獄無效且只保護首次釋出的權重；少數偽造可能更危險，故加入 fail-safe 篩選並要求向下游使用者揭露。此工作的意義在於首個保證自「攻擊成功之後」才開始生效的釋出時防禦，把攻擊收益轉化為無法驗證的萃取難題。
papers.title: Fool's Gold: Defensive Deception Against Safety-Removal Attacks on Open-Weight Models
papers.title_zh: Fool's Gold：以防禦性欺敵對抗開放權重模型的安全移除攻擊

links.title: MaliciousSkillBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Malicious Agent Skill Detection

evidence: Abstract/Section 1: 9,740 Skills (7,505 malicious, 2,235 benign) from 13 frozen public sources (11 Core-contributing), 8,414 raw records reduced to 7,539 normalized-unique identities in 4,588 structural families
Table 2/Section 6.2: learned detectors Random Macro-F1 0.882-0.932 but Source-Disjoint only 0.653-0.665; word TF-IDF SVM scores 0.932/0.916/0.665
Section 6.3/Table 37: on Source-Disjoint, word-SVM flags 340/545 benign Skills while missing only 37/839 malicious (recall 95.6%, benign FPR 62.4%)

Table 3/Appendix J: scanners occupy opposite failure regime (Cisco 2.5% recall/1.1% FPR; SkillSpector 0%/0.55%; SkillFortify 25.3%/49.9% on Source-Disjoint), with 10,000-resample bootstrap CIs in Table 48
Appendix H/Table 35: balancing lowers word-SVM Source-Disjoint FPR to 0.433 and scaffold sanitization leaves gaps of 0.211-0.270, showing degradation survives both controls
Appendix F.3/Table 27: authors acknowledge Source-Disjoint is confounded (SRC009 100% malicious, SRC011 4.4% malicious) and is source-conditioned stress, not a causal source effect
Section 8 Limitations: coverage bounded by frozen sources; static-only artifacts; SkillSpector evaluated in no-LLM mode; Cisco run with documented yara-x dependency-version deviation

Reproducibility Statement/Appendix L: frozen revisions, hashes, split manifests, serialized seed-42 estimators, public project page/GitHub/Hugging Face; 9,735/9,740 exact texts released, five credential-bearing records sanitized and disclosed
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant benchmark paper on malicious skill detection for LLM agents (agent security, tool-use safety, guardrail/scanner evaluation), with unusually disciplined construction: frozen 13-source registry, multi-level deduplication, cross-label conflict exclusion, structural-family and source-disjoint splits, and honest treatment of confounds. Deductions: the contribution is consolidation/evaluation rather than new attack or detection methodology (learned baselines are TF-IDF/linear models plus one frozen MiniLM), threat characterization covers only 66.4% of malicious identities with source-native mappings, the Main-benign pool draws from only five sources, and Source-Disjoint results are explicitly non-causal due to source/label skew. All cited related work is 2026 arXiv preprint, bounding external validation.

primary_link.title: MaliciousSkillBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Malicious Agent Skill Detection

papers.summary: Agent Skills extend LLM agents with reusable instruction packages that may also include scripts, resources, and service configuration. This creates a direct distribution channel for malicious behavior, yet existing malicious-Skill datasets are fragmented across sources, artifact formats, evidence regimes, and benign coverage; duplicated and structurally related content further complicates direct aggregation and evaluation. We present MaliciousSkillBench, a comprehensive benchmark for malicious A
papers.summary_zh: Agent Skill 是讓大型語言模型（LLM）代理取得可重複使用能力的指令套件，但惡意 Skill 可能竊取憑證、操縱代理行為或植入後門，使安裝前的偵測成為重要的資安問題。然而現有資料集來源零散、證據標準不一、內容互相重複，難以支撐可靠評估。本文提出 MaliciousSkillBench：作者凍結 13 個公開來源，保留 11 個符合嚴格條件者，將 8,414 筆原始惡意紀錄去重為 7,539 個正規化唯一身分與 4,588 個結構家族；排除 34 組跨標籤衝突後，主要基準含 9,740 個 Skill（7,505 個惡意、2,235 個良性），並為其中 4,983 個惡意身分對應 11 類攻擊，顯示各來源的威脅組成差異懸殊。評估方面，三個文字偵測器在隨機切分下 Macro-F1 達 0.882–0.932，最強的 word TF–IDF SVM 在留出來源測試卻降至 0.665：惡意召回率仍有 95.6%，良性誤報率卻高達 62.4%；三款現成掃描器（Cisco、SkillSpector、SkillFortify）則走向另一極端，召回率僅 0%–25.3%，低誤報其實是犧牲偵測能力換來的。研究限制包括覆蓋範圍受限於既定來源、僅分析靜態文字而非執行時行為，且來源與標籤組成互相糾結。此基準的價值在於證明可靠偵測必須同時衡量攻擊召回與良性誤報，並為防禦性研究提供可重現的共同評比基礎。
papers.title: MaliciousSkillBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Malicious Agent Skill Detection
papers.title_zh: MaliciousSkillBench：惡意代理 Skill 偵測的全面性基準

links.title: MemToC: Benchmarking Memory-Tool Conflict Resolution in Large Language Models

evidence: §1/§3.3: controlled post-tool-call setting with injected returns of known correctness enables four source-correctness cases plus tool-error and no-tool controls
§3.2: 3,912 sub-questions filtered to 605, then 575 with verified answers, blinded two-annotator QC yields 542 final questions; 542×4×3 = 6,504 episodes
§5.1 (Table 1): instruction-tuned baselines retain verified answers in only 6.5–17.1% of eligible cases vs 86.0–93.1% correct-tool following; incorrect-tool following 78.4–86.0%

§5.2: SFT and DPO meet the asymmetric criterion on the same two of four backbones (Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, gemma-2-9b-it); Mistral SFT gains retention +41.8 but loses correct-tool following −27.6 and abstention −57.7
§5.4: prompting raises retention in 11/12 pooled combinations but every strategy reduces tool-error abstention for every model; abstain-and-flag cuts Llama correct-tool following 88%→24%
§5.4/App. G: tool-choice protocol is a model×protocol interaction; Llama drops 0.992→0.328 under free auto choice, repaired by schema-constrained decoding to 0.992, replicated at T=0.7
App. F.1: OOD transfer to FaithEval/ARC is positive but frame-dependent; abstention leak confirmed on all three transferred arms; disclosed matcher repair flipped one preregistered retention gate
§6: limitations—no proprietary models, single ToolHop core, 426/575 machine-authored distractors from one generator, annotators are authors, forced elicitation makes retention upper bounds
§8: benchmark, code, scoring layer, and per-claim map released Apache-2.0 with a verification script recomputing 180 reported values; two unrecomputable families are named rather than omitted
llm_evaluation.rationale: squarely in-scope LLM work: tool-augmented LLM arbitration between parametric memory and tool returns, evaluated on Llama/Qwen/Gemma/Mistral, mitigated with DPO/SFT and prompting. The controlled design—injecting tool returns of known correctness so arbitration (not mere source preference) is measurable (§1, §3.3)—is a genuine methodological advance over prior conflict benchmarks; the asymmetric success criterion and cross-fitted chain-level splits are thoughtful. Rigor is exceptional: preregistered protocol, Holm-corrected permutation tests with cluster bootstrap (§4.5, App. B), blinded scorer validation (κ=0.806, §4.2) and target validation (κ=0.785, §3.4), disclosed post-hoc matcher repair that flipped one gate (App. F.1), and honest negative results (prompting trade-offs §5.4, 19/20 arms reduce abstention; SAE steering asymmetry App. C). Evidence is strong with CIs, replication at T=0.7, and version provenance, though transfer rests on small verified pools (279/185 episodes) and two of four backbones lack seed replication. Generalizability is limited: only open-weight 7–9B models plus one confounded 70B probe (App. F.2), a single ToolHop-derived core with one distractor realization skewed to biographical domains, and annotators who are also authors (§6). Reproducibility is excellent: Apache-2.0 release with a verification script recomputing 180 values and a per-claim file map (§8), though fine-tuned absolute levels need unreleased training runs. Score reflects top-tier methodological care with moderate external validity.

primary_link.title: MemToC: Benchmarking Memory-Tool Conflict Resolution in Large Language Models

papers.summary: Tool-augmented LLMs must arbitrate between two fallible sources when a tool return conflicts with their parametric memory, yet existing evaluations measure source preference without establishing source correctness. We introduce MemToC, a controlled benchmark for post-tool-return arbitration with executable tools. MemToC comprises 6,504 evaluation episodes constructed from 542 quality-controlled factual questions, independently elicited model-specific closed-book answers, and controlled tool retu
papers.summary_zh: 工具增強的大型語言模型在工具回傳結果與其參數記憶矛盾時，必須在兩個都可能出錯的來源間仲裁，但既有評測往往只量測來源偏好，未事先確認來源正確性。本文提出 MemToC：自 ToolHop 資料集建構 542 道經品質控管的事實性問題，為每個模型獨立引出閉卷回答，再提供正確性已知的受控工具回傳，形成 6,504 個評測情境，依來源正確性劃分四種案例並設對照組，使仲裁行為而非單純偏好得以量測。在五個開放權重 7–9B 模型上，工具回傳強烈壓倒模型自身答案：四個指令微調模型在記憶正確而工具錯誤時，僅 6.5–17.1% 保留正確答案；工具正確時有 86.0–93.1% 跟隨；兩來源皆錯時仍有 78.4–86.0% 重複錯誤回傳，且排序在三種提示措辭間不穩定。作者以鏈層級交叉切分避免訓練與評測洩漏，比較提示策略與 SFT、DPO 微調，並採非對稱成功準則：正確答案保留率須提升，且正確工具跟隨率不得顯著下降。SFT 與 DPO 僅在相同兩個骨幹（Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct、gemma-2-9b-it）達標，顯示結果取決於骨幹多於最佳化目標；20 個方法—模型組合中有 19 個降低工具錯誤後的棄答率，增益常伴隨對工具的普遍不信任，外部遷移亦不完整且依模型而異。限制包括僅涵蓋 ToolHop 與開放權重模型、干擾答案建構單一、部分模型未做多種子驗證、強制引出使保留率成為上限，人工標記者亦為作者。本文將工具—記憶衝突重新框架為正確性條件化仲裁，凸顯評測須同時檢視正確工具使用、棄答與對措辭的穩健性。
papers.title: MemToC: Benchmarking Memory-Tool Conflict Resolution in Large Language Models
papers.title_zh: MemToC：評測大型語言模型的記憶—工具衝突解決能力

links.title: AgentSpec: Speculative Decoding for Batch Inference of LLM Agents

evidence: Abstract: proposes AgentSpec with structure-isolated drafting and redundancy-aware budget allocation; claims at most 2.02x speedup over autoregressive decoding for agent batch inference.
Section 3.2 / Table 1: measured average per-request rejection rates of 53.3% (EAGLE-3), 88.7% (NGram), 65.9% (SuffixDecoding) vs 26.4% for AgentSpec on the Reflexion code-generation workflow.
Section 3.2 / Figure 2: FFN latency of Qwen-3-8B grows linearly beyond batch size 256 on A100, motivating the token budget M(b)=AI-b definition.

Section 5.2 / Table 2: goodput results across Qwen-3-8B, GPT-OSS-20B, DeepSeek-Distill-8B on GAIA, SWE-Bench, Deep Research, Code Generation; AgentSpec achieves up to 104% relative gain and 2.02x speedup while several baselines fall below 1.0x.
Section 5.5 / Table 3: on MiMo-7B, MTP reaches only 0.73x speedup on Code Gen (All) while AgentSpec reaches 1.29x.
Section 5.6 / Table 5: execution breakdown shows AgentSpec verification cost 26.11 min (down 21%) and overall 27.85 min (down 19%) vs baselines.

Section 5.7 / Table 6: ablations AgentSpec(S), AgentSpec(R), AgentSpec(N) show structure-isolated drafting contributes more than redundancy-aware budget allocation, and the no-structure variant still outperforms baselines.
Section 5.4 / Table 4: on non-agentic Spec-Bench (Qwen-3-8B), AgentSpec achieves 1.14x overall speedup, smaller than agentic gains.

Section A.1: vLLM v0.12.0 V1 engine, A100 80G, FlashAttention-2, max batch 256, baselines run with official default configs, results averaged over five seeds; API extension with structure/query_id/agent_id fields documented.
Section A.3 / Table 7: H100 speedups (e.g., 2.28x CodeGen) exceed A100, supporting hardware generalization.
Limitation: acknowledges required lightweight interface between agent and serving system and dependence on explicit semantic blocks and repeated generation patterns.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-profile: an inference-efficiency method for LLM agents, evaluated on agent benchmarks (SWE-Bench, GAIA, USACO code generation, DeepResearch) in vLLM, matching Agents & Tool Use, LLM, Inference & Serving, and Code & Programming. Novelty is solid but incremental over SuffixDecoding/NGram-style draft-model-free speculation: structure-isolated drafting via a PDA over semantic blocks (Section 4.1) and redundancy-aware budget allocation (Section 4.2, Eq. 1-3) are concrete mechanisms, though budget-allocation ideas exist (AdaSpec, TETRIS). Rigor is good: bottleneck analysis with a cost model and FFN latency measurement (Section 3.2, Figure 2), four models from four families, four agentic workloads plus Spec-Bench, MTP comparison (Table 3), ablations isolating each component (Table 6), batch-size and thinking-mode sweeps (Figure 9), and H100 cross-check (Table 7). Weaknesses: losslessness is asserted in the abstract but no explicit output-equivalence verification is reported; baseline configs use defaults (Section A.1) which may favor the proposed method; no variance/CI despite five-run averaging; rejection-rate analysis concentrates on one Reflexion workload (Table 1). Evidence strength is high for throughput claims (Table 2: up to 104% gain, 2.02x speedup; Table 5: verification -21%), with the caveat above. Generalizability is supported across models, GPUs, and a non-agentic benchmark (1.14x, Table 4), though the method expects semantic-structure metadata from the agent, acknowledged in Limitations. Reproducibility is moderate: engine version, GPU, baseline hyperparameters, API extension example, and pseudocode are given (Section A.1, A.2), but no code-release claim and key hyperparameters (alpha, g_min) values are unspecified.

primary_link.title: AgentSpec: Speculative Decoding for Batch Inference of LLM Agents

papers.summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agent applications often incur high response time. Speculative decoding is a promising solution to improve the inference efficiency of LLM agents without impacting generation quality. However, state-of-the-art speculative decoding algorithms exhibit substantial speed degradation under large batch sizes, limiting their effectiveness to deploy in real-world agent applications. In this work, we first present a systematic analysis of speculative decoding for LLM agen
papers.summary_zh: 以大型語言模型（LLM）為基礎的代理應用常因多步推理與工具呼叫而推論成本高昂。推測解碼雖可無損加速生成，但在現代推論引擎普遍採用的大批次設定下，現有方法的加速效果會大幅衰退，甚至比自迴歸解碼更慢。作者分析後歸納兩大瓶頸：推測 token 的高拒絕率，以及動態 token 預算的低利用率。據此提出 AgentSpec，一套免草稿模型的推測解碼演算法：其一為結構隔離起草，要求代理提供語意結構識別資訊，透過輕量下推自動機追蹤語意區塊，僅從語意一致的歷史片段擷取草稿，將拒絕率降至約 26%，遠低於 EAGLE-3 的 53% 與 NGram 的 89%；其二為冗餘感知預算分配，以冗餘分數預測各請求的接受可能性，動態分配推測預算以貼近硬體可用上限。團隊在 vLLM 上實作，於 Qwen-3-8B、GPT-OSS-20B、DeepSeek 蒸餾模型與 MiMo-7B，以及程式碼生成、深度研究、SWE-Bench、GAIA 等代理式工作負載評估，最高達 2.02 倍加速，goodput 較最佳基線提升最多 104%，於 Spec-Bench 與對比 MiMo-7B 的 MTP 亦領先。消融實驗顯示兩個元件各有貢獻，其中結構隔離起草影響較大。限制在於需在代理與伺服器間加入輕量介面，且加速程度部分取決於工作負載中重複生成樣式的多寡；即使缺少明確語意結構，仍有穩定加速。此研究讓推測解碼在大批次代理服務場景重新變得實用，有助降低 LLM 代理的部署成本與延遲。
papers.title: AgentSpec: Speculative Decoding for Batch Inference of LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: AgentSpec：針對 LLM 代理批次推論的推測解碼演算法

links.title: AgentJudgeBench: A Multi-Difficulty Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Judges on Agentic Tool-Calling

evidence: Abstract: 3,808 instances, six DAG topologies, three difficulty tiers; hard without-GT alignment converges to a 77-82% band across all six judges, with GT exposure reducing alignment for GPT-5.4 (-1.5 pp) and Gemini-2.5-Pro (-3.9 pp).
Sec 3.2 / Table 2: full factorial alignment results across five generators, six judges, three difficulties, both GT conditions; QwQ-32B leads with-GT in 10 of 15 cells while never leading without-GT.
Appendix E (Table 10): 95% bootstrap CIs (n=2,000 stratified resamples) with half-widths <=0.3 pp for every cell, supporting robustness of monotone difficulty effects.

Appendix G (Tables 12-13): 120-record human study validates the programmatic scorer at 92.7% overall (82.5% on parameter structure); GPT-OSS-120B is most human-aligned judge (Delta=-2.8 pp) and QwQ-32B drops 1st to 4th under human verdicts.
Appendix N (Table 20): rewrite validation unanimity is 93.9% for hard-vs-medium but only 58.1% for medium-vs-easy, with the paper explicitly downgrading the medium tier to a robustness check.

Sec 4.2 RQ5 (Table 5/26): CoT thinking on/off changes alignment by at most 0.3 pp across 24 paired cells; RQ6 (Table 31): structured prompt advantage of +4.8 to +6.5 pp on one pairing only partially replicates and reverses on hard queries (+3.9/+2.4/-0.8 pp).
Appendix J (Table 1): C3 corrupted-GT control shows Gemini-2.5-Pro anchors to any reference block while QwQ-32B tracks its without-GT score within 0.2 pp.
Appendix O (Table 23): GPT-5.4 self-preference check finds aggregate bias +0.012 within cross-generator range but a localized sequence-accuracy over-credit of +0.172 vs <=+0.008 elsewhere.

Limitations / Appendix B: single-annotator validation, synthetic records with domain-drift risk, non-reproducible GPT-5.4 snapshot, and evaluation-time-only scope are all explicitly acknowledged and partially bounded (ranking shifts <=0.09 pp under generous correction).

Supplementary Material: dataset and all judge verdicts on HuggingFace (ServiceNow-AI/AgentJudgeBench) and pipeline code with reproducibility script via SyGra GitHub; verbatim prompts in Appendix W; GPT-5.4 identifier is a non-versioned Azure snapshot (Appendix M/P).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly in-scope: a systematic reliability study of LLM-as-judge for agentic tool-calling, directly hitting top-weighted preferences (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, evaluation/benchmarking, CoT ablation, prompt-format sensitivity). Novelty is solid though incremental in parts: individual ingredients (BFCL-style data, DAG benchmarks, judge models) exist, but the paired with/without-GT protocol with difficulty stratification, per-metric decomposition, and deterministic programmatic reference is a genuinely new combination (Appendix L comparison). Rigor is strong: full 5x6x3x2 factorial (321,648 evaluations, Appendix D), bootstrap CIs <=0.3 pp (Appendix E), corrupted-GT C3 control (Appendix J), 0.5-default C2 ablation (Table 4), CoT and temperature ablations each replicated on a second pairing (Appendix R), scorer human validation (Appendix G), self-preference check (Appendix O), and unusually honest limitations (single annotator, 58.1% medium-tier validation, non-reproducible GPT-5.4 snapshot). Evidence strength is high; key claims are backed by tables with CIs and bounded corrections (Table 15). Generalizability is the weakest axis: synthetic single-shot records, domain drift acknowledged, ceiling partly prompt-dependent for weak generators, and judge rankings are model-version-specific. Reproducibility is good (code, HF dataset, verbatim prompts in Appendix W) but marred by the non-reproducible GPT-5.4 Azure snapshot used as generator, judge, and meta-judge.

primary_link.title: AgentJudgeBench: A Multi-Difficulty Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Judges on Agentic Tool-Calling

papers.summary: LLM judges are widely used to evaluate agentic tool-calling systems, yet their reliability on structured, dependency-driven workflows remains largely unexamined. We present AgentJudgeBench, the first benchmark to systematically study LLM-as-a-judge reliability for agentic tool-calling over workflow DAGs, as distinct from the broader LLM-as-a-judge task of open-ended text or preference evaluation. The benchmark comprises 3,808 instances spanning six DAG topologies and three difficulty tiers, eval
papers.summary_zh: LLM 裁判已廣泛用於評估代理式工具呼叫系統，但在結構化、依賴驅動工作流程上的可靠性長期未被檢驗。本文提出 AgentJudgeBench，首個針對工作流程 DAG 上 LLM-as-a-judge 可靠性的系統性基準：包含 3,808 筆 BFCL 風格資料，橫跨六種 DAG 拓撲與三個難度層級，每筆均附經程式化驗證的 ground-truth 軌跡。五個生成器（3B–70B 開源模型與 GPT-5.4）產出工具呼叫預測，由六個裁判（20B 至前沿規模）在有／無 ground truth 的配對條件下，就工具選擇、參數結構、序列準確性與查詢覆蓋四項指標評分，合計 321,648 次評估。主要結果：裁判對齊度隨難度單調下降，無 ground truth 時降幅約 1.5 倍；高難度且無參考答案時，六個裁判不論規模皆收斂於 77–82% 窄幅區間，顯示模型容量無法克服的結構性天花板；提供 ground truth 未必有利，GPT-5.4 與 Gemini-2.5-Pro 對齊度反而下降，符合過度錨定；思維鏈推理與取樣溫度影響可忽略，結構化評分準則最多提升 6.5 個百分點但未必通用。有 ground truth 時 QwQ-32B 最貼近程式化參考，GPT-OSS-120B 最貼近人類判斷。限制包括資料為合成生成、程式化評分器在參數結構指標上與人類一致度僅 82.5%，medium 難度未完全校準，且 GPT-5.4 身兼生成器、裁判與改寫驗證的 meta-judge。本研究揭露 LLM 裁判的根本限制，為代理系統評估提供部署指引，警示不宜單一依賴任何裁判。
papers.title: AgentJudgeBench: A Multi-Difficulty Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Judges on Agentic Tool-Calling
papers.title_zh: AgentJudgeBench：以多難度基準評估 LLM 裁判於代理式工具呼叫的可靠性

links.title: Semantic Overlays: Mitigating Prompt Injection with Annotations Beyond Tokens and Steering Vectors

evidence: Abstract: SEP separation rises from 24.3% to 96.5% with utility unchanged, TensorTrust ASR falls 34.8% to 6.6%, all four PIArena families drop to 0% compliance, marked spans stay readable at 92.5% exact copy rate.
§7 Training: adapter is 50M parameters, base model untouched; training items share SEP's shape so SEP measures in-distribution generalization while TensorTrust and PIArena are zero-shot transfer.

Table 1 (§4): embedding-conditioned shared MLP reaches 99.5% exact span retrieval and 100% refusal-when-absent vs 63.3%/89.7% for a 604M per-overlay MLP, attributed to supervision sharing and state-conditioned writes.

Appendix I, Table I.1: replication on frozen Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct moves SEP 31.0%→96.2%, TensorTrust hijacking 68.9%→4.4%, all PIArena families to 0%, with hyperparameters unchanged and corpus re-derived per Appendix D.

Appendix E: red team of 222 adaptive black-box probes; no direct authority attacks succeeded, but trusted instructions that delegate to marked spans override the overlay, and no instruction hierarchy was trained.

Appendix F: documents SEP witness substring false positives (pen matches 'open'), a TensorTrust harness discarding 606 of 776 rows non-randomly, and substring scoring inflating extraction; main tables lead with the corrected rule and give published-rule numbers in parentheses.
Appendix G.1: three seeds at temperature 0.7 reproduce every SEP number within 0.4 points; run-to-run noise floor measured at ~2 points on a 300-item paired subset.
§8 and Appendix C: held-out instruction embeddings fail 0/120 by nearest-neighbor substitution (codes collapse to effective rank two), while held-out pointer concepts score 95%.

Reproducibility statement: code at github.com/JoshuaSP/semantic-overlays, corpus and adapter checkpoints on HuggingFace, ≈32 GPU-hours per overlay set, Appendix B gives full recipe and hyperparameters.

Appendix J: limitations include one base model at one scale, channel experiments not replicated, binary non-executable overlay, unmeasured agentic multi-turn settings, and unprofiled end-to-end serving latency.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology and safety paper, squarely in scope: a trained span-targeted residual-stream adapter on frozen LLMs (Qwen3.5-9B, Llama-3.1-8B) that defends against prompt injection, directly matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, AI Safety, Red Teaming & Evaluation, Agents security, Interpretability/steering). Novelty is a genuine but incremental advance over prior defenses: unlike ISE/ASIDE/AIR it keeps the base frozen, applies edits only at designated prefill spans across all layers, state-conditioned and multiplexed; position-targeted steering is explicitly named as future work by Rimsky et al. Rigor is above average: four architectures compared on identical data (Table 1), loss ablation (CE vs KL vs hybrid, 93.5/88.5/79.6), Muon multiplier sweep, payload screening, mechanical target validation, a 222-probe adaptive red team, and honest reporting of failure modes (haiku 18% compliance; delegation attacks succeed; novel descriptors fail 0/120). Evidence is strong and specific (SEP 24.3→96.5 with utility ~unchanged on 9,160 items; TensorTrust 34.8→6.6 on all 776 rows; PIArena four families to 0%; replication on a second model family; seeded reruns within 0.4 points), and the authors surface defects in the very benchmarks they use, reporting both corrected and published-rule numbers. Generalizability is capped by single-scale testing (8-9B), channel experiments (§4-6) not replicated across families, single training runs outside the injection benchmarks, binary overlay only, and unmeasured multi-turn/agentic settings. Reproducibility is excellent: full pipeline code, corpus, and adapter checkpoints released, ~32 GPU-hours per set, recipes and harness deviations documented. Self-reported results and reliance on a small LLM judge for some scoring keep it short of the top band.

primary_link.title: Semantic Overlays: Mitigating Prompt Injection with Annotations Beyond Tokens and Steering Vectors

papers.summary: Everything a language model sees is tokens. The serving stack knows what each span is -- user input, tool output, instructions -- but the model must keep track of that itself, and it can lose track or be confused: text can be written to read like anything. Prompt injection is a natural exploit of this phenomenon. By scrambling the model's understanding of span identity, an attacker can induce unwanted and potentially dangerous actions. Adding a non-textual channel to the model's input -- a way t
papers.summary_zh: 語言模型的輸入全是token:部署端雖然知道每段文字來自使用者、擷取文件或工具,卻只能以可偽造的文字傳達這項資訊,提示注入攻擊正由此而生。本文提出Semantic Overlays:在凍結模型的殘差流上,於指定prefill位置套用小型學習式adapter,以頻外方式為跨度加上標記;標記是激活編輯而非文字,任何輸入皆無法模仿,基底模型完全未被修改,可依請求開關,其中以嵌入條件化的共享MLP效果最佳。實驗顯示:模型能讀回堆疊的視覺標記(99.5%精確跨度召回,缺席時100%正確拒答);標記能覆寫模型對內容的認知,例如宣稱片段是Python時,模型會忠實地以Python重寫該程式(97%);標記也能攜帶僅作用於該跨度的指令。將一個「勿執行」標記套用於不受信任內容即成提示注入防禦:SEP分離度自24.3%升至96.5%而效用不變(作者並發現且修正SEP評分器缺失),TensorTrust劫持成功率由34.8%降至6.6%,PIArena四類攻擊全數歸零,被標記內容仍可92.5%逐字引用;防禦亦在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上重現,紅隊222次自適應探測中直接權限攻擊皆未得手。限制:僅驗證單一規模、可信任指令委派至標記跨度時行為不一致、對最佳化式攻擊未經檢驗、未訓練的指令嵌入無法零樣本泛化,且假設部署端本身未被入侵。此法顯示頻外詮釋資料通道能兼顧安全與可用性,為不動權重的指令層級防護開創新路徑。

links.title: WebMCP-Phalanx: Enforcing and Characterizing Trust Boundaries for Browser-Integrated LLM Agents

evidence: Section 5.1: experiments conducted in a real browser environment on @mcp-b/global 2.3.2 (2026-06-17 draft spec); attack success defined as malicious tool invoked and exfiltrated data received at the receiving end.
Table 1 (Section 5.2): four-layer ablation (L0-L3), n=80 per cell; description injection 69/80 (L0) to 0/80 (L3); return-content injection 42/80 (L0) to 2/80 (L3).

Table 2 (Section 5.3) and Section 5.3 text: the 2/80 residuals at L2/L3 are explained as name-driven invocations occurring before inspection; Q detects the carrier 40/40; residuals are structural, not detection failures.

Table 3 (Section 5.4): cross-page semantic residual — lifecycle clearing alone leaves 70% ASR; lifecycle+framework yields 0% ASR at 100% completion; Section 5.2 reports no-attack baseline 61/80 statistically indistinguishable from L3 (p=0.48); Section 6.2 flags adversarial utility inflation (p=0.003).

Section 6.1: capability handles reduce overwrite/revocation attacks (V4, V6) from 20/20 to 0/20 and V5 legitimate responses rise 0/20 to 20/20; bearer-capability limits and confused-deputy risk acknowledged.

Section 6.2/Section 7: name-relevance Table 4 shows rule-based stripping ASR rises 0% to 70% with name relevance while multi-agent stays 0%; white-box adaptive attacker with Q's classifier prompt bypassed 15/16 description payloads with median one rewrite.

Section 7 (Limitations): reference implementation is a JavaScript polyfill emulating API-surface integrity and script provenance; site-declared trust policy and Request UI not empirically evaluated; Runtime Observation is detection/containment, not prevention; Section 5.1 uses a single unnamed language model and no code release is claimed.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly on-scope: security architecture for browser-integrated LLM agents with MCP-style tool calling, prompt-injection defense, and adversarial evaluation maps strongly to the Agents & Tool Use, AI Safety, LLM, and Red Teaming preferences. Strengths: well-specified threat model (same-origin script attacker, extensions explicitly out of scope), a clean four-layer ablation with n=80 per cell, a notable utility-confounder analysis anchoring completion to a no-attack baseline (p=0.48, p=0.003), an honest limitations section, and a white-box adaptive-attacker study showing 15/16 description-layer bypasses via tool-name relocation. Weaknesses: the asymmetric dual-agent quarantine is derivative of Dual-LLM/CaMeL-style privilege separation (novelty rests mainly on the browser-native capability layer and the WebMCP specification-level analysis); results are tied to one reference implementation version with an unnamed LLM; no empirical comparison against external defenses (CaMeL, ACE, IsolateGPT); two architectural components (trust policy, Request UI) are presented but not evaluated; no code/artifact release is claimed. Evidence is internally consistent and quantitative but self-contained, lowering generalizability and reproducibility. Calibrated weighted score ~0.78.

primary_link.title: WebMCP-Phalanx: Enforcing and Characterizing Trust Boundaries for Browser-Integrated LLM Agents

papers.summary: The emerging W3C WebMCP proposal enables LLM agents to invoke tools exposed by web pages. In multi-party web environments, however, integrating agent execution into a browser security model centered on the Same-Origin Policy (SOP) leaves insufficient provenance and lifecycle guarantees for agent-accessible tools, creating three risks: subject-attribution spoofing, uncontrolled tool lifecycles, and semantic prompt injection. We propose WebMCP-Phalanx, a dual-layer agent runtime architecture. Its
papers.summary_zh: 隨著 W3C 推動 WebMCP 標準草案，網頁將能向 LLM 代理人暴露可呼叫的工具，但也使代理執行落入以同源政策（SOP）為中心的瀏覽器安全模型；由於網站主程式、第三方廣告 SDK 與分析腳本共用同一 origin，規範未提供工具來源與生命週期保障，衍生主體歸屬偽冒、生命週期失控與語意提示注入等結構性弱點。作者提出 WebMCP-Phalanx 雙層架構：瀏覽器原生層以不可偽造的能力憑證綁定工具所有權，並結合遙測與生命週期監控產生綠、黃、紅三級信任標籤；多代理層則由不具工具呼叫權限的隔離代理（Q-LLM）先行檢視工具描述、輸入綱要與回傳內容，再交由擁有執行權限的特權代理（P-LLM）使用。真實瀏覽器實驗顯示，所有權機制將撤銷與覆寫攻擊成功率由 100% 降為 0%，雙代理執行環境擋下全部 80 次描述注入，回傳內容注入僅殘留 2 次，且任務效用與無攻擊基線無統計顯著差異。論文亦刻畫限制：同源腳本可自行註冊取得憑證，使來源維度失效；白箱自適應攻擊者能將指令藏於工具名稱並在檢查完成前觸發呼叫，繞過描述層過濾；polyfill 實作的安全假設屬模擬性質，能力憑證屬持有式憑證，仍有混淆代理人問題。作者建議 WebMCP 納入原生腳本來源與宣告式信任拓撲等機制，並新增呼叫時機閘門，盼在規範定型前落實安全設計，對瀏覽器整合代理的安全性與標準制定具直接參考價值。

papers.title_zh: WebMCP-Phalanx：為瀏覽器整合式 LLM 代理人強制並刻畫信任邊界

links.title: What Does Activation Steering Control? Attribution Across Answer Encodings and Output-Sensitive Subspaces

evidence: Abstract and Table 1: across all five A/B/C remappings on NormBank strict split, extraction-index effects (3.00-4.13) exceed semantic-label effects (up to 2.18), with advantage 1.95-4.04 and 93.8-97.6% positive pairs
Section 5.1/Table 17-18: norm-matched layer sweep shows extraction-index advantage rises from -0.061 at 50% depth to +0.236 at 75% and +0.208 at 87.5%, with paired depth contrasts excluding zero

Section 5.1/Table 22-24: validation-selected identifier-readout subspace contains 15.4% of CAA squared L2 energy yet retains 96.3% [95.8, 96.7] of the extraction-index effect; residual (84.6% energy) retains 1.0%; per-model retention 93.3-103.5%

Appendix C.1/Table 28: ITI-style replication across three retained models shows positive extraction-index advantage (5.63-9.33) under all five alternative mappings; wrong-sign control exceeded by 14.13 [14.09, 14.17]

Section 5.2/Table 3 and Appendix D: open-ended verdicts diverge from MCQ (refusal MCQ +3.28 vs open -0.13; sycophancy MCQ -0.48 vs open +1.11), with judge panel validated on 180 blinded human-scored responses (Pearson .927, QWK .929)

Section 4 and Appendix A: locked interventions (zero-based blocks 20/23/23/31, alpha=0.8), strict group-disjoint splits with zero cross-split overlap (Table 7), five seeded Gaussian controls, and group-cluster bootstrap with Holm correction (Appendix E.3)

Section 7 Limitations: audit covers only three three-label tasks and four instruction-tuned model families; factorial audit, localization, and ITI confined to NormBank; gradient subspace functionally localizes without identifying a complete circuit
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM interpretability/evaluation methodology paper: it audits what CAA/ITI activation steering actually controls by freezing interventions and counterfactually re-encoding MCQ answers, separating semantic-label, extraction-index, and extraction-row following, and localizing the effect to a low-rank output-sensitive subspace. Preference relevance is high (LLMs, interpretability, safety behaviors like hallucination/refusal/sycophancy, evaluation methodology). Novelty is solid: applying verbalizer/selector-remapping logic to attribute steering-induced changes is a genuinely new evaluation framework, though it builds on known MCQ-selection-bias work. Rigor is exceptional: 108-condition factorial audits, L2- and covariance-matched random controls, competence gating, wrong-sign controls, norm-matched layer sweeps, position controls, prespecified positive-gain criteria, cluster bootstrap with Holm correction, and blinded human validation of LLM judges (r=.927). Evidence is strong and quantified with tight CIs (Table 1: 3.00-4.13 extraction-index effects; Table 22: 15.4% energy retaining 96.3% of effect), and limitations are honestly scoped to three three-label tasks and four model families. Generalizability is decent but the paper itself documents reversals (Qwen, SC101), tempering universal claims. Reproducibility is aided by exact templates, locked hyperparameters, seeds, and split audits, though no explicit repository URL is stated. Score ~0.86.

primary_link.title: What Does Activation Steering Control? Attribution Across Answer Encodings and Output-Sensitive Subspaces

papers.summary: Activation steering is often evaluated under the answer encoding used to construct the direction. A reported gain may reflect the intended judgment or compatibility with answer identifiers seen during construction. We introduce Cross-Encoding Steering Evaluation, which freezes an intervention while re-encoding answers to the same held-out items. On NormBank, after A/B/C identifiers are reassigned, contrastive activation addition (CAA) induces larger target-versus-source score changes for the ext
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討激活導引(activation steering)的根本證據問題:當對比激活加入(CAA)等介入手法在特定答案編碼下提升分數時,它究竟控制了什麼?作者提出「跨編碼導引評估」,在凍結介入方向的前提下,對同一批保留測試項目重新編碼答案(改變標籤對應、識別碼詞彙與列序),藉此區分語意標籤追隨、抽取索引追隨(extraction-index following)與抽取列追隨三種可能。在 NormBank 上,重新指派 A/B/C 後,CAA 對抽取索引的目標分數變化大於對語意標籤者;因子式審計(6 種語意映射、3 種識別碼詞彙、6 種列序,共 108 條件)證實效果追隨索引而非顯示列位置。經範數匹配後,此效果主要在較深層(75% 與 87.5% 深度)出現;一個僅佔方向平方範數 15.4% 的低秩輸出敏感子空間,卻保留了 96.3% 的效果,顯示高度集中。ITI 式方法在 NormBank 的三個模型重現同樣排序;MNLI 整體偏向抽取索引追隨(唯 Qwen 反轉),SC101 則偏向語意標籤追隨,顯示歸因隨模型與任務而異。開放式生成測試亦顯示選擇題分數與生成行為可能得出不同結論:幻覺在兩種評估皆為正,拒答僅在選擇題有增益,諂媚僅在開放式評估有增益。限制包括僅涵蓋三個三標籤任務與四個模型系列,子空間分析屬功能性定位而未找出完整電路。其重要性在於:單一答案編碼下的導引增益無法證明語意控制,導引主張須有與所宣稱控制層級相符的證據。
