links.title: TTPO: Test-Time Policy Optimization

evidence: Abstract + Table 2: claim 'raises Qwen3-1.7B from 38.0% to 45.2% in TTT' matches reported averages (Base 38.0, TTPO 45.2 over AIME26/HMMT26/BRUMO25).
Abstract + Table 7: non-thinking gains +25.2/+30.6/+36.4 correspond to Base 9.5/19.9/20.3 vs TTPO 34.7/50.5/56.7 averages.

Section 4.1: evaluation is Avg@12 at temperature 1.0; OPSD/TTPO trained 100 steps with 'peak performance across checkpoints saved every 25 steps', GRPO/TTRL 500 steps with peak across all checkpoints — peak selection without error bars.

Section 3.2 / Figure 1(a): asserts pseudo-labels wrong on ~85% of AIME 2026 prompts and ~79% of disagreeing rollouts wrong; the 85% figure is not analyzed per problem and sits uneasily with the 37.8 base Avg@12 and K=64 voting.
Table 1: TTPO vs label-supervised OPSD margins are 40.1 vs 39.7 (1.7B), 58.6 vs 58.4 (4B), 62.6 vs 61.7 (8B) — within plausible noise, no variance reported.
Section 4.3 / Table 3: token-level ablations (TTPO 46.5/31.6/54.7 vs w/o pos. weight 43.3/30.6/52.8 and w/o neg. mask 45.4/29.5/50.0) support both components.
Figure 3: update-strategy ablation shows full TTPO (48.9) beats all alternatives including reversed assignment (37.2) on Qwen3-1.7B AIME26 TTT.

Appendix A (Tables 5-6) and Appendix B: full training/eval hyperparameters (LoRA r=64, alpha=128, lr 5e-6, K=64, lambda=0.1, 16k sampling / 1,024 gradient tokens) and prompt templates; code URL given in Abstract.
Appendix F: limitations explicitly cover majority-vote dependence, restriction to math with verifiable answers, and fixed curriculum; code generation and open-ended reasoning unexplored.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-topic LLM reasoning paper: label-free test-time training via an asymmetric objective (OPSD distillation on majority-vote-agreeing rollouts, GRPO penalties on disagreeing ones) with token-level weighting/masking, evaluated on Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B across five competition math benchmarks. Strong preference fit (LLMs, chain-of-thought reasoning, RL/GRPO, LoRA fine-tuning). Novelty is moderate: the asymmetric routing and the empirical observation that ~79% of disagreeing rollouts are wrong regardless of pseudo-label correctness are a genuine contribution, but components (TTRL, OPSD, TIP, STAPO token selection) are assembled from prior work. Rigor is good: four baselines including label-free and label-supervised, extensive ablations (Table 3 token selection, Figure 3 update-strategy grid, Table 4 privileged information, Tables 8-10 hyperparameter sweeps), theory appendix (E), and explicit limitations (Appendix F). Deductions: all methods report peak-across-checkpoint accuracy (Section 4.1) which inflates absolute numbers; headline 'matches or exceeds label-supervised OPSD' rests on 0.2-0.9 avg-point margins (Table 1) without error bars or significance tests; the ~85% wrong-pseudo-label rate (Section 3.2) seems internally high given a 37.8 base Avg@12 and K=64 voting, and is not broken down per problem; the surprising 'pseudo-labels beat ground-truth supervision' result (Figure 5) has plausible but unverified explanations. Generalizability is limited to verifiable-answer math on one model family, acknowledged in Appendix F. Reproducibility is solid: code link, full hyperparameter tables (Appendix A, Tables 5-6), prompt templates (Appendix B).

primary_link.title: TTPO: Test-Time Policy Optimization

papers.summary: Recent prominent post-training methods, such as Reinforcement Learning (RL) and On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), have driven rapid progress in mathematical reasoning for large language models, yet their reliance on ground-truth labels precludes test-time training (TTT). Replacing ground truth with majority-vote pseudo-labels is a natural alternative, yet it is fragile: an incorrect vote corrupts the teacher and misleads every token. We observe that this failure mode is asymmetric: rollouts that disagree with the pseudo-label are typically wrong regardless of whether the vote itself is correct. Building on this observation, we propose Test-Time Policy Optimization (TTPO), an asymmetric objective that distills agreeing rollouts via OPSD and penalizes disagreeing rollouts with Grouped RL. Token-level selection further refines both branches: distillation down-weights already-converged positions, while RL penalizes only confident errors. Both updates remain well-grounded even under frequent pseudo-label errors, and majority-vote routing yields tighter self-supervision as the model improves. Without any labels, TTPO matches label-supervised OPSD on five competition-level benchmarks, raises Qwen3-1.7B from 38.0% to 45.2% in TTT, yields +25.2% to +36.4% without thinking, and shows strong cross-task generalization.
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文處理大型語言模型在無標籤情境下進行測試時訓練（TTT）的難題。現行後訓練方法如強化學習（RLVR）與 on-policy 自我蒸餾（OPSD）皆仰賴標準答案；改用多數決虛擬標籤時，錯誤共識會污染教師模型，在每個 token 上誤導訓練——在競賽級題目上虛擬標籤約有 85% 是錯的。作者觀察到關鍵的不對稱性：與虛擬標籤不一致的 rollout 中約 79% 本身也是錯的，因此懲罰「不一致」樣本不論標籤對錯幾乎都正確。據此提出 TTPO 不對稱目標：對一致的正樣本施以前向 KL 為基礎的 OPSD 蒸餾，並以 token 加權聚焦學生尚未掌握的位置；對不一致的負樣本施以 GRPO 懲罰，並以遮罩只懲罰導致失敗的自信錯誤。在 AIME、HMMT、BRUMO 五個競賽級數學基準上，完全不用標籤的 TTPO 即追平或超越使用標準答案的 OPSD；純 TTT 設定下將 Qwen3-1.7B 平均準確率由 38.0% 提升至 45.2%；關閉思考模式時增益達 +25.2 至 +36.4 個百分點，並展現跨基準遷移與自我演進能力。有趣的是，以虛擬標籤訓練反而勝過使用標準答案，因為過難的真實標籤使兩個分支同時缺乏學習訊號。限制包括依賴多數決品質、僅驗證於具可驗證答案的數學領域，以及採用固定的訓練課程。此研究為無標籤的測試時自我改良提供了穩健且有效的新方向。
papers.title: TTPO: Test-Time Policy Optimization
papers.title_zh: TTPO：測試時策略最佳化

links.title: Graph-Guided Selective Unlearning for Language Models: Controlling Support Routes Beyond Forget Seeds

evidence: Section 3.3, Table 2: GraphSU achieves 46.83% soft leakage at retain PPL 3.27 on TOFU complete deletion, lowest among methods satisfying PPL<=10; GRU's 38.13% violates the constraint at PPL 79.11.

Section 3.3: Seed-Only ablation uses the same unlearning objective but omits the graph controller, isolating scope-control effects; reductions of 46.42/41.65/18.33 points on TOFU and 49.50/21.66/12.22 on PISTOL across settings.

Appendix F, Table 8: taxonomy-blind free-form probes (736 all-target, 342 confirmed-attack) evaluated with five detectors; combined-detector reduction 13.59 pp with 95% CI [8.97, 18.34] and McNemar p=5.98e-10.

Appendix D: local Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct extraction swap yields soft leakage 49.83% vs 46.83% (GPT-4.1); 40% graph-critical corruption retains 66/72 support nodes with diffusion-score correlation >=0.9974.
Appendix A: Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct complete deletion shows 13.33% vs Seed-Only 93.67% leakage at PPL 1.96 vs 1.05; PPL definition correction (exp(0.03)≈1.03) documented.
Appendix J: the archive lacks a leave-one-view-out sweep for the five affinity terms and independent sweeps over rho, hop limit, and budget B; gains are not attributed to a single view.
Appendix K: unlearning runs use one training seed; no across-seed variance reported and none fabricated.
Limitations section: soft leakage measures behavioral recoverability under fixed route probes, not certified representational erasure.
Appendix H, Table 9: graph build at 4K samples takes 452.36s with 7.82MB cache and 4.01s warm selection; exact cosine retrieval is quadratic and flagged as bottleneck.
Section 3.1, Table 1: baselines GA, GA+KL, DPO, NPO-TR, AltPO, GRU, SELU from same SFT checkpoint with shared forget seeds and prompts; per-setting hyperparameters given but full sweeps deferred.
llm_evaluation.rationale: On-topic LLM methodology paper: selective unlearning for fine-tuned language models with privacy/compliance motivation, adversarial recovery-probe evaluation, and safety-adjacent framing, aligning with high-weight LLM, AI Safety, and Red Teaming/Evaluation preferences; no out-of-scope domain trigger. Novelty is solid but incremental: scope expansion beyond forget seeds via related-knowledge removal (UIPE, Wei et al.) and influence-style attribution (Koh & Liang, TRAK) exist; the multi-view support graph with restart-diffusion and graded forgetting strengths (Section 2.3-2.5) is a credible new controller, explicitly separated from the loss. Rigor is strong: matched Seed-Only ablation sharing the same objective (Section 3.3), seven baselines, three deletion settings, two datasets, two backbones (Table 2, Appendix A), local-extractor swap with corruption stress tests (Appendix D), and taxonomy-blind LLM-generated probes with bootstrap CIs and McNemar tests (Appendix F/Table 8). Evidence is weakened by a single training seed (Appendix K), absence of leave-one-view-out or fusion-weight sweeps (Appendix J), self-defined soft-leakage metric with tau=0.85, small models (GPT-2 Medium, Llama-3.2-3B), and a post-hoc PPL<=10 feasibility guardrail, though Appendix B shows Pareto robustness across caps 5-50 and honest reporting of residual partial-deletion leakage (81.67% TOFU). Generalizability is limited to QA-format English unlearning benchmarks; beyond-QA applicability is argued (Appendix A) but not tested, and quadratic candidate retrieval is a scaling bottleneck (Appendix H). Reproducibility is aided by released anonymous code, frozen prompts/manifests, hyperparameter tables, and a validated local extraction path, but full sweeps are not provided. Calculated: 0.85*0.4 + 0.7*0.15 + 0.8*0.15 + 0.77*0.15 + 0.6*0.1 + 0.7*0.05 = 0.77.

primary_link.title: Graph-Guided Selective Unlearning for Language Models: Controlling Support Routes Beyond Forget Seeds

papers.summary: Enterprises fine-tune language models on proprietary data that may later require removal due to privacy, contractual, or compliance obligations. Selective unlearning removes requested knowledge while preserving model utility, offering a practical alternative to full retraining, but existing methods treat the explicitly identified forget examples as the complete deletion scope. This is insufficient when target knowledge remains recoverable through paraphrases, aliases, or neighboring training exa
papers.summary_zh: 企業常以專有資料微調大型語言模型，但基於隱私、合約或法規義務，事後往往必須刪除特定知識。現有選擇性遺忘方法多半只針對明確標記的遺忘樣本，忽略目標知識仍可透過改寫、別名或相鄰訓練樣本被推論還原的問題。本文提出GraphSU，一個與損失函數無關的圖引導控制器：先以GPT-4.1離線抽取事實三元組，融合實體、關係、尾實體三種符號重疊、語意相似度與答案側梯度對齊共五種視圖，建構加權支援圖；再以個人化圖擴散從遺忘種子傳播刪除壓力，選出高風險支援鄰居並賦予分級遺忘強度，最後結合熵最大化、unlikelihood、表示斥力與保留損失進行更新。在TOFU與PISTOL基準上，以GPT-2 Medium與Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct評估，GraphSU在所有刪除設定下均達到保留困惑度低於10的最低軟性洩漏，相較共用相同遺忘目標的Seed-Only對照組最多降低49.5個百分點，且在736個未見過的自由形式探測提示上維持統計顯著的改善。限制方面：部分刪除仍有大量殘餘洩漏；軟性洩漏僅衡量行為層面的可達性，並非具備正式保證的表徵抹除；實驗僅使用單一訓練種子，亦未完成逐視圖消融分析。整體而言，本研究顯示可靠的知識刪除關鍵在於控制支援路徑，而非只設計遺忘損失函數，對企業部署中的隱私與合規管理具實務價值。
papers.title: Graph-Guided Selective Unlearning for Language Models: Controlling Support Routes Beyond Forget Seeds
papers.title_zh: GraphSU：圖引導的語言模型選擇性遺忘——控制遺忘種子之外的支援路徑

links.title: Unlearning Is Not Just Erasing: Temporal Decoupling via Generation Inequality

evidence: Abstract: 'ADU achieves the strongest aggregate performance among evaluated baselines on the TOFU and WMDP benchmarks, including a Forget Quality of 0.93 on TOFU. It preserves 87–98% of model utility (92.9% on average versus 81.9% for baselines)'
Table 1: On Llama3.1-8B-Instruct, ADU Bio 27.32 / Cyber 27.97 vs Base 71.86 / 45.37, with MMLU 62.84 and GSM8K 58.82 retained; best or near-best across seven baselines

Table 5 (Discussions, Path-specific causal validation): 'Base − Selected C̃e' lowers WMDP Avg from 58.62 to 36.37 vs 57.09 for cardinality-matched random edges; 'ADU ← Base selected' restores 27.65 to 47.23 vs 28.82 for matched-random replacement, with MMLU shifts of only -0.58/+0.53

Table 4 (Component ablation): removing pathway loss raises WMDP Avg to 47.79 (vs 27.65); removing retain objective drops MMLU to 56.32 and GSM8K to 52.10; random heads degrade both forgetting and retention

Robustness Analysis (Fig. 5): six attacks grouped into prompt scaffolding (few-shot, masking, role-play CoT) and adaptive recovery (anchor shift, multi-turn probing, repeated sampling); ADU has the smallest increase and lowest final accuracy under adaptive recovery

Method section: LoRA adapters update W_Q, W_K, W_V, W_O in layers containing selected global heads; head partition computed once with ρ=0.3 and fixed; defaults q=0.4, α=0.3 from Fig. 4 sensitivity analysis
Contributions item 3 states evaluations on 'WMDP, TOFU, and MUSE-Books' while the Experiments section and Table 3 use 'MUSE-Harry Potter' with Llama2-7B — an internal naming inconsistency

Metrics section: fluency 'evaluated by GPT-4o on a 1 to 5 scale' (single-judge, no inter-annotator check reported in provided text); no code-release or artifact-availability statement appears anywhere in the document
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM research with strong preference fit: parameter-level unlearning for LLMs (Llama3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen3-14B, Llama2-7B) intersecting AI safety/privacy (WMDP hazardous-knowledge removal, GDPR motivation), interpretability-style analysis (local/global attention head partition, bidirectional activation exchange for causal mediation), and evaluation robustness. Not a pure domain application, so in scope. Novelty is solid but not maximal: attention-based unlearning exists (ASU suppresses attention to salient tokens), and the contribution is the shift from static token salience to context-specific preplan-anchor retrieval pathways plus a temporal 'generation inequality' characterization. Rigor is good: three benchmarks, seven baselines across three method families, component ablations (Table 4), hyperparameter sensitivity (Fig. 4), and six-attack robustness analysis. Evidence is strengthened by controlled causal interventions (Table 5: Base minus selected edges drops WMDP Avg 58.62→36.37 vs 57.09 matched-random; ADU restored to 47.23 vs 28.82 random), but weakened by conditional theory resting on unverified directional-alignment assumptions, single-judge GPT-4o fluency, an unverified seed-stability claim deferred to Appendix D.4, and an internal inconsistency (contributions/conclusion say 'MUSE-Books' while experiments use MUSE-Harry Potter). Generalizability is moderate: two model families and three task types, but the method presupposes the extended context-rich retrieval regime the authors themselves flag, and requires retain sets and calibration splits. Reproducibility is middling: hyperparameters (ρ=0.3, q=0.4, α=0.3) and appendices A–F are specified, but no code or artifact availability is claimed in the provided text.

primary_link.title: Unlearning Is Not Just Erasing: Temporal Decoupling via Generation Inequality

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) require effective unlearning to address privacy regulations and safety concerns. However, achieving precise forgetting without compromising general utility remains challenging. Existing sequence- and token-level methods penalize target outputs without modeling their context-dependent retrieval paths, which can disrupt linguistic structure or suppress benign knowledge. We present ADU, a fine-grained, training-based framework that shifts unlearning from token erasure t
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討大型語言模型(LLM)的機器遺忘(unlearning)問題:模型須依 GDPR 等規範遺忘敏感或私人內容,同時保留一般能力。既有序列級與 token 級方法只懲罰可見輸出,未建模情境相依的內部檢索路徑,容易破壞語言結構,或在無害情境造成過度遺忘。作者提出「生成不平等」概念:局部注意力頭維持短程依賴,全域注意力頭則在語義轉折的前規劃位置回溯檢索遠處持續被關注的錨點。據此提出 ADU 框架:先在原始模型上定位前規劃—錨點路徑並固定,再訓練注意力投影 adapter 抑制這些路徑的注意力質量,並以保留集語言建模與局部注意力保存損失約束副作用;訓練後以雙向激活交換驗證所選路徑的因果中介角色。實驗顯示,ADU 在 WMDP 上將 Llama3.1-8B-Instruct 的 Bio/Cyber 準確率降至 27.32/27.97,MMLU 與 GSM8K 保留 62.84/58.82;TOFU 遺忘品質達 0.93,平均保留 92.9% 效用(基線 81.9%);MUSE 上 ROUGE-L 最低;面對提示框架與適應性恢復等攻擊仍維持最低敏感準確率。消融實驗證實路徑損失與保留損失缺一不可。限制在於路徑識別依賴注意力且僅在原始模型計算一次,錨點自動建構與殘留知識防護仍待改進。此研究將遺忘從擦除 token 轉為抑制情境化檢索路徑,對隱私合規與安全部署深具意義。
papers.title: Unlearning Is Not Just Erasing: Temporal Decoupling via Generation Inequality
papers.title_zh: 機器遺忘不只是擦除:以生成不平等達成時間解耦

links.title: PILOT in the Loop: Live Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Agents

evidence: Abstract: 'PILOT ranks first in five of six configurations'; 'PILOT gains 14.6 points with GLM-5.1 and 12.4 points with Kimi-K2.6; mean output tokens fall by 42.9% and 47.4%'
Section 3.1 Setup: 'We run each configuration twice and report the mean pass rate across the two runs' — no variance, confidence intervals, or significance tests reported anywhere

Section 3.1 Evaluation settings: one-shot setting uses 'a fresh harness state, isolating whether live steering keeps the worker on track'; self-improvement setting uses verifier outcomes only to retain/discard updates, never to create them

Table 2 / Section 4.2: steering-aided successful runs classified by manual trace inspection at 2.3% (GLM-5.1) and 10.6% (Kimi-K2.6) overall, with a stated inclusion criterion but no inter-annotator agreement or second annotator

Appendix A.1: 'We exclude 43 SWE-bench Multilingual tasks and 198 SWE-bench Pro tasks whose pinned environments cannot bootstrap the JavaScript agent runtimes... We apply the same exclusions to every harness' — lists 'will be released'
Appendix A.3: identical self-improvement instruction prepended for every harness with only harness-native [SKILL_PATH]/[MEMORY_PATH] substitutions — a good control against instruction-induced gains

Limitations: 'Iterative self-improvement repeats every task across many iterations... limits the current evaluation to three benchmarks and two open-weight backbones'; supervisor and worker share the same backbone, heterogeneous pairings 'unexplored'

Section 3.3/Figure 3(b): skill library grows from 62 to 83 (GLM-5.1) and 50 to 81 (Kimi-K2.6) over 20 iterations; Figure 3(c) reports token reductions counting all supervisor and worker assistant turns (honest accounting)
llm_evaluation.rationale: A strongly on-topic agentic-LLM paper: a supervisor-worker harness (PILOT) enabling mid-run 'live steering' plus concurrent harness evolution (skills/memory) over frozen LLM backbones (GLM-5.1, Kimi-K2.6), evaluated on Terminal-Bench 2.0, SWE-bench Multilingual, and SWE-bench Pro. Preference relevance is high (agents, LLMs, coding benchmarks, token-efficiency analysis). Novelty is moderate: the framing of 'live' (mid-execution) correction plus concurrent harness updates is a sensible architectural gap relative to post-hoc self-improvement work (Reflexion, ExpeL, ACE, etc.), but the components (supervisor-worker, skill libraries, memory) are well-trodden. Rigor is decent but limited: fixed backbone across harnesses, identical self-improvement instruction across harnesses (Appendix A.3), uniform task exclusions (Appendix A.1), and two settings that partially decompose steering vs. self-evolution; however, only two runs per configuration with no significance testing, no ablations of the channel mechanics or supervisor design, and manual single-pass classification of steering-aided runs (Table 2, 2.3%/10.6%). Evidence includes concrete tables and two trace-grounded case studies (Figure 4), but gains of 4-5 points on 89 tasks are not statistically supported. Generalizability is constrained to two open-weight backbones and adjacent terminal/SWE domains, acknowledged in Limitations. Reproducibility is moderately good: public GitHub claim, pseudocode (A.2), full instruction text (A.3), exclusion lists promised, though supervisor prompts, skill schemas, and update criteria are underspecified.

primary_link.title: PILOT in the Loop: Live Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Agents

papers.summary: Long-horizon agent runs generate experience that can improve both the current run and future work. Most self-improvement methods process this experience only after execution ends, so they cannot redirect the active run or immediately apply and validate lessons learned from it. We argue that self-improvement should instead be live, using emerging experience both to redirect the active run and to update the persistent harness. Existing agent architectures do not fully support this goal. Single-agent self-correction combines task execution and trajectory assessment within one context, while subagent delegation separates execution but typically cannot redirect an active subagent. We present PILOT, a supervisor-worker harness for live self-improvement through two coupled mechanisms: (1) live steering lets a separate supervisor redirect or abort the active worker during execution; and (2) live self-evolution distils procedures and failure modes revealed during execution into reusable skills and memory. Across two frozen backbones and three benchmarks, PILOT ranks first in five of six configurations. On Terminal-Bench 2.0, PILOT outperforms counterpart harnesses by up to 9.8 percentage points. In the self-improvement setting, PILOT gains 14.6 points with GLM-5.1 and 12.4 points with Kimi-K2.6. Mean output tokens fall by 42.9% and 47.4%, while successful evaluations per million output tokens rise by 110.3% and 134.0%, respectively.
papers.summary_zh: 長程代理在執行任務時產生的經驗,理應能同時改善當前與未來的表現:成功軌跡可沉澱為可重複使用的程序,失敗軌跡則暴露應避免的失敗模式。然而多數自我改進方法只在執行結束後做事後檢視,既無法導正進行中的執行,也無法立即套用並驗證新學到的知識;單一代理自我修正會讓執行與監督在有限的上下文中互相干擾,子代理委派又通常要等執行結束才能取得結果並介入。對此,作者提出 PILOT,一個監督者—工作者(supervisor–worker)框架,以兩個耦合機制實現「即時自我改進」:(1)即時導引(live steering),監督者透過雙向即時通道接收工作者的通知、提問、結果與錯誤警示,並能在執行中導引或中止工作者;(2)即時自我演化(live self-evolution),將執行中浮現的有效程序、專案慣例與失敗模式沉澱為可重複使用的技能庫與記憶。模型參數全程凍結,僅演化持久化的框架狀態。在 GLM-5.1 與 Kimi-K2.6 兩個凍結骨幹及 Terminal-Bench 2.0、SWE-bench Multilingual、SWE-bench Pro 三項基準上,PILOT 於六種組合中的五種排名第一,Terminal-Bench 2.0 最高領先對手 9.8 個百分點;在自我改進設定下,最佳通過率分別提升 14.6 與 12.4 個百分點,平均輸出 token 減少 42.9% 與 47.4%,每百萬輸出 token 的成功評估數增加 110.3% 與 134.0%,技能庫由 62、50 個成長至 83、81 個,且增益在困難任務上最為顯著。限制方面,迭代式自我改進成本高昂,評估僅涵蓋三項基準與兩個開放權重模型;監督者與工作者共用同一模型,異質配對的取捨尚待探索。本文的價值在於將「導正當前執行」與「累積可重用經驗」整合成單一連續迴路,使代理的自我改進能即時發生並跨任務延續。
papers.title: PILOT in the Loop: Live Self-Improvement for Long-Horizon Agents
papers.title_zh: PILOT in the Loop:長程代理的即時自我改進

links.title: IAPO: Influence-Aware Policy Optimization for Credit Assignment in Multi-Turn Service Agents

evidence: Abstract: 'IAPO represents each rollout as a typed influence-dependency graph... Experiments with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B demonstrate superior performance over multi-turn RL baselines across three service-agent benchmarks: τ2-Bench, UserBench, and AgentChangeBench.'

Method/Influence-Dependency Graph: support-use (i→+j) and failed-use (i→-j) edges with necessity/explicit-binding/source-priority acceptance criteria; 'user turns and tool returns provide evidence but never receive advantage.'
Properties, Propositions 1-4: mass conservation Σ A_i,ℓ = L Â_τ, uniform fallback, sign preservation, optimization-interface preservation; 'proofs are in Appendix B.'
Table 1 (8B): IAPO 42.18±2.55 vs GRPO 29.61±3.56 on τ2-Bench; UserBench 24.44 vs 19.83; AgentChangeBench 30.44 vs 26.03; BFCL-MT 39.36 vs 39.04.

Experiments/Experimental Setup: 'train Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B with thinking disabled on 8× NVIDIA H20 GPUs using a verl/FSDP GRPO stack, N=16 samples/prompt, max 30 turns. Dependency annotation uses Qwen3-32B at temperature 0... IAPO defaults: β+=0.05, c=0.25.'
Table 3 (Ablation): β+=0 yields 32.50 τ2 vs 42.18 default; β+=0.1 yields 33.96; c=0.5 yields 42.29 τ2 but UserBench drops to 17.78; Gemma4-31B annotator yields 40.90 τ2.
Annotator Stability: 'Six frozen annotators achieve 100% parse rate... mean edge-typed F1 0.87, source Jaccard 0.84, mean pairwise Cohen's κ=0.83'; m− Spearman ρ=0.96-1.00 (Table 4).
Main Results: 'IAPO lowers macro tool-call redundancy from GRPO's 46.00 to 29.74 (Appendix F)'; routing departs from flat credit ('86.5% of steps move by more than 10% from flat credit, Appendix E').
No code or data release statement appears anywhere in the provided document; only public benchmarks and the MUA-RL checkpoint (re-evaluated) are cited.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent RL methodology, squarely in scope: multi-turn service agents, GRPO-style training, tool use, and function calling (Abstract; Related Work). The core idea—routing a fixed trajectory-level advantage through a within-rollout, LLM-annotated typed influence-dependency graph instead of uniform GRPO credit—is a genuinely distinct angle versus cross-rollout grouping (GiGPO), reset/branch methods, or auxiliary critics (Introduction; Related Work), though influence-based credit assignment has older RL precedents (RUDDER, hindsight). Rigor is solid: a controlled GRPO baseline differing only in the advantage map (Experiments), two model scales, three seeds, OOD benchmarks, hyperparameter and annotator-swap ablations (Table 3), and cross-annotator stability audits (Table 4); proofs of mass conservation and sign preservation are stated (Properties, Appendix B). Deductions: no significance testing, the chosen defaults (β+=0.05, c=0.25) are the sweep optima with notable sensitivity (42.18 vs 33.96 for β+=0.1), and the method's quality hinges on a frozen Qwen3-32B annotator whose extraction rules could bias credit. Evidence strength is good but internal: detailed quantitative tables (Table 1: 42.18±2.55 vs 29.61±3.56 at 8B; Table 5 BFCL retention) with no code/data release statement in the document. Generalizability is supported by training only on τ²-Bench while improving UserBench/AgentChangeBench and flat BFCL (Main Results), but the approach presumes multi-turn interaction with observable tool/schema errors and a capable annotator model. Reproducibility is moderate: stack (verl/FSDP, 8×H20, N=16, temp-0 annotator) and defaults are given with full details claimed in Appendix F, but no artifact availability is stated.

primary_link.title: IAPO: Influence-Aware Policy Optimization for Credit Assignment in Multi-Turn Service Agents

papers.summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly solve long-horizon tasks through multi-turn interactions with users and external tools. In these settings, relevant task information often unfolds over time rather than being fully specified at the initial prompt. Service agents make this challenge especially concrete: users may clarify or revise their goals, while tool responses provide information needed for subsequent decisions. Thus, a final reward alone cannot indicate which actions contributed
papers.summary_zh: 多輪服務代理的任務資訊隨對話逐步浮現：使用者會中途修改目標，工具回傳揭示所需狀態，僅憑最終獎勵難以判斷哪些動作促成任務完成。GRPO 等演算法把軌跡層級優勢平均套用到每個 token，無法區分中間動作的貢獻。論文提出 IAPO（影響感知策略最佳化），將完成的 rollout 表示為以可訓練動作為節點、帶正負號的影響依賴圖：支援使用邊記錄後續動作消費前序動作引出的資訊，失敗使用邊標記可觀察錯誤的傳播與回退；使用者與工具觀察僅作證據、不取得梯度信用。路由權重據此重新分配原軌跡優勢，並具質量守恆、符號保持與均勻回退等保證。實驗以 Qwen3-4B 與 Qwen3-8B 在 τ²-Bench 訓練，並於 τ²-Bench、UserBench 與 AgentChangeBench 驗證：8B 模型於 τ²-Bench 由 29.61% 提升至 42.18%，電信領域增益達 +18.19 個百分點，並優於 GRPO、GiGPO 與 InfoPO，BFCL-v4 Multi-Turn 的函式呼叫能力亦維持不變；消融實驗亦顯示兩類訊號皆有貢獻、標註模型可替換。限制在於依賴凍結標註模型（Qwen3-32B）抽取依賴圖，標註品質與超參數 β+、c 的設定影響成效，且驗證集中在服務型任務。此研究顯示，rollout 內已實現的依賴結構是稀疏獎勵下細粒度功勞分配的實用來源。

links.title: CatchBench: When Can an Agent Failure Be Caught?

evidence: Abstract: 'The release scores 72 entrants, from rule scanners and structural models to eleven LLM judges across nine model families (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Gemma, Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral, Nova), over 1187 declared configurations and 1162 recorded runs.'

Section 3.3: 'Sixteen comparison families are declared before scoring, and the contrasts inside each are adjusted by Holm's step-down procedure... all 118 reported contrasts are regenerated from the committed predictions.'
Section 5.4: 'The auditable lift over size (flat) is +0.141 on SWE-Gym (0.804 against 0.663). This is the paper's only effect that survives multiplicity correction.'

Section 4.3 Bar Verdicts: 'File-level Gold passes item 1... fails item 2... Named-value Gold v2 leaves items 1 to 3 undetermined... Thus both substrates remain mechanism diagnostics and carry no evidential weight.'

Appendix D.1: 'The injecagent harvester writes each roster as the user tool followed by the attacker tools... A rule that reads nothing but position... scores 1.000 F1 there' — a construction leak in the authors' own PRE corpus.
Reproducibility Statement: 'The scored board calls no model service: it reads committed prediction caches, so a third party reproduces every number in this paper without an API key.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-topic: a benchmark for auditing LLM-agent failures scored across PRE/LIVE/POST information states, entrants include 11 LLM judges (GPT, Claude, Gemini, Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, etc.), directly matching top-weight preferences for agents/tool use, LLMs, and LLM-as-judge evaluation. Novelty is solid rather than fundamental: the evidence-budget axis (three information states under one task-method interface) and a five-item admissibility bar for injected faults are new for agent auditing (Table 1 shows no prior benchmark covers all three states), but the fixed-data/many-method arena contract is inherited from ADBench/BOND. Rigor is exceptional: 16 pre-declared comparison families, 118 Holm-corrected paired contrasts, per-board floors, seed-stability analyses, and honest separation of 'separates' from 'unresolved' (47/118). The paper even documents and repairs its own harness defects (PyGOD batching bug, judge parser bug, injecagent declaration-order leak). Evidence is strong and internally consistent, with the headline SWE-Gym structural gain (+0.141 ROC-AUC, Section 5.4) the only effect surviving correction, and GPT-5.5's localization lead (0.452 vs 0.211) cleanly established; caveats include single-pass judge generations and small corpora that leave many contrasts unresolved. Generalizability is limited by domain split: structural signal holds on SWE-Gym but tau-bench remains an acknowledged open problem, and all three Gold-derived boards ship only as mechanism diagnostics after failing the authors' own admissibility bar. Reproducibility is outstanding: public repo, committed prediction caches allowing API-free rescoring, pinned corpus commits, CI checks, and documented PII redaction, though raw upstream traces must be fetched and judge regeneration needs credentials.

primary_link.title: CatchBench: When Can an Agent Failure Be Caught?

papers.summary: When can an agent failure be caught? An audit is usually limited by the record rather than by the method. CatchBench therefore puts one auditor's question to three information states: the declared configuration before a run (PRE), a growing prefix of its trace (LIVE), and the finished trace (POST). Prior benchmarks fix one of these states or vary the telemetry; to our knowledge none scores all three under one task-method interface. Each state admits different questions, so seven task contracts c
papers.summary_zh: 本論文提出 CatchBench，是首個在單一任務—方法介面下，跨三種資訊狀態評測 AI 代理稽核方法的基準：執行前的宣告設定（PRE）、執行中的軌跡前綴（LIVE）與執行後的完整軌跡（POST）。作者主張稽核成效受限於紀錄本身而非方法，故設計七項任務契約，涵蓋過度授權稽核、失敗早期預警、線上錯誤偵測、步驟定位、失敗偵測與原因歸因，形成九個計分板，收錄 1187 個宣告設定與 1162 筆執行紀錄，評測 72 個方法，包括規則掃描器、結構化偵測器與九個模型家族的十一個 LLM 評審。主要結果：118 個預先宣告的比較僅 47 個在 Holm 校正後可分離；GPT-5.5 在 Who&When 定位任務以 Top-1 0.452 領先所有非 LLM 方法；SWE-Gym 失敗偵測的結構特徵效應（0.804 對 0.663）是唯一通過校正者，而 tau-bench 的早期預警始終低於 0.70 警戒線。論文也揭露自身資料的缺陷：某語料來源保留宣告順位，一條只看位置的規則即達完美 F1，顯示分數反映語料建構方式而非推理能力；注入式 Gold 資料因留下可被偵測的建造痕跡，未通過五項可採納性檢驗，三個 Gold 計分板僅列為機制診斷。限制包括多數比較無法解析、標籤流程異質且部分仰賴 LLM 判讀、遺失接地與線上過期狀態偵測等問題仍未解。其價值在於證明基準分數須先公開標籤產生流程並檢驗捷徑才可解讀，並以預先宣告、無需模型呼叫即可重現的統計契約，取代單一排行榜式的結論。

links.title: Training Agents to Evolve with Their Harness: TaoLive Digital Avatar Agent Technical Report

evidence: Abstract/Section 5.2 Table 3: HAT reaches 94.8 AVG on T1 vs base 80.3 and best top model 93.0; Fixed-Harness SFT drops IFE-P to 73.8 (-7.7) while HAT achieves 83.5.
Section 5.3 Table 4: ablation crosses HSA at SFT and RL; non-augmented RL drops Prompt Robustness 72.6→66.7 whereas HSA-RL raises 77.1→77.6, supporting the HSA claim.
Appendix C.4 Table 14: paired bootstrap shows Ours−Fixed-SFT IFE-P +8.50 [4.44,12.38] but Ours−Base +2.03 [-1.11,+5.18] with P_boot=0.1134, i.e., general-capability gain over base not significant.
Appendix B.4/Figure 9: judge calibration on n=482 human labels; effectiveness agreement peaks at 83.40% and selected panel at 82.2%, so headline Accuracy/Effectiveness rest on an imperfect proxy.

Section 5.5 Tables 5/7: single H20 with MTP gives P95 8.114s at C=1 (1.69× decode speedup, 100% ≤15s attainment); speedup degrades to 1.27×/1.19× at C=4-8, honestly scoped as low-concurrency optimization.
Section 5.7 Table 8: human blind test on 100 requests, Harness preferred 35 vs ReAct 1 (binomial p<0.001), with 64 ties.
Section 5.8 Table 10: A/B with 1,581,494 control and 395,276 treatment UVs shows GMV +4.3340% and IPV +0.9107%; significance is the platform's assessment without exposed test, thresholds, or CIs.
Section 5.1 and Appendix C: training data are 10K proprietary live-room SFT examples and 4K RL tasks with no code, data, or checkpoint release, limiting reproducibility.
Section 5.6: held-out harness edits cut error counts by 51.7% for HAT vs 18.1% for Fixed-Harness SFT on 1,000 held-out real-traffic cases.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An industrial LLM-agent technical report squarely within preferred topics (agents/tool use, agentic RL, distillation, prompting, serving). Core methodological idea—Harness-State Augmentation placing harness variation (skills, tools, prompts, hooks) into the training distribution to prevent surface-form overfitting—is a sensible, moderately novel framing that mostly composes known techniques (teacher-rejection SFT, on-policy distillation, GRPO/GDPO/GSPO). Rigor is above average for a tech report: stage-wise ablations (Table 4), judge calibration against 482 human labels (Appendix B.4), paired bootstrap (Table 14), a 100-request human blind test with binomial test, and a ~1.98M-UV online A/B test. Evidence is strong but self-referential: headline quality scores come from the authors' own LLM-judge panel with ~82-90% human agreement, two of four sets are synthetic/LLM-generated, and the IFEval gain over base (+2.03, CI [-1.11,+5.18], P_boot=0.1134) is honestly reported as not significant; A/B significance is reproduced from the platform without test details. Generalizability is claimed via a general formulation but all evaluation is Taobao live-commerce; the method plausibly transfers to any evolvable-harness agent. Reproducibility is low: no code/data release, proprietary live-room data, internal simulator and harness inventory, unreleased future-model checkpoints. Not a pure domain application since the training methodology is the contribution.

primary_link.title: Training Agents to Evolve with Their Harness: TaoLive Digital Avatar Agent Technical Report

papers.summary: AI-powered digital avatar streamers must answer product questions, engage viewers, and execute marketing strategies in real time, demanding low latency, frequent strategy updates, and accurate yet effective responses. Evolvable Harnesses, whose Skills, Hooks, prompts, and tools can be updated independently of model weights, enable rapid iteration but expose a trade-off: large models adapt zero-shot yet are too slow, whereas compact models meet latency targets but overfit to fixed Harness configurations. We propose Harness-Aware Training (HAT), which trains compact models to adapt to changing Harnesses. Its key component, Harness-State Augmentation (HSA), applies task-preserving transformations to Skill identifiers and content, tool schemas, prompt structures, and Hook functions. Training proceeds in three stages: HSA-SFT learns reasoning and tool use from strong-model trajectories across diverse environments; General On-Policy Distillation restores generalization lost during SFT; and HSA-RL improves robustness to changing Harnesses through reinforcement learning in augmented environments. Across four evaluation sets, HAT achieves 94.8 on Live-Stream QA (base: 80.3; strongest general LLM: 93.0) and 94.6 on Harness-Variant QA (base: 75.4). Unlike Fixed-Harness SFT, which lowers IFEval by 7.7 points from the base model, HAT avoids this regression and reaches 83.5. On one NVIDIA H20 GPU, the optimized system delivers P50 and P95 latencies of 3.4 s and 8.1 s. Deployed in Taobao Live's digital-avatar service, it also yields positive online A/B test results for GMV and item-page views.
papers.summary_zh: 此報告探討淘寶直播數位虛擬主播代理的訓練難題:即時電商要求超低延遲、策略頻繁更新,回覆又須準確。團隊採用可演化的 Harness 架構,將 Skills、Hooks、系統提示與工具註冊表同凍結的模型權重解耦,業務行為免重訓即可調整;但僅以單一組態做 SFT,輕量模型會對技能與工具名稱、提示模板產生表面形式過擬合,IFEval 掉了7.7分。作者提出 Harness-Aware Training(HAT),以 Harness-State Augmentation(HSA)對技能識別與內容、工具定義、系統提示及 Hook 施加保留語意的擾動,並採三階段訓練:HSA-SFT 由教師模型在多樣 Harness 環境產生軌跡;General OPD 以基礎模型做 on-policy 蒸餾,恢復通用指令遵循;HSA-RL 在模擬直播環境以 GRPO 與 GDPO 做強化學習。訓練後的 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 在 Live-Stream QA 達94.8分、Harness-Variant QA 達94.6分,IFEval 保住83.5分而未退化;單張 NVIDIA H20 開啟 MTP 後 P50 延遲3.4秒、P95約8.1秒,請求全數於15秒內完成;線上 A/B 測試確認收貨 GMV 較 ReAct 提升4.33%、商品頁瀏覽提升0.91%。限制為評測集與模擬器多源自自有業務資料且依賴內部評審,MTP 加速僅限低併發,訓練動態屬單次運行診斷。本研究示範讓輕量模型理解當前 Harness 而非背誦固定版本,兼顧延遲、適應性與通用能力,對快速迭代的生產級代理系統深具參考價值。

links.title: Decomposition Attacks Across Unlinkable Identities: Limits of Stateful Defenses for LLM Services

evidence: Abstract: reports experiments on 91 executable tasks and 11,393 capability-matched benign requests; all ten tested policies fail to stop attacks or exceed budgets; attack success >=99% after one attempt and 100% after two on defense-unseen families.

Section 4, Theorems 1-2 and Propositions 2-3: exact one-attempt frontier ASR*(B)=max{0,1-B/D} and finite-retry frontier, plus non-identification of off-service pooling from the request trace; proofs in Appendix A.1-A.5.

Section 5.1: dataset construction from 500 synthetic cyber tasks -> 491 screened -> 262 qualified -> 91-task common support cohort with 365 operations and 11,393 certified matched controls; frozen family splits for training, adaptation, calibration, and evaluation.
Section 6.1 and Appendix B.17: independent causal replay reproduces the analytic frontiers within frozen Monte Carlo tolerance (65,000 cells), with LP agreement to 5.69e-14.

Section 7.2, Table 2: on the main evaluation split the best admissible realizable defense (M5) reaches 97.64% ASR under 1% MCD/0.5% BBR caps; methods with lower ASR (M1, M6, M8) exceed the matched-control cap.

Section 7.3 and Appendix B.4: Thompson sampling using only Allow/Block bits reaches 99.4% ASR vs 47.2% for a fixed profile across 3,072 cells; one certified retry raises M1 from 8.75% to 98.75% ASR in the positive control (Table 4).

Section 8 and Appendix B.18: acknowledged limitations include synthetic cyber-only tasks, shared construction prefix (removed in B.12 ablation), mutable DeepSeek API aliases observed on a single date, and main-split in-distribution design; conclusions framed as conditional mechanism evidence.

Appendix B.3 and B.17: pinned model revisions (hashes), exact prompts and thresholds, seeds for resampling, and a portable result inventory with identifiers and hashes support reproducibility, though the capability bank is described as gated for reviewers.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A strong LLM-safety paper squarely on preference: it formalizes decomposition (multi-request) attacks against stateful defenses for LLM services under unlinkable identities, proves exact security-utility frontiers (Theorems 1-2, Propositions 1-3), builds an executable benchmark (91 tasks, 365 operations, 11,393 capability-matched controls, 1.5M background requests), and evaluates 8 realizable defenses plus a privileged steelman and a coalition-aware oracle. Novelty is high: the hidden access-coalition threat model, balanced recoloring protocol, and impossibility-style frontier results go beyond TwinGate/DecomposedHarm/Paranoid Monitors. Rigor is exceptional: theory replayed to numerical precision (Section 6.1, Appendix B.17), calibration/test family splits, an 11-family defense-unseen outer cohort, positive controls (Section 7.3, Table 4), construction-prefix ablation (Section 7.1, B.12), generator-provenance analysis (B.10-B.11), budget sweeps and threshold re-solving (B.8, B.13), and honest cap-overrun reporting (Tables 2, 10, 12). Evidence is strong but domain-limited: only synthetic cyber-programming tasks, a single attacker/judge model family (Qwen 3.5), and mutable DeepSeek API alias screens are acknowledged limitations (Section 8, B.18), and the main evaluation split is in-distribution by construction. Generalizability of the theoretical claim is broad within the stated observation boundary, but empirical transfer is only mechanism-level. Reproducibility is very strong on paper: pinned model revisions, seeds, prompts, thresholds, and a result inventory (B.3, B.17), though availability appears gated rather than fully public. No unsupported claims detected; the key numbers (97.64% best admissible ASR on main split, >=99.43% at highest outer density, 99.4% Thompson-sampling ASR) are consistently reported with intervals.

primary_link.title: Decomposition Attacks Across Unlinkable Identities: Limits of Stateful Defenses for LLM Services

papers.summary: Most large language model services use stateless defenses, which judge only the current request, to refuse harmful tasks. Decomposition attacks exploit this limitation by splitting a harmful task into individually permissible requests and combining their answers. Defending against them therefore requires a stateful monitor that considers requests together. If it can group all requests for one attacker task, it can stop the attack. However, attackers can use unlinkable identities and combine answ
papers.summary_zh: 本文研究大型語言模型（LLM）服務對分解式攻擊的防禦極限。此類攻擊將有害任務拆成個別看似無害的子請求，分別送出後於服務外合併答案；多數服務僅依當前請求判斷的無狀態防禦因此失效。理論上，有狀態監控若能將同一攻擊的所有請求正確分組並累積其能力即可阻斷任務，但攻擊者可透過服務無法連結的全新身分送出請求，使分組訊號失效。作者建立區分「可連結群組」與「存取聯盟」的威脅模型，並證明在此觀測邊界內，理想防禦者的安全與效用權衡前緣完全由良性請求的分組結構決定：良性請求重複出現於可辨識群組時防禦可行；若攻擊與良性請求皆使用不可區分的新群組，加強防護必然增加誤擋，且當攻擊者可重試並觀察 Allow/Block 回饋時，有利的操作點隨之消失。實驗以 91 個可執行任務、365 項操作與 11,393 個能力相符的良性請求驗證理論：在 1% 良性誤擋與 0.5% 背景誤擋上限下，十種受測政策（含具備精確請求—操作對應的特權基準）不是擋不住攻擊就是超出預算；在防禦未見的任務家族上，一次嘗試攻擊成功率至少 99%，兩次後達 100%；僅憑二元回饋的 Thompson sampling 攻擊者可達 99.4% ASR。研究受限於合成網路程式設計任務與僅觀察請求的通道，未涵蓋能存取回應或工具證據的系統。其意義在於指出：有效防禦需仰賴可靠身分連結、新身分成本或範圍限定授權等獨立證據，且安全評估應揭露狀態累積單位與良性對照設計。

links.title: Left-Branching Transformers Excel at Right-Branching Languages: Data Shapes Word Order Preferences in Language Models

evidence: Abstract: 'We systematically compare word order preferences in decoder-only language models across 192 artificial languages and typologically diverse natural languages'; models 'exhibit a left-branching preference' on artificial languages but an SVO advantage on natural languages at scale, establishing data-driven bias.

Section 5.2, Table 1: SVO-SOV gap absent at 5 MB (Mann-Whitney U=353, p=.99) and large at 1 GB (Cliff's delta=-0.76, U=84, p<10^-5), with the same 68 languages compared across all four training sizes so the shift is attributable to data volume.

Section A.5, Table 6: the is_SOV x size interaction survives all covariate controls (beta +0.049 to +0.038, p<=.001) including morphological complexity (subword MATTR), resourcedness, and OSCAR web-crawl share, plus a maximal random-effects robustness refit.

Section 5.2, Table 2 and footnotes 11-13: SVO advantage extends to mGPT and XGLM but reverses in BLOOM because 21 of 28 SVO languages are very-low-resource Niger-Congo (median 1.7 MB vs 3.7 GB), supporting the resource/data-quality explanation.

Section 4.1 and Appendix A.1: 192 grammars x 10 disjoint splits trained per data size (~252 A100 GPU-hours), full hyperparameters in Table 3, plus a unigram-tokenizer re-run of all 192 models (Spearman rho=0.94 at 5 MB) confirming results are not tokenizer-driven.

Limitations section: admits GPT-2-only architecture, written formal/translated corpora (FLORES-200, PUD; translationese risk), coarse data-quality proxy, and categorical WALS word-order labels as constraints on generalization.
Title page: 'Code and data are available at https://github.com/kleines-gespenst/word-order-preferences'; Appendix A.7 documents licensing for all artefacts.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core decoder-only LM/transformer analysis (GPT-2, Goldfish, mGPT, BLOOM, XGLM) squarely matching the highest-weight LLM, transformer, and NLP preferences, though it does not touch reasoning, agents, RAG, or prompting. Methodologically strong: 192 artificial languages x 10 splits x 2 data sizes, matched architectures across artificial/natural settings, Holm-Bonferroni corrections, mixed-effects models with morphological/resource/data-composition covariates, script-confound subset checks, PUD replication, and a tokenizer robustness re-run. The central claim (word order preference is data-driven, SVO advantage emerging with data scale) is supported by quantified effects (Cliff's delta -0.76 at 1GB, is_SOV x size beta surviving all controls) and the homogenisation risk is carefully framed as a precondition rather than an overclaimed result. Novelty is good but partly incremental over White & Cotterell (2021), whose left-branching finding is corroborated rather than overturned; the artificial+natural unification and scaling analysis are the genuinely new contributions. Generalizability is limited by small (20.6M) models, written/translated evaluation text, and no frontier-model validation, which the Limitations section transparently acknowledges. Code, data, hyperparameters, compute cost, and licensing are all provided, making the work highly reproducible.

On artificial languages, models exhibit a left-branching preference that aligns with neither natural language universals nor human word order learning biases. On natural languages, monolingual models show no clear base word order bias at small scales, but as data grows, a preference for right-branching subject-verb-object (SVO) languages em
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討語言模型是否對語序有系統性偏好,以及這些偏好源自架構本身還是訓練資料。作者結合兩條研究路線:一是在192種人工語言(6種S/V/O基本語序搭配32種內部成分排列)上訓練GPT-2風格的解碼器模型;二是評估訓練資料量從5MB到1GB的單語Goldfish模型,以及mGPT、BLOOM、XGLM等多語模型,涵蓋類型多樣的自然語言,以困惑度與BPEC(每英文字元位元數)等指標衡量建模難度。結果顯示,在人工語言上模型一致偏好左分支配置,既不符合跨語言的語序共性,也與人類學習者的和諧偏好相左;在自然語言上,小資料量時未見明顯偏好,但資料規模擴大後,SVO語言變得最容易建模,SOV語言儘管是跨語言最常見的語序反而落後,且此SVO優勢延伸到多語模型,並與語言資源等級及資料品質相關,而非語序本身。同一架構在兩種設定下呈現相反偏好,證明實際觀察到的語序偏好是資料驅動的。作者也討論限制:實驗限於GPT-2架構與書面正式語料,類型學資料庫的二分標籤可能掩蓋漸變的語序變異,資料品質也只能以粗略代理指標衡量。由於高資源語言絕大多數為SVO,這種偏好在LLM普及下可能導致「靜默類型同質化」,逐漸侵蝕語序多樣性,因此透過資料策展可望緩解此風險,對多語言NLP的公平性具重要意義。
papers.title: Left-Branching Transformers Excel at Right-Branching Languages: Data Shapes Word Order Preferences in Language Models
papers.title_zh: 左分支Transformer擅長右分支語言:資料形塑語言模型中的語序偏好

links.title: From Inertia to Objectivity: Improving Deep Research Agents with Noise Isolation

evidence: Abstract: NIS-Agent achieves competitive performance while reducing token cost by 33% vs the smolagents DR baseline; code publicly available at github.com/PangSMPang/NIS-Agent
Section 3.2 / Appendix A.4: IBIS construction — 1,016 LLM-generated candidates filtered to 712, human annotation retains 245 Should Re-search + 209 Should Visit Page samples, Fleiss' kappa = 0.684
Section 6.2: switching Agentic to Observer Mode improves Should Re-search accuracy ~15–30% across models; GPT-4o collapses to 4.08% in Agentic Mode (Appendix B.1 Table 7)
Appendix A.5: paired flip analysis — 91.9% of flips point toward the inertia direction; 18 surface features fail to predict flips (AUC 0.498 direction, 0.492 occurrence)
Section 6.4 Table 4: GAIA/GPT-4o ablation — full NIS-Agent 61.82 vs w/o Filter 59.39 vs w/o Validation 56.96; Table 3: total tokens 219.8k → 147.3k (−33.0%)
Table 5: validation module transfers to math reasoning — AIME 2025 GPT-4.1 improves 35.3 → 68.7 vs CoT validation
Section 5 + Appendix D: NIS-8B trained on Qwen3-8B via SFT (4,293 examples) then GRPO (9,964 examples) with offline rubric generation (Claude Sonnet 4) and cheap online judge (qwen3-max)
Section 8 Limitations: no mechanistic investigation of the bias; generalization beyond information seeking and math is speculative; isolation filters can mistakenly discard relevant pages
Appendix C.4.2: full WebWalkerQA (680 queries) run with Claude-3.7-Sonnet yields 69.26% vs 68.50% on the 200-query subset, supporting subset reliability
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent research: diagnoses a newly named agentic failure mode ('inertia bias'), builds a controlled diagnostic benchmark (IBIS), proposes context-isolation interventions (NIS-Agent), and trains an 8B model via SFT+GRPO to internalize resistance. Hits high-weight preferences squarely (Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Reasoning, RL/alignment, evaluation/benchmarks, RAG/grounding). Novelty is solid but context isolation/pruning is a known tool family; the contribution is the targeted debiasing framing plus controlled Agentic-vs-Observer measurement. Rigor is above average: paired conditions, Fleiss' kappa 0.684, ablations, token-cost analysis, AIME transfer, a subset-reliability check on full WebWalkerQA, and a paired flip analysis (AUC ~0.50 on surface features) that preempts the main confound. Evidence is strong across multiple benchmarks and backbones, though some baselines are self-reproduced, the noise analysis is manual and small-scale, and the 'inertia bias' construct is distinguished from confirmation bias mainly conceptually. Honest limitations (no mechanistic account, unverified generalization to other agent domains, isolation can discard relevant pages). Code release and detailed training/evaluation protocols support reproducibility, with some dependence on proprietary judges/teachers.

primary_link.title: From Inertia to Objectivity: Improving Deep Research Agents with Noise Isolation

papers.summary: Web search agents powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) show strong promise, but deep research tasks expose a recurring failure mode: once an agent has produced a query, plan, or intermediate conclusion, it becomes less objective when later judging the consequences of that same action. We term this phenomenon inertia bias. To make it measurable, we introduce the IBIS benchmark, which controls the search observations while varying whether the model is evaluating the outcome of its own prior act
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討 LLM 網路搜尋代理在深度研究任務中的系統性失敗機制:慣性偏誤(inertia bias)。一旦代理產生查詢、計畫或中間結論,之後評估該行動後果時便失去客觀性,傾向強化自己先前的選擇。作者建立 IBIS 基準,在相同搜尋結果下比較「自己發起行動」(Agentic Mode)與「外部資訊」(Observer Mode)兩種情境,發現模型普遍出現 15% 至 30% 的落差,證實此偏誤普遍存在。此偏誤會在兩個決策點放大雜訊:工作者層級的搜尋雜訊與管理者層級的脈絡雜訊。為此提出 NIS-Agent,於網頁篩選與答案驗證兩個脆弱環節導入情境隔離,使判斷脫離代理自身的行動歷史:過濾模組僅依任務狀態評估網頁並適時改寫查詢,驗證模組則重組推理鏈、逐項檢驗推論。在 GAIA、WebWalkerQA 等基準上,NIS-Agent 達到開源框架中的最佳表現,於 BrowseComp 亦具競爭力,並節省 33% token 成本;以 SFT 加 GRPO 訓練的 8B 開源模型 NIS-8B,在同框架下平均表現接近 GPT-4o。驗證模組附加於 ReAct 管線亦可大幅提升 AIME 數學推理成績,顯示方法可外推至深度研究之外。限制方面,作者僅將模型視為黑箱,未探究偏誤的機制根源;偏誤是否通用於程式碼或具身代理仍屬推測;隔離與驗證本身可能誤刪相關頁面或背書錯誤結論,高風險場景應保留人工把關。本文為代理系統的自我強化錯誤提供可量測的診斷基準與去偏介入方案,對建構更可靠的研究型代理極具參考價值。
papers.title: From Inertia to Objectivity: Improving Deep Research Agents with Noise Isolation
papers.title_zh: 從慣性到客觀:以雜訊隔離改進深度研究代理人

links.title: Why2Speak: Faithful Reasoning for Abstaining Action Policies

evidence: Abstract: 'Using Qwen3-8B as a hybrid model that can be decoded with or without chain-of-thought reasoning, we compare direct decision policies, reasoning policies, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning' and identifies a capability-auditability tradeoff.

Table 1 (Results): Token-SFT classifier no-think F1 0.620 vs 0.367 in think mode; base Qwen3-8B think 0.536 vs no-think 0.096; RL-accuracy 0.520 and RL-faithfulness 0.549 fail to exceed base think policy.
Results, 'Decision Formation During Reasoning': post-CoT decision probe AUROC 0.976±0.045 vs pre-CoT 0.664±0.034 and TF-IDF text baseline 0.631±0.053; direct classifier decodable pre-CoT at 0.997.
Appendix E, Table 12-13: neutral filler flips 0.403 vs partial reasoning 0.277; filler-controlled base dependence gap +0.126 with McNemar p=7.0e-8, showing raw truncation overstates dependence.
Appendix G, Tables 17-18: dependence gap for accuracy objective changes sign across seeds (+0.046, -0.070, +0.110); between-run variability exceeds differences between reward objectives.
Appendix C.3-C.4: pushed RL run (temperature 1.0, group size 16, 250 iterations) reduced zero-variance groups from ~15/16 to ~3/16 yet held-out macro-F1 plateaued unchanged, ruling out undertraining.
Appendix D: probe validation includes within-family evaluation (D.3), TF-IDF text-only baselines (D.4), nested cross-validation layer selection (D.5), and register-transfer failures (D.6).
Appendix F.2: GPT-5 stated-type classifier validated on n=120 human-labelled traces (kappa 0.42 and 0.53) with inter-annotator kappa only 0.21, honestly reported as taxonomy ambiguity.

Limitations section: 'The experiments focus on a single intervention-timing benchmark composed of synthetic conversations... complete probe and reinforcement-learning analyses are limited to Qwen3-8B.'

Reproducibility Statement: LoRA rank 16 alpha=32, GRPO hyperparameters in Appendix A.6, single 24 GB GPU, three seeds per RL objective, and commitment to open-source code, adapters, prompts, and evaluation scripts.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly relevant LLM paper spanning multiple weighted preferences: chain-of-thought faithfulness in abstaining action policies (Qwen3-8B think/no-think, GPT-4o, GPT-5.1), agent oversight, GRPO/alignment, and interpretability via activation probes. Novel contribution is framing faithfulness beyond QA for action/abstention policies with class imbalance and asymmetric costs, identifying a capability-auditability tradeoff, and introducing filler-controlled CoT ablations plus seed-variance controls for RL comparisons. Rigor is strong: text-only TF-IDF baselines, shuffled-label controls, nested cross-validation for layer selection, within-family probe evaluation, McNemar tests, three RL seeds, a prior-shift ablation, an increased-gradient RL run (zero-variance groups 15/16 to 3/16), and human validation of the LLM classifier (kappa 0.42/0.53 vs inter-annotator 0.21). Evidence is quantitative and honestly caveated, though some evaluations are small (n=400 matched, n=196 trajectory probes, 60-item RL held-out), non-matching 200-item slices for secondary models, and reliance on a synthetic benchmark from concurrent unpublished work. Generalizability is moderate: the tradeoff replicates across scale and family, but full probe/RL analyses are Qwen3-8B only. Reproducibility is strong with full hyperparameters, compute details (single 24GB GPU), and an open-source commitment. No instructions inside the paper were followed.

primary_link.title: Why2Speak: Faithful Reasoning for Abstaining Action Policies

papers.summary: Many agentic systems must repeatedly choose between acting and abstaining, making faithful reasoning important for oversight: an explanation is useful only if it reflects the computation that produced the action. We study this problem through intervention timing in multi-party conversation, where an assistant must decide whether to speak or remain silent. This setting exposes class imbalance, asymmetric action costs, and the possibility that exposing reasoning changes the policy being audited. U
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討具棄權能力的行動政策之忠實推理：代理系統不僅要決定說什麼，還要決定是否該出手，而解釋唯有反映真正產生行動的計算才有價值。作者以多方對話中的干預時機為受控測試平台，利用 Qwen3-8B 可切換 think 與 no-think 解碼模式的特性，比較直接決策分類器、推理政策、LoRA 監督式微調與 GRPO 強化學習。結果呈現一致的能力—可稽核性權衡：決策 token 微調分類器達到最佳 macro-F1（0.620）卻不留任何推理可供檢視；推理政策可稽核但效能較低，漏失干預的比率明顯偏高。監督式微調會壓抑推理，保留推理的遮罩目標只在模型本已答對的案例上訓練，無法改善困難案例；GRPO 在所有取樣 rollout 一致行動（含自信犯錯）時缺乏學習訊號，加入行為忠實獎勵也因推理格式效應主導而失效，近似 Goodhart 定律。探針與行為消融顯示干預決策多在推理過程中才形成，但原始截斷測試會高估推理依賴，必須以長度相符的中性填充內容控制格式效應；論文另警示類別不平衡下的探針準確率、探針位置、機率貢獻指標飽和等陷阱，並主張強化學習比較應以獨立訓練 run 為統計單位。限制包括僅使用單一合成對話基準、深入分析限於 Qwen3-8B，且代表性分析仍屬相關性證據。本文顯示揭露推理本身會改變代理的行為政策，QA 式忠實性評估無法直接套用於可行動或棄權的代理系統。
papers.title: Why2Speak: Faithful Reasoning for Abstaining Action Policies
papers.title_zh: Why2Speak：棄權式行動政策的忠實推理

links.title: Inadvertent Context Leakage in Language Models

evidence: Abstract: '2-digit in-context secrets are reconstructed with near-perfect accuracy and 4-digit secrets at 82% exact match, all from outputs the model produces in response to ordinary, non-adversarial requests'
Section 3.1.1: 'Claude Opus sustains 82% exact match and Gemini Pro 44%' at N=4, with adaptive pipeline 'nearly doubles Opus's full-secret recovery over the static templates (82% vs. 44%)'
Appendix B: 'All 160 queries are correctly refused: no model reveals the secret under any baseline prompt', establishing leakage is not trivial disclosure
Appendix E (Randomized controls): decoders trained on shuffled secret labels yield 'advantage is ≤0.02 across all architectures'
Appendix G Table 3: Claude Opus 4.6 digit-stripped embedding decoder reaches 61.3% vs 10% chance while literal digit-frequency decoder is non-significant (16.3%), isolating non-digit channels

Section 4: suppression and leakage 'strongly rank-correlated (Spearman ρ=0.95, exact permutation p=0.0011, n=8)'; OLMo-3-32B-Think channel entropy falls 'from 2.91 bits at Base to 1.37 bits after RLVR'
Section 3.3 / Table 2: SSN Phase 1 68/70 (97.1%) on Claude Opus 4.6 and 62/70 (88.6%) on Gemini 3.1 Pro; direct-request control '0/70' at all context sizes up to 256K tokens

Section 5 (Limitations): 'Open-vocabulary, free-text secrets are a natural next step that we do not attempt here'; 'All eight evaluated models are proprietary'; 'The memory-predicate evaluation covers a single user profile from CIMemories'
Appendix H remark: 'exact match at N=2 spans only the ten held-out secrets and is reported for completeness; per-digit accuracy and channel entropy are the main metrics'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM safety/privacy research squarely matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, agents, AI safety, red teaming, alignment): the paper studies whether in-context secrets leak through statistical channels of benign LLM outputs and attacks production-style agents. Novelty is strong: it claims and credibly supports a new phenomenon—inadvertent, suppression-driven leakage readable by black-box adaptive decoders—distinct from prompt injection, model inversion, and linguistic-judge contextual-integrity benchmarks, including the counterintuitive finding that more emphatic confidentiality instructions increase leakage (Appendix H: Opus per-digit accuracy 0.643 under verbose policy vs 0.054 under terse). Rigor is high: formal predicate-inference game, 8 proprietary models, 1,000 secrets per (model,N) cell, direct-extraction baseline of 0/160 refusals bypassed (Appendix B), shuffled-label controls ≤0.02 advantage (Appendix E), digit-stripped feature decoders isolating non-digit channels (Appendix G: Opus 61.3% vs 10% chance), distractor-specificity 2×2 design (Appendix I), and cost accounting (Appendix J). Evidence is detailed and internally consistent (Section 3.1.1: 100% full-secret at N=2, 82% at N=4 on Opus; Table 2: SSN Phase 1 97.1%/88.6%, direct control 0/70; Section 4: suppression-leakage Spearman ρ=0.95, p=0.0011), though some headline numbers rest on only 10 held-out secrets at N=2 (acknowledged in Appendix H) and the capability correlation is acknowledged fragile at n=8 (Figure 4 caveat). Generalizability is moderate: two predicate families only, no free-text secrets, single user profile for memory predicates, proprietary-model dependence (Section 5). Reproducibility is limited by proprietary APIs, no stated code/data release, single seeds in places, and mid-project model retirement (Grok omission notes in Appendices G-J).

primary_link.title: Inadvertent Context Leakage in Language Models

papers.summary: For AI agents to be useful beyond simple chat, they must hold sensitive user context such as calendars, credentials, health records, and financial data. We study whether the mere presence of such secrets in a model's context window introduces hidden correlations into the model's benign outputs, allowing reconstruction even when the model correctly refuses direct extraction. We further study whether an adversary can actively engineer prompts that amplify this effect, using the model as a covert c
papers.summary_zh: 論文探討：當機密資料（PIN 碼、社會安全號碼、健康紀錄）存在於模型的 context window 時，即使模型在文字上正確拒絕洩漏，其良性輸出的統計特性是否仍隱含足以重建秘密的訊息。作者將此「非預期脈絡洩漏」形式化為謂詞推論賽局，對手僅需黑箱存取，先對公開模型做一次性估計，再訓練針對該模型的解碼器讀出隱藏通道。在八個專有模型上的控制實驗顯示：Claude Opus 4.6 與 Gemini 3.1 Pro 的兩位數秘密可完全重建，四位數達 82% 精確匹配，八位數個位數準確率仍達 41%（隨機基線 10%）；自我抑制程度與洩漏量高度相關（Spearman ρ=0.95），越強調保密指令反而洩漏越多，能力越強的模型洩漏越嚴重，Grok 4.1 Fast 與 GPT-5.4 nano 則構成抗性層級。應用面上，微調分類器可從例行輸出推斷使用者記憶的語意屬性（優勢 0.319，高於語言式評判器的 0.058）；以 GRPO 訓練的提示注入（prompt injection）攻擊利用驚嘆號數量編碼，前置數字成功率達 97.1% 與 88.6%，其餘八位數為 76.5% 與 46.8%。限制包括僅涵蓋數字與二元屬性兩類謂詞、秘密為均勻隨機產生、只評測黑箱情境，且未研究輸出擾動等部署端防護。結論指出對齊訓練與輸出過濾不足以保護 in-context 秘密，個人代理程式的隱私可能需要資訊論層級的保證，且單一解碼器一次訓練即可攤提至全體使用者，構成規模化部署下的系統性隱私風險。

links.title: More Rejective, Not More Discriminative: The Unit of Verification in Pre-Execution LLM Oversight

evidence: Section 4.2 / Table 1: catch rises monotonically 0.765→0.970 while gold-clean FR rises 0.419→0.935; J peaks at L=2 (0.602) and collapses to 0.035 at L=8, with every judge peaking at L∈{1,2} in both domains.

Section 3.3: pre-registered direction-agnostic outcome map (RISING/DECAY/FLAT/INDETERMINATE) with a mandatory clean co-report; score-mode pass (Eq. 4-5) adds threshold-free AUC with per-length recalibration.

Section 4.3 / Appendix M: observation-provision intervention collapses retail FR climb (0.419→0.290 at L=8, slope difference 0.645, CI excludes 0) and recovers J(8) 0.035→0.490; AppWorld loses 38% of slope.

Appendix AF: minimum detectable effects 0.046-0.263 vs observed contrasts 0.075-0.567, design effects 1.00-1.48, and realized rejection rates at nominal 5% of .066/.054/.068 (item bootstrap), indicating calibrated inference.

Appendix AC: SHA-256 freeze manifest, append-only dated amendment chain, archived judgments, and byte-identical re-run of 44/45 analyses; closed judges regenerate from archived verdicts but floating model ids are disclosed as non-reproducible by re-query.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A controlled, pre-registered measurement study of a deployment parameter (the unit of verification) for LLM monitors in agent oversight. Topic alignment is strong with top-weighted preferences: LLM verifiers across six judges, tool-using agent oversight (Agents & Tool Use), AI control/trusted monitoring (AI Safety), and LLM-as-judge evaluation methodology. The twin-prefix framework with matched clean twins and the catch-minus-FR informedness co-report is a genuinely novel instrument, and the core finding (longer windows buy rejection, not discrimination; J peaks at L=1-2 in all six cells) plus the observation-deprivation mechanism via intervention are non-obvious contributions. Rigor is exceptionally high: direction-agnostic frozen outcome map, paired item/cluster bootstraps with exact McNemar, score-mode AUC separating threshold drift from ranking loss, position sweep, inert-padding and predicted-observation controls, three-way defer probe, LoRA-trained monitor control, held-out recipe validation, jackknife, and a power/design-effect appendix. Evidence is strong and quantitatively dense (e.g., catch 0.765→0.970 vs FR 0.419→0.935; J(8) recovery 0.035→0.490 under observation replay), though scoped to non-adaptive injected errors, zero-shot monitors, two domains, L≤8, and a small retail clean set (n=31, disclosed). Reproducibility is outstanding (SHA-256 manifests, archived judgments, append-only amendment chain, byte-identical re-run 44/45), with the disclosed caveat that closed-weight judge ids are floating. Score slightly below the component average reflects that generalizability is deliberately scoped and the subject is a niche oversight parameter rather than a broadly applicable LLM methodology.

primary_link.title: More Rejective, Not More Discriminative: The Unit of Verification in Pre-Execution LLM Oversight

papers.summary: Pre-execution oversight is core to trusted monitoring in AI control: a fallible LLM monitor vets planned actions before irreversible execution. Over-blocking forfeits usefulness and pressures deployers to disable it. Every protocol must fix a unit of verification: how many actions one call reviews. Existing designs take the unit as given; its effect on fallible monitors is unmeasured. Natural traces cannot isolate it: review length co-varies with error type and position. Catch alone misleads: re
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討AI控制中的執行前監督：在工具型代理執行不可逆動作之前，由可能出錯的LLM監控器審核其計畫。每個協定都必須設定「驗證單位」——每次驗證呼叫審核幾個動作，但此參數對易錯監控器的影響從未被量化，自然軌跡又讓長度與錯誤型態混淆，單看偵測率也會誤導。作者提出雙生前綴框架：對每個黃金計畫注入一筆環境可接受的錯誤寫入，配上僅差該筆寫入的乾淨孿生前綴，於五種嵌套長度L∈{1,2,3,5,8}下成對評估，以預註冊的Youden informedness（J=偵測率−誤拒率）計分，並強制同步報告乾淨側誤拒率。在零售與AppWorld兩領域、六個評審模型（Llama-3.3-70B、Qwen2.5-14B/72B、DeepSeek-V4-Pro、Claude Opus 4.8、GPT-5.6 Sol）上，加長視窗雖提升偵測率，誤拒率卻同步攀升，J皆於L=1或2達到峰值；長視窗使零樣本監控器更傾向拒絕，而非更善區分。介入實驗指出主因是觀察剝奪：回放黃金觀察可將零售的J(8)由0.035回升至0.490。僅用短視窗訓練的LoRA監控器無法泛化到長視窗，而任何標籤盲策略（投票、路由、草稿訊號）皆未穩定勝過校準後的固定短單位。限制包括單一非自適應注入錯誤、僅兩領域且L≤8、零售乾淨樣本僅31筆。本文主張安全案例應明示驗證單位並共報乾淨序列，對可信監控的部署極具實務意義。

links.title: MentorPulse: Refreshing Cross-Model Latent Guidance for Long-Form Generation

evidence: Abstract: 'static guidance pushes a 4B student's constraint satisfaction 2.5 points below its no-guidance baseline; a training-free refresh every 16 tokens ... restores a 2.0-point gain over that baseline'

Section 3.2/Table 20: 'OneShot scores 56.2, below the S-only floor of 58.7 by more than twice the pooled standard deviation ... OracleSwap@16 lifts the score to 60.7, 4.5 above OneShot and 2.0 above the floor' with OracleSwap-mis@16 showing no repair
Section 5.2/Table 8: 'MP closes 52.2% of that gap on macro average, ahead of T2T at 26.9%, LoRA at 17.5%, and C2C at 10.9%'; per-dataset scores with mean +/- sd over three seeds
Table 1 (Section 5.3): row 2 'No refresh (R to inf)' drops mean recovery by -41.9; row 3 shows refresh without WRT recovers little; row 7 gates-zeroed reproduces S-only 'bit for bit'
Appendix C.5: 'The three trainable objects (C2C fuser, LoRA adapters, MentorPulse bridge) use the same training set fuse_v3, the same step budget, and the same learning-rate search'
Appendix A.4: 'any difference below 2*sigma_ab is described as comparable rather than better or worse; every claim of significance in the paper passes this threshold'
Appendix H.6: 'billing a resident, dedicated mentor for the full request duration instead of active compute seconds reverses the direction of the cost conclusion ... we report this reversal as is'
Section 5.4/Table 18: 'Recovery tracks V64 (Spearman rho=0.78, p=0.004); ... Three limits apply: eleven pairs are observational evidence'

Section 6/Appendix E.1: limits stated - 'The gains require long outputs (short outputs never refresh ...), basic student capability, and a pair close enough for selective reading'; 'cross-tokenizer pairs are future work'
Appendix A.3: 'Code, evaluation configurations, the data pipeline, per-seed outputs, and the scripts that derive every table in this appendix will be released' (promise, not yet available)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper on cross-model latent guidance between frozen large/small LLMs (Qwen3.5, Gemma-4, Ministral), squarely in scope. Novel contribution: identifies 'guidance staleness' as a failure mode of one-shot cross-model guidance in long-form generation and introduces prefix-conditioned refresh via versioned slot memory, incremental mentor prefill, and Windowed Refresh Training, cleanly differentiated from LLM-to-SLM, C2C, LGR, RefreshKV, and disaggregated serving (Section 2, Table 6). Exceptional experimental discipline: 13 datasets, 11 mentor-student pairs across 3 families, 3 seeds with a 2x-pooled-SD significance rule (Appendix A.4), bit-exact degeneracy checks via zeroed gates (Appendix E.2), matched parameter budgets for LoRA and shared training data/budget for C2C (Appendix C), a disjoint diagnostic suite, and hard-verified identity constraints (Appendix G.5). The causal staleness diagnosis (probe readability decaying 0.79 to 0.47 while fresh stays 0.76-0.80; OracleSwap@16 lifting Multi-IF from 56.2 to 60.7 vs an S-only floor of 58.7, Section 3.2/Table 20) is a strong intervention-based design. Main result (52.2% gap closure vs 26.9% T2T, 17.5% LoRA, 10.9% C2C, Section 5.2/Table 8) and ablations (removing refresh costs -41.9 mean recovery, Table 1) are quantitatively supported. Honest cost accounting includes a sensitivity that reverses its own conclusion (resident mentor billing, Appendix H.6) and acknowledged limits: gains require long outputs and student capability, cross-tokenizer pairs untested, V64 predictor observational (n=11, Section 5.4). Reproducibility is strong on protocol detail (seeds, vLLM 0.19.1, lm-eval-harness 0.4.9, judge GPT-4.1, training pipeline stats) but code and artifacts are only promised for release, and LLM-judged metrics depend on a proprietary judge.

primary_link.title: MentorPulse: Refreshing Cross-Model Latent Guidance for Long-Form Generation

papers.summary: Cross-model latent guidance lets a frozen large mentor encode an input once and a frozen small student generate from the resulting signal. Existing methods keep this signal fixed, assuming it stays useful as the output grows; we show this fails in long-form generation. On multi-turn instruction following, static guidance pushes a 4B student's constraint satisfaction 2.5 points below its no-guidance baseline; a training-free refresh every 16 tokens changes only the memory content and restores a 2
papers.summary_zh: 跨模型潛在引導讓凍結的大型 mentor 模型編碼輸入一次,凍結的小型 student 模型據此生成,但既有方法在解碼前算好引導訊號後便固定不變。本文指出此設計在長文本生成中失效:隨著已生成前綴增長,僅依輸入的靜態引導會過時,使 4B student 在多輪指令遵循任務的約束滿足率比無引導基準低 2.5 分。免訓練診斷證實,每 16 個 token 依前綴重建並替換記憶,即可在不改動 student 權重與 KV cache 的情況下恢復高出基準 2.0 分的增益,顯示問題源自引導「新鮮度」而非能力不足。MentorPulse 據此提出可部署機制:Slot Memory Constructor 將 mentor 狀態壓縮為數量有上限的槽位記憶;student 透過 gated cross-attention 橋接讀取;每 R 個 token 進行增量式 prefill,只處理新 token 並直接替換記憶,不會使 student 的 KV cache 失效;Windowed Refresh Training 則讓橋接學會消化生成中途的記憶更新。在十三個資料集上,MentorPulse 於主配對 Qwen3.5-27B→4B 平均縮小 52.2% 的 mentor–student 差距,優於 T2T、C2C 與同參數量 LoRA,並在三個模型家族共十一組配對全面領先;增益集中於長輸出任務,靜態潛在引導 C2C 在此反而低於 student 基線。預設 R=16 兼顧品質與成本,V64 讀取分佈變異數可在部署前預測配對增益。限制包括:短輸出從不觸發刷新、student 需具備基本能力、能力差距過大的配對增益收窄;學習式刷新觸發與跨 tokenizer 配對仍屬未來工作。整體而言,本文將「引導新鮮度」確立為設計軸線,使大小模型協作在長文本生成中最能發揮價值。

links.title: Model Hypnosis: Strong control of AI via additive subliminal effects

evidence: Abstract: 'individually weak and seemingly irrelevant cues in the prompt can be systematically combined to strongly control model behavior... hypnotic prompts can transfer between models'
Figure 1: meaning-preserving paraphrase flips Qwen3-8B on a trolley question from P(no)=94% to P(yes)=99.93% with identical question text
Section 3.1 / Figure 4: additive log-odds model fit on N=12,000 random configurations per model-cue-effect cell; held-out configuration-level R2 spans 0.3-0.99 with median ~0.75 (Figure 13)
Figure 2: Qwen2.5-14B driven to answer 7 or 5 with probability 0.993 each by changing only animal list contents
Section 3.1 / Figure 8: extreme-prompt steering range is about 10x the random-prompt logit standard deviation

Appendix A.4 / Table 1: reasoning-model pipeline uses disjoint screen (K_scr), confirm (K_conf), and 100-sample report stages to keep reported probabilities unbiased ('would bias the estimate upward (a winner's-curse effect)')
Section 4 / Figure 12: extremizer prompts transfer across 16 non-reasoning models; 'animal cues and some of the phrasing and JSON cues transfer with significantly above chance probability'
Appendix C / Figure 38: exact Fourier decomposition via FWHT shows degree-1 weight 87.3% of variance for Qwen2.5-7B at L=10 (95.2% cumulative with degree-2 for Llama-3.1-8B)
Section 5: safety framing—'no individual cue needs to be influential or suspicious, because a strong effect emerges from many weak contributions'—and admitted limitation of no mechanistic explanation
Page 1 footnote: 'Code and data: github.com/eboix/model_hypnosis'; Appendix E enumerates all 200 animals, 10 paraphrases/slot, 6 typo variants/slot, and 6 JSON values/slot
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM paper squarely aligned with high-weight preferences (LLMs, prompting, AI safety, red-teaming, interpretability): it shows that many individually weak, semantically irrelevant prompt cues (animals, paraphrases, typos, JSON metadata) stack additively on the log-odds scale to deterministically steer model answers, including in frontier reasoning models, and transfer across models. Novelty is solid but incremental over known prompt-sensitivity, subliminal-prompting, and adversarial-suffix work; the additive-composition framework, cross-model transfer, and Fourier interaction analysis are the new contributions. Rigor is unusually careful: N=12,000 random configurations per non-reasoning cell with held-out R2 (median ~0.75), tilt-sweep extrapolation tests, and a fit-then-validate pipeline for reasoning models with disjoint screen/confirm/report samples explicitly guarding against winner's curse. Evidence is strong and quantitative (0.993 probability flips, ~10x random-prompt logit steering range, degree-1 Fourier weight 87.3%). Limitations: binary response effects only, English-only templates, no mechanistic explanation offered, lighter coverage for closed reasoning models. Generalizability is supported by 16 non-reasoning models across families/scales plus API reasoning models and positive transfer; reproducibility is aided by a code/data link and complete cue inventories in Appendix E, though closed-model results require API access.

primary_link.title: Model Hypnosis: Strong control of AI via additive subliminal effects

Model hypnosis occurs across model families and scales, including in frontier reasoning models, and hypnotic prompts can transfer between models. Because the model is controlled by inconspicuous textual choices, such as paraphrases and typos, model hypnosis presents n
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文提出並系統性展示「模型催眠」現象：把許多單獨看極微弱、且與問題語意無關的提示線索同向堆疊，即可近乎完全操控語言模型的答案。作者以提示模板建立四類線索（動物清單、JSON 中繼資料、語意保留改寫、錯字位置），搭配三種二元效果（偏好 5 或 7、電車難題、意識問題），先測量數千個隨機提示組態的答案 log-odds，以嶺迴歸或羅吉斯迴歸擬合可加性模型取得各線索分數，再外推挑選極端同向的組合構造催眠提示。主要證據：可加性模型對保留組態的 R² 中位數約 0.75；極端提示的操縱幅度約為隨機提示 logit 標準差十倍，可把答案機率推向 0 或 1，例如改寫無關故事措辭即可讓 Qwen3-8B 從 94% 答「no」變成 99.93% 答「yes」；效應遍及 Qwen、Gemma、Llama 等非推理模型，也存在於 GPT-5.6、Gemini-3-Flash、Claude Sonnet-5 等推理模型；催眠提示可跨模型轉移；傅立葉分析顯示一階效應佔大宗（Qwen2.5-7B 約 87% 變異）、高階交互作用遞減。限制：可加性僅為近似，JSON 場景的 priority 欄位可能主導效應；初步實驗顯示改寫周遭提示後相對線索效應仍在，偵測與移除催眠文字尚缺有效演算法。其意義在於：這類分散式弱線索可成為代理間隱蔽溝通管道，難以被搜尋少數顯著特徵的可解釋性方法捕捉，對 AI 安全與多代理系統監督構成新挑戰，但也可能反向用於稽核或促進誠實等對齊行為。

links.title: When "Do Not" Is Not Deny: Security Rules in CLAUDE.md vs Built-In Controls

evidence: Abstract & §I: 481 public CLAUDE.md files; only about 4–16% of retrieved security rules have a matching built-in control; strict adjudicated estimate 4.4% [2.6, 6.7]
§IV-B Table II: classifier precision 0.350, recall 1.000 on the matching-control judgment; annotator agreement 96.5% with Cohen's κ=0.89 (match) and 0.77 (security-relevant gate)
§III-E & §VI: blind 50-file audit puts rule-word extraction recall at 66.3% [48.8, 82.0], so rates apply only to retrieved rules
§IV-E Table VI: sampling-frame replication on Agent READMEs corpus gives 25.1% [20.8, 30.0], still a minority; same instrument, not independent confirmation

§III-D & Appendix A: post-hoc audit of frozen control reference found three documentation issues (additionalDirectories reversed, missing sandbox.credentials, imprecise network sandbox) with no label changes reported
Appendix D: releases frozen sampling frames, commit-pinned manifests, seed 20260813, frozen classifier prompt (Claude Sonnet 5), control-reference audit, and analysis scripts
llm_evaluation.rationale: Empirical usable-security measurement of LLM coding-agent instruction files: how often security rules written in CLAUDE.md have a matching built-in Claude Code control. Strongly aligned with Agents & Tool Use and AI Safety preferences (agent permission controls, tool-use enforcement, guardrails, agent misbehavior context), with secondary fit to Code & Programming and LLM topics; not a pure domain application. The research question (coverage of developer-written security rules by existing controls) is genuinely new relative to Agent READMEs, Cursorrules, ContextCov/Prose2Policy, and Michael & Roesner, though the method is standard corpus-mining plus LLM classification with human validation. Rigor is unusually high: stratified 180-item validation with inverse-probability weights, repository-clustered bootstrap CIs, two blind annotators (κ=0.89 match gate, 0.77 security gate) with adjudication, extraction-recall audit, duplication/concentration sensitivities, second-frame replication (25.1%), and a transparent post-hoc audit of the frozen control reference showing no label changes. Evidence is solid but the headline is a wide 4–16% range driven by the matching standard rather than sampling error, classifier precision for matches is low (0.350), and extraction recall (66.3% [48.8, 82.0]) restricts the denominator. Generalizability is honestly bounded to Claude Code at a freeze date and a capped, relevance-ranked GitHub frame; frame B reuses the same instrument. Reproducibility is excellent: frozen frames, commit-pinned manifests, seed, frozen prompt, control reference plus audit CSV, and analysis scripts released.

primary_link.title: When "Do Not" Is Not Deny: Security Rules in CLAUDE.md vs Built-In Controls

papers.summary: In CLAUDE.md, "do not" is a natural-language instruction that the model interprets. Claude Code's deny is a built-in control that blocks an action before the agent can take it. Both can express the same security goal, but they control the agent in different ways. We measure this gap in 481 public CLAUDE.md files. An LLM matched the extracted candidate rules against Claude Code's documented controls, and two security practitioners independently checked a sample without seeing the model's answers
papers.summary_zh: 論文量測一個可用性安全落差：開發者在 CLAUDE.md 以自然語言寫安全規則，但 Claude Code 只有 deny、ask 等 permission rule 與沙箱等內建控制能確定攔阻；兩者形式相同、強制力不同，檔案與工具都不標示何者真有控制支援。作者蒐集 481 個公開 CLAUDE.md，以規則詞抽出 4,661 個候選片段，用 LLM 分類器對照凍結的官方控制清單，判斷各片段是否為安全規則、有無免寫程式碼的內建控制；再由兩位安全實務者盲測 180 個分層樣本，以逆機率加權與儲存庫群集 bootstrap 校正。結果顯示，依配對標準寬嚴不同，僅約 4–16% 的已抽取安全規則有對應控制，最嚴格估計為 4.4%（95% CI：2.6–6.7%），其餘只能靠模型詮釋；破壞性命令與網路出口較常有控制，授權與個人資料最少（此排名屬探索性）。分類器 recall 高但 precision 僅 0.350，常把可比對的命令或路徑誤判為完整涵蓋；兩位標註者對配對判定高度一致（Cohen's κ=0.89）。抽取召回率為 66.3%，比率因此僅適用於被抽出的規則。限制：樣本取自 GitHub 程式碼搜尋、非隨機；研究僅測書面規則與文件記載的控制，未涵蓋團隊以 CI、hooks 等其他方式的防護或執行期可靠性。CLAUDE.md 因此是「只寫不回」的安全通道，對缺乏安全背景的新手風險最大，作者呼籲平台標示規則有無控制支援、把無法強制者列為建議，並使執行可被觀察。
