links.title: Utility Under Attack: Agent Memory Poisoning and the Limits of Content Screening and Provenance Ranking

evidence: Section 6.2 / Table 3: 1.2% poison (360 memories, n=120 questions) drops LongMemEval accuracy 0.850→0.300; write-time screening 'refused 0 of 360 poisoned memories'; poisoned memory ranked #1 for every question.

Section 6.3: shipped weights (wt=0.15) give margin 0.175 vs poison's 0.32 similarity gain; McNemar p=0.80 vs no defense; corrected wt=0.35 imposes 0.245 absolute penalty against 0.45 max semantic term, characterized as 'a hard exclusion filter wearing the costume of a soft one.'

Table 6 (Section 6.3): Corpus M (94% benign untrusted band) accuracy 0.3167→0.7000 (p=1.17e-10) but authors flag windfall from removing distractors; Corpus N (untrusted evidence) accuracy 0.8583→0.0417 with evidence recall 99.17%→0.00% (p=6.31e-30).

Section 6.4 / Table 4: full pipeline reaches 0.832 recall on InjecAgent indirect injection with 0.035 FPR on NotInject vs 42.8% for DeBERTa-based detectors; Table 5 ablation shows Stage 3 injection rules contribute zero on indirect injection (Stage 2 secrets detector fires on credential-shaped exfiltration strings).

Section 7: adaptive-attack sweep pre-registered but 'not complete[d] in time'; single retriever/embedding model/reader; remedy (occupancy gate) 'not implemented or evaluated'; trust labels assumed un-malleable per threat model in Section 2.3.

Appendix A: repo revision 6d2863083361f7a5c8e12b4512346c94cb453c2c, LongMemEval_S revision 2ec2a557 with SHA-256, seed 42 throughout, sha256-keyed completion caching with temperature folded into key, measured $11.22 mixed-provenance arm cost, per-corpus dataset revisions in Table 1.
llm_evaluation.rationale: An agent-security paper squarely within preference scope: LLM agent persistent-memory poisoning, write-time injection screening, and provenance-weighted retrieval, with strong alignment to Agents & Tool Use (2.5), AI Safety (2.0), and Red Teaming & Evaluation (1.8). Rigor is high: paired exact McNemar tests across identical question sets, a mixed-provenance design that explicitly removes the trust-label-as-answer-key confound (Corpus M/N, Section 6.3), per-stage ablation of the screening pipeline (Table 5), bootstrap CIs, and a three-line margin derivation (Equation 2) that explains both the inert shipped default (p=0.80) and the over-correction at wt=0.35. Evidence is internally consistent and quantitative (0.850→0.300 at 1.2% poison, 0/360 screening refusals, Corpus N evidence recall 99.17%→0.00%). Notable honesty: negative result on the authors' own shipped product, limitations ordered by threat, and explicit refusal to claim the proposed occupancy-constraint remedy. Novelty is good but bounded: memory poisoning itself is established (PoisonedRAG, AgentPoison, MINJA, concurrent MPBench); the contributions are the utility-retained metric, the screening-boundary demonstration, and the additive-margin analysis rather than a new attack or defense. Generalizability is the weakest component: one memory system, one retriever/embedder/reader, LongMemEval-S only, non-adaptive attacker, and the authors acknowledge empirical generalization is by argument, not replication (Section 7). Reproducibility is excellent: pinned repo revision, frozen JSON inputs, seeds, completion caching, dataset revisions, and measured $11.22 API cost (Appendix A).

primary_link.title: Utility Under Attack: Agent Memory Poisoning and the Limits of Content Screening and Provenance Ranking

papers.summary: Persistent memory makes false information durable: once a false statement is stored, it can be retrieved into future sessions that match it. We measure the cost of this failure mode using plainly worded false assertions generated in a single pass, with no instruction, trigger, or retriever optimization. Poisoning 1.2% of a LongMemEval corpus reduces accuracy from 0.850 to 0.300. A four-stage write-time screening pipeline that reaches 0.832 recall on indirect prompt injection while flagging 1.5%
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討 LLM 代理程式持久記憶遭投毒攻擊時的效用損失,以及寫入與讀取兩道防線的極限。作者刻意採用最弱攻擊:單次生成、不含指令或觸發詞、也未針對檢索器最佳化的白話錯誤陳述,藉此污染 LongMemEval 語料。僅佔語料 1.2% 的 360 筆毒化記憶,便使準確率從 0.850 跌至 0.300,失去約三分之二的記憶價值。寫入端的四階段內容篩選管線雖在間接提示注入偵測上達 0.832 召回率、誤報率僅 1.5%,卻對 360 筆毒化記憶全部放行;作者論證這是內容篩選類方法的結構性邊界,因為辨識陳述真偽需要文字以外的外部依據。防禦因此落在讀取端的來源加權排序,但結果並不理想:原廠預設權重統計上與無防禦無異(p=0.80);提高權重雖將效用恢復至 56%,卻是靠完全排除而非偏好——其對不可信內容的絕對懲罰超過語意相似度可用範圍的一半。混合來源實驗顯示,當不可信內容多為良性時防禦仍有效(0.3167 升至 0.7000);但當承載答案的證據本身來自不可信通道時,120 題的證據召回全數歸零,準確率跌至 0.0417。作者據此主張,此種加法計分形式下來源項沒有可用設定,應改採有界佔用配額。主要限制包括:攻擊者未做自適應最佳化、僅測單一系統與嵌入模型,且信任標籤可能遭洗白竄改。本文以「保留效用」取代攻擊成功率作為核心指標,並揭露防禦在無攻擊時的代價,對代理記憶安全評估極具參考價值。
papers.title: Utility Under Attack: Agent Memory Poisoning and the Limits of Content Screening and Provenance Ranking
papers.title_zh: 受攻擊下的效用:代理記憶投毒與內容篩選、來源加權排序的極限

links.title: Understanding Evolution Strategies for LLM Reasoning: Broader Reasoning Coverage than GRPO

evidence: Abstract & Section 3.2: ES improves average Pass@1/16/32 over base and exceeds GRPO on Pass@16/32; GRPO falls below base on Pass@16/32 in 15 of 18 Easy-Setting comparisons (Tables 2-3)

Section 3.1 & Appendix A: Lemma 1 gives E[JS]=sigma^2/2(1-1/N)tr(I_x)+O(sigma^4) (Eq. 9); Proposition 1 (Eqs. 12-14) requires an assumed KL transfer-error bound epsilon_succ that is not empirically verified
Section 4.2, Table 4: Full ES relative L2 drift is 40.7-44.1x GRPO; largest ES updates concentrate in LayerNorm/attention parameters while GRPO's top updates sit in embeddings/LM head
Appendix D, Tables 11-12: magnitude-thresholded ES retains Pass@1 with changes of -0.351 to +0.488 points at ~78% update sparsity, degrading only beyond ~92%
Section 5.1, Table 6: N=16 within 0.01 of N=64 reward for 1.5B/3B models but only N=32 for 0.5B at update 300, supporting decreasing population-size needs with scale

Section 5.2 & Appendix E, Table 13: two-point/antithetic subtraction fails to reduce variance for regenerated GSM8K rollouts (kappa_pair 1.99-2.78) though it works for fixed-batch objectives (0.16), explaining one-point preference

Appendix G, Tables 14-17: complete hyperparameters, evaluation settings, prompt templates, dataset provenance/licenses; GitHub repository link given in title-footnote; no seed repetitions or confidence intervals reported for main comparisons
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology work directly matching high-weight preferences (LLM reasoning post-training, GRPO/RL comparison, CoT, scaling/efficiency). Contributions are analytical rather than a new method: theory linking ES population JS diversity to Pass@K, empirical demonstration that ES avoids GRPO-style entropy collapse and Pass@16/32 degradation, functional-sparsity analysis of ES updates, and hyperparameter/scaling study. Theory is correct but partly standard (AM-GM, Pinsker, Fisher expansions) and Proposition 1 relies on a transfer-error condition (Eq. 12) that is stated as testable but not directly measured. Empirics cover 4 models, two settings, held-out suites, and careful estimator diagnostics (Appendix E), but main RL/ES comparisons appear to be single runs with no variance or significance reporting, and some deltas (e.g., +0.07-0.8 points, Table 11) are small. Reproducibility is strong: GitHub link, full hyperparameters (Table 14), evaluation protocol (Table 15), prompts, and dataset licenses. Novelty limited by existing ES-for-LLM work (Qiu et al., ESSA, EGGROLL) that the paper builds on.

primary_link.title: Understanding Evolution Strategies for LLM Reasoning: Broader Reasoning Coverage than GRPO

papers.summary: Evolution Strategies (ES) have recently emerged as a memory-efficient post-training paradigm for LLM reasoning. However, the optimization behavior of ES remains understudied, making it hard to define its advantage scope compared to mainstream post-training paradigms (e.g., Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)). By systematically investigating ES dynamics and mechanisms, this paper first identifies a performance advantage of ES over GRPO, theoretically and empirically showing that ES can lead to broader reasoning coverage, thereby better exploiting the reasoning capabilities of pretrained LLMs. Theoretically, we show that verifier-projected Jensen-Shannon diversity across the ES population is helpful to higher Pass@K performances. Empirically, unlike GRPO, which exhibits entropy collapse, ES improves Pass@1 while attaining higher Pass@K than GRPO. We further develop a sequential GRPO-ES training strategy that combines GRPO's strength in Pass@1 with ES's gains in Pass@K. Second, we find that despite substantial whole-model parameter drift, the task-performance gains of ES are only contributed to a sparse subset of larger-magnitude updates. This functional sparsity suggests that large parameter movement need not imply widespread functional change, and held-out evaluations further show that it does not necessarily lead to catastrophic forgetting. Finally, we study how hyperparameter design affects the effectiveness of ES, demonstrating that ES requires a smaller population size in a larger LLM. These findings position ES as a distinct reasoning post-training paradigm rather than a less effective, memory-efficient alternative to GRPO.
papers.summary_zh: 本論文系統性探討演化策略（Evolution Strategies, ES）作為大型語言模型（LLM）推理後訓練方法的最佳化行為，並與主流方法 GRPO 比較。作者圍繞三個研究問題：ES 是否呈現與 GRPO 相同的後訓練特性、ES 是否必然導致災難性遺忘，以及何種超參數與估計量設計能使 ES 有效且可擴展。理論上，論文證明 ES 群體間的 verifier 投影 Jensen–Shannon 多樣性有助於提升 Pass@K；實證上，與出現熵坍縮、Pass@K 下降的 GRPO 不同，ES 在改善 Pass@1 之餘仍維持較廣的推理覆蓋率，作者並提出 GRPO→ES 與 ES→GRPO 兩種序列混合訓練，兼取 GRPO 的 Pass@1 與 ES 的 Pass@K 優勢。關於遺忘，研究發現 ES 雖造成整體參數大幅漂移（與初始化的距離約為 GRPO 的四十倍），但效能增益主要來自少數幅度較大的更新，集中於 LayerNorm 與注意力參數，展現功能性稀疏性；held-out 評估顯示能力大致保留，大參數位移未必導致災難性遺忘。設計研究進一步指出 z-score 獎勵正規化是關鍵要素，two-point 估計量對推理任務無優勢，且模型越大所需群體規模越小。限制在於理論結果依賴局部近似與傳遞誤差預算等假設，遺忘結論限於特定訓練設定，跨任務持續學習情境仍待驗證。整體而言，本論文將 ES 定位為獨立的推理後訓練典範，而非只是節省 GPU 記憶體的 GRPO 替代方案。
papers.title: Understanding Evolution Strategies for LLM Reasoning: Broader Reasoning Coverage than GRPO
papers.title_zh: 理解演化策略在 LLM 推理中的角色：比 GRPO 更廣的推理覆蓋率

links.title: Candidate supply and answer selection shape the value of LLM judging in multi-agent systems

evidence: Abstract (p.1): combining answer frequency with judge evaluation 'raised accuracy from 63.82% to 70.82-70.95%' by rescuing outnumbered correct answers.
Results (p.4): open committee reached 42.20% accuracy at 10.73x token cost vs 41.06% for majority voting at 4.96x; oracle ceiling exceeded actual accuracy by 13.13-14.38 pp.

Results (p.6): judge rank AUC rises with availability, fitted half-rise midpoint pgen=14.7% (95% CI 14.3-15.1%, R2=0.900) over 15,336 questions, 67,163 pools, 823,988 pairs; fixed-composition 2C/6W control preserves the rise (m=12.2%, R2=0.887).
Results (pp.9-10): rationale-answer swap perturbation reduces rank AUC to 0.482 vs 0.684 unperturbed (+0.173, 95% CI 0.139-0.208) across 713 matched pools.

Results (p.12): first-ranked selection beats majority voting by +13.52 pp at k=2 but -0.34 pp (CI includes zero) at k=16; incremental judging cost escalates from US$0.10 to US$6.28 per 1,000 additional correct answers.

Methods/Software (pp.24-25): analysis code versioned at GitHub (release commit 7840cf3dbde77e61a1b4349ad3239669a7502431) and access-controlled Hugging Face archive with revision hash; seeds reported for all resampling procedures.

Extended Data Table 1 (pp.37-39): per-benchmark fit diagnostics; MuSR combinations frequently flagged low-R2/diagnostic, showing non-universal reliability boundaries across generators, judges, and tasks.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A general LLM-methods paper (not a domain application) squarely aligned with high-weight preferences: multi-agent LLM systems, LLM-as-judge evaluation, reasoning benchmarks, and test-time compute scaling. It decomposes multi-agent accuracy into candidate generation, judge recognition, and terminal selection, showing a 13-14 pp generation-retention gap (Methods, oracle upper bound, p.16) and that hybrid frequency+judge-rank selection lifts accuracy from 63.82% to 70.82-70.95% on 81,390 frozen pools (Abstract, p.1; Results, p.9). Rigor is exceptionally high: fixed-composition 2C/6W controls rule out displayed-ratio confounds (p.6), tie-breaking and odd/even pool-size sensitivities are run (p.12), rationale-answer swap perturbations isolate what the judge reads (+0.173 AUC, pp.9-10), bootstrap CIs with fixed seeds appear throughout, and low-R2 fits (e.g., MuSR) are honestly flagged in Extended Data Table 1. Novelty is moderate: it extends known results on self-consistency vs. debate and judge biases, but the availability-reliability sigmoid (half-rise 14.7%, R2=0.900, p.6) and the generation/selection attribution framework are fresh empirical contributions. Evidence is strong but tied to two closed preview APIs (DeepSeek-V4-Flash Preview, Mimo v2.5) and mostly multiple-choice verifiable tasks; open-ended and live-interaction settings are explicitly left open (Discussion, p.15). Reproducibility is strong: versioned GitHub code (commit 7840cf3) and a Hugging Face archive with revision hash (pp.24-25).
topics: reasoning benchmarks (MMLU-Pro, GPQA, MuSR, MedXpertQA, HLE)

primary_link.title: Candidate supply and answer selection shape the value of LLM judging in multi-agent systems

papers.summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) sometimes already have the potential to answer correctly, but still report a wrong answer. Explaining this outcome is difficult because generation, communication and final answer-selection rules usually change simultaneously. We conceptualize multi-agent reasoning as an evolutionary pipeline of candidate generation, peer communication and terminal selection, wherein consensus without quality control can exhibit patterns of memetic drift. We study two questions: (1) when
papers.summary_zh: 多代理系統（MAS）有時明明已產生正確答案，最終卻回報錯誤結果。本文將多代理推理概念化為「候選生成、同儕溝通、終端選擇」三階段的演化式流程，指出在缺乏品質把關時，共識可能出現類似迷因漂移（memetic drift）與多數偏誤級聯的現象，使受歡迎的錯誤答案排擠少數正確答案。研究先以四種醫療推理協定檢視此瓶頸，再於 MMLU-Pro、GPQA、MedXpertQA、MuSR 共 15,336 題描繪 LLM 評審可信度（Humanity's Last Exam 另行分析），並以 16,278 題、81,390 個固定候選池進行離線重放實驗。三大發現：其一，正確答案常已存在於候選之中，系統卻仍輸出錯誤，形成 13.13–14.38 個百分點的「生成—保留缺口」；其二，評審可靠度並非模型的固定屬性，而隨任務、生成器與正確答案可用度（pgen）變化，低可用度時甚至低於隨機；其三，結合答案頻率與評審排序的混合選擇規則，將準確率由 63.82% 提升至 70.82–70.95%，主要來自拯救被多數錯誤淹沒的正確答案。成本分析顯示，評審在小候選池（k≤6）最具成本效益，池擴大後多數決優勢追平、評審效益遞減。限制在於離線重放隔離了動態互動中的接收者中介選擇與轉換過程。本研究為設計防止正確答案流失的多代理架構建立清晰的診斷基礎。
papers.title: Candidate supply and answer selection shape the value of LLM judging in multi-agent systems
papers.title_zh: 候選答案供給與答案選擇形塑 LLM 評審在多代理系統中的價值

links.title: Broken Symmetry in LLM Refusal: Answer Release Is More Local Than Refusal Restoration

evidence: §3 Experimental Setup: controlled withhold setting provides matched A-run/R-run trajectories with identical token lengths enabling bidirectional residual-stream activation patching with shared A/B answer-channel readout.
§4.1 Table 1: linear probe recovers withheld answer at 1.000 bits while behavioral answer rate is 0.000, motivating causal tests.
§4.2 Table 2: single-position A→R patch achieves 1.0 answer readout while matched R→A leaves suppression readout at 0.5 across layers 16–26 in Qwen2.5-7B (0.50 locality gap).
§4.2 Table 3: forced-distractor override control is symmetric under single-position edits, establishing the asymmetry is refusal-specific rather than a generic override effect.

§4.3 and Appendix C Tables 14-16: Qwen2.5-14B/32B retain concentrated shared-direction geometry (Table 15 energy shares 0.57-0.91) but addition/ablation/projection interventions are behaviorally inert, dissociating geometry from control.

Appendix F Tables 24/26: naturalistic retained set (66 cases, then 283 speech-heavy) shows late-layer release-refusal gap ~0.60-0.664 with bootstrap interval [0.613, 0.716], but blog retention 0.25 and thread retention 0.31-0.48.
Limitations section: explicitly concedes idealized withhold setting, weaker heterogeneous naturalistic checks, partial cross-family coverage, and no full circuit decomposition.

Reproducibility: Table 4 lists exact HF repo IDs; Appendix A.1 gives prompt templates, scoring rules, and decoder training protocol (test_size=0.25, seed=42, max_iter=2000); Compute Requirements section describes GPU classes and Slurm templates.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM interpretability/safety paper directly matching high-weight preferences (LLMs, interpretability, AI safety, evaluation). Strong methodological rigor: controlled withhold setting yields matched trajectories for bidirectional activation patching, with multiple controls (forced-distractor override, out-of-set overrides, sampling robustness, sparse-carrier negative controls), cross-scale and cross-family checks, and honestly stated limitations. The central finding—answer release is single-position local while refusal restoration requires distributed interventions, and probe recoverability overestimates behavioral control—is a novel, well-supported refinement of single-direction refusal accounts (Arditi et al.). Weaknesses: main evidence is Qwen2.5-7B-centric with a synthetic A/B withhold task; naturalistic checks are small (66 retained cases) and speech-heavy; vector-intervention results are checkpoint-dependent (inert at 14B/32B); no circuit decomposition. Reproducibility support is good (HF IDs, templates, decoder protocol, compute notes, claimed supplemental code), though code release is asserted rather than demonstrated in the text.

primary_link.title: Broken Symmetry in LLM Refusal: Answer Release Is More Local Than Refusal Restoration

papers.summary: When a language model refuses to answer a prompt, it is unclear whether the correct answer is erased from its internal representations, or merely suppressed at the output layer. We investigate this mechanism using a controlled withhold setting, which yields perfectly matched answering and refusal trajectories for bidirectional activation patching. We uncover a causal asymmetry in intervention locality under matched causal interventions, which we term broken symmetry. Even when a model generates
papers.summary_zh: 當語言模型拒絕回答時，正確答案究竟已從內部表徵被抹除，還是只是在輸出層被壓抑？本文以 Qwen2.5-7B 為主要測試平台，設計「controlled withhold」設定：要求模型在可回答的 A/B 選擇題中隱藏正確選項，藉此取得完全匹配的作答與拒答兩條軌跡，再以雙向 activation patching 檢驗對稱性。結果發現明顯的「對稱性破缺」：即使在乾淨的拒答輸出下，線性探針仍能自隱藏狀態完全恢復正確答案；釋放該答案只需單一位置的局部修補（A→R），但反向重新施加壓抑（R→A）需橫跨多個位置的廣泛干預，組裝連貫的拒答字串更是困難。對照實驗顯示此不對稱為拒答特有，強制輸出干擾選項的 override 控制呈現對稱行為。此外，平均「作答到拒答」位移向量雖具集中的幾何結構，其加減卻非可靠的可逆開關；在 Qwen2.5-14B/32B 中方向干預甚至行為失效，而 Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B 與 Gemma-4 則支持同樣的定性模式。研究侷限包括：主實驗依賴理想化的指令式選擇題設定、自然語言檢驗較弱且偏重演講類文本、跨家族覆蓋有限，且未完成電路層級分解。此發現對安全稽核至關重要：僅憑 probe 可恢復性會高估真正的行為控制，找到拒答相關方向也不保證能可靠操控模型；同時這些干預工具具兩面性，可能被用於資訊萃取，須搭配存取控管。

links.title: Credit Without Ground Truth: Auditing Step-Level Credit Assignment in LLM Agents Against Executed Replay

evidence: Abstract: 'none of the step-level credit signals we audit — LLM-judge scores, outcome-conditioned logprob ratios, or the policy's own confidence — shows reliable incremental fidelity beyond its own marginal-matched shuffled control'

Section 2: executed replay ground truth construction with K=4 alternatives and >=3 factual replays leaves '1,768 complete turns of 2,034 intervened' under Qwen2.5-7B; determinism verified and 20,538 replay rollouts archived
Section 3.2: measurability is model-dependent — no-counterfactual rate 13.1% (Qwen, n=2,034) vs 26.8% (Llama, n=1,082), Wilson 95% [11.7,14.6]% vs [24.2,29.5]%
Table 1 (Section 4): implicit rho 0.0193 [-0.109,0.081] vs own shuffle [0.005,0.114]; judge 0.1142 [0.027,0.168] vs shuffle [-0.049,0.117]; verdict H3 under frozen controls-first order

Section 5: pre-registered positive prediction held — implicit credit vs fluency median rank correlation +0.752 [0.647,0.793], n=47, Holm-adjusted p=0.0002; partial correlation with causal increment -0.004 (p=0.87)

Section 6 / Table 5: seven-arm training experiment — no arm reliably beats base policy (0.422; 54/128), all six confirmatory comparisons inconclusive at +/-3pp band with MDE ~11.8pp; dose mediation partial Mantel rho +0.078 (p=0.774) vs positive control +0.912 (p=0.0001)
Section 9: scope conditions measured — 'the audit runs in a single environment with a binary outcome'; training loop single-family, single-scale (Qwen2.5-7B, LoRA, offline)

Reproducibility statement: 'a single script regenerates the complete ledger from raw artifacts, two independent regenerations must agree byte-for-byte'; released replay archive of 29,402 files, credit/logprob dumps, adapters, and hash-pinned pre-registrations
llm_evaluation.rationale: Squarely in-scope core methodology work: audits step-level credit signals (LLM-judge scores, outcome-conditioned logprob ratios, policy confidence) used to train LLM agents, in ALFWorld with Qwen2.5-7B/Llama-3.1-8B policies and a Qwen2.5-72B judge, plus a seven-arm LoRA training experiment — strong hits on Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, RL, Training, and Evaluation. Novelty is high: it is the first audit of deployed credit signals against executed-replay causal contribution (distinct from correctness-annotated benchmarks and self-referential replay auditing), with novel findings on model-dependent measurability, a replicated fluency-echo mechanism, and dose-vs-credit mediation. Rigor is exceptional: pre-registered frozen thresholds and verdict order, marginal-matched shuffled controls gating first, Holm correction, reliability-corrected bounds, cross-family replication, and honest labeling of inconclusive results (training null reported as inconclusive, not 'no difference'; post-hoc analyses flagged). Evidence matches claim strength, with wide CIs and small effective n disclosed rather than hidden. Generalizability is the weak axis: single environment, binary outcome, 7-8B scale, LoRA offline training, all explicitly scoped. Reproducibility is exemplary: script-regenerated byte-identical ledger, hash-pinned pre-registrations, verbatim prompts, and a large released artifact set including disclosed dead values. Weighted score: 0.4*0.92+0.15*0.80+0.15*0.93+0.15*0.83+0.10*0.45+0.05*0.95 ≈ 0.84.

primary_link.title: Credit Without Ground Truth: Auditing Step-Level Credit Assignment in LLM Agents Against Executed Replay

papers.summary: Audited against policy-conditional ground truth from executed replay in a single-agent tool environment (ALFWorld), none of the step-level credit signals we audit -- LLM-judge scores, outcome-conditioned logprob ratios, or the policy's own confidence -- shows reliable incremental fidelity beyond its own marginal-matched shuffled control. Correcting for replay-target reliability leaves implicit fidelity bounded near zero and judge fidelity inconclusive at the achieved target reliability. Existing
papers.summary_zh: 本文檢驗 LLM 代理強化學習中步級信用訊號是否真的有效。常見做法是以 LLM 評審分數、結果條件化的 log-prob 比值或策略自身信心為每一步打分,但這些訊號是否反映該步驟對結果的實際因果貢獻,過去從未被測試。作者在可重播的單代理環境 ALFWorld 中建立「執行重播」真值:於每個決策點重新取樣策略支援的替代動作、推演至終局,並度量結果分佈的變化。以此稽核後,隱式信用、評審分數與信心訊號的排序保真度皆與自身邊際匹配的洗牌對照組無法區分,裁定為安慰劑等級;機制上,隱式信用主要是流暢度的回聲(與策略 log-prob 的秩相關約 +0.75,且跨模型家族重現),而以結果條件化並未帶來因果資訊。真值本身亦具結構:僅約 30.5% 的決策點呈現非零重播對比,且可測性隨模型而異,Qwen2.5-7B 與 Llama-3.1-8B 的無反事實比例相差一倍。七臂訓練實驗中沒有任何臂穩定勝過未訓練策略,各信用規則間的差異與有效訓練劑量的中介作用一致,而非信用內容本身。僅以信心為門檻的路由器雖只能以隨機水準找回關鍵步驟,卻可削減約 13% 的評審呼叫成本。限制包括單一環境、二元結果、小樣本與訓練實驗檢定力不足。作者主張比較信用規則前必須匹配有效樣本量,並提供劑量匹配、對照強度測量與最小可偵測效應等實務協定,對建立於未驗證信用訊號之上的代理訓練研究具重要警示價值。
papers.title: Credit Without Ground Truth: Auditing Step-Level Credit Assignment in LLM Agents Against Executed Replay

links.title: StartupBench: Benchmarking General-Purpose Agents on Market-Validated End-to-End Workflows

evidence: Abstract: 'even the strongest model successfully completes only approximately 30% of StartupBench' under fine-grained rubric evaluation
Section 3.1.1: 'We first survey AI-native startups... retain startups with more than USD 1M in funding and require evidence of real adoption'; 'we collect 20+ start-up agents'
Section 3.1.3: 'we recruit over 50 domain experts to reconstruct benchmark tasks'; tasks defined as triple T=(q, E, R) with weighted rubrics
Section 3.2 / Table 2: 97 tasks across 6 domains, average 25.3 fine-grained rubrics per task
Section 4.1: 'we conduct 3 independent runs for each model and report 95% bootstrap confidence intervals... using 10,000 resamples'; success defined as score >= 90
Section 4.3: 'the automatic evaluator achieves an overall agreement of 92.78% with expert judgments'; single-judge holistic ablation 'reduces the agreement... to 83%'
Section 4.5.1 / Table 6: harness ablation across Hermes/Claude Code/Nanobot shows max-min variation of only 1.79 points on average, 'relative ordering of models remains unchanged'
Section 4.5.2 / Table 7: specialized agents score 83.50 avg / 39.18% success vs general-purpose 64.26 / 19.74% (oracle 71.75 / 28.06%)
Table 4: core rubric satisfaction (63.45%) consistently below auxiliary (68.67%) across 8 of 9 models
Appendix A.2 / B: cross-validation by independent expert reviewers; 57 domain experts, median 5 years experience
Section 4.4.2: named failure modes 'Complex Instruction Following' and 'Self-Verification Hallucination' with case studies (Figures 5, 6, 8, 9)
llm_evaluation.rationale: A market-validated end-to-end agent benchmark (StartupBench) built from AI-native startup workflows with expert rubrics and Agent-as-a-Judge evaluation. Strong preference alignment with Agents & Tool Use, LLMs, Reasoning, Red Teaming & Evaluation, and LLM-as-judge themes. The task-sourcing methodology (survey + user interviews + expert reconstruction) is a reasonable novelty contribution over researcher-defined benchmarks. Rigor is supported by multi-stage QC, 3 runs with bootstrap CIs, harness ablations, and human-agreement validation of the judge (92.78% rubric-level). Evidence is concrete with named tables/figures. Deductions: judge validation covers only two representative models, the benchmark is not yet externally validated beyond the authors' own harness family, several model names/citations are unverifiable or anachronistic (e.g., GPT-5.6-sol, Seed-2.1-Pro dated 2026), no code/data release is confirmed, and the difficulty-filtering step (excluding tasks frontier models solve) introduces circularity that is disclosed but not quantified.

primary_link.title: StartupBench: Benchmarking General-Purpose Agents on Market-Validated End-to-End Workflows

papers.summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models(LLMs) and agents have substantially improved the ability of AI systems to execute complex tasks. Yet existing benchmarks largely rely on researcher-selected tasks, leaving uncertain whether such progress extends to the work that real-world users actually demand from AI systems. We introduce \textbf{StartupBench}, an E2E agent benchmark grounded in market-validated AI startup products. Rather than defining tasks from pre-defined assumptions about useful ag
papers.summary_zh: 現有代理基準多半由研究者自訂任務，難以反映真實使用者委託給 AI 的實際工作，且評估方式常過於粗略，無法忠實檢驗複雜交付物。StartupBench 改以市場驗證的 AI 原生新創產品為任務來源：團隊調查 20 多家具真實採用證據的新創，訪談 30 多位深度用戶，再由 50 多位領域專家將工作流程重建為可重現的評測任務，並經跨專家審查與難度校準。基準含 97 項端對端任務，涵蓋醫療、金融、法律、商業管理、STEM 與電腦科學、教育與人文六大領域，每項任務由使用者請求、完整工作區與加權評分準則組成，平均 25.3 條細粒度規則，並以具工具存取能力的 Agent-as-a-Judge 逐條獨立判定。在統一的 Nanobot 框架下評測 9 個代表性模型，最佳的 Kimi-K3 與 GPT-5.6-sol 平均分數約 73.67 與 73.61，但在分數達 90 的嚴格標準下成功率僅約 29.55% 與 31.27%，顯示模型雖有大量部分進展，卻難以完整交付。金融與 STEM 最具挑戰，商業最易；失敗主要源於複雜指令遵循、領域專業合規不足與自我驗證幻覺，且自動評分與專家一致率達 92.78%。相較之下，專門化新創代理平均分數 83.50、成功率 39.18%，仍明顯領先通用代理。此基準以市場需求為錨，為衡量代理能否可靠完成真實工作提供實證指標，並指引基礎模型與代理系統的改進方向。

links.title: VIG: Visual Information Gain as a Reward Signal for Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Compression

evidence: Abstract: 'Across six main multimodal reasoning benchmarks and three Qwen3-VL-Thinking model sizes (2B/4B/8B)... VIG consistently improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off' and code link https://github.com/chaser682/vig
Section 4.2: 'On Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking, VIG attains AvgACC = 64.92% and AvgEff = 52.42, surpassing the strongest compression baseline ThinkPrune by +2.37% in accuracy and +39.4% in efficiency'
Section 4.3 / Table 4: 'Removing the VIG term from the reward reduces the method to plain GRPO, which collapses AvgEff from 52.42 to 36.44 (-30%) and lowers AvgACC by 2.04 points'
Section 4.1: 'All numbers we report are from a single deterministic (greedy, temperature 0) decoding pass per checkpoint' with paired-bootstrap CIs reported where margins matter (Appendix F)
Section 4.2: 2B block caveat: 'the margin over the strongest baseline is only +0.55 points and is not significant under a unified step-400 protocol... 53% of 2B generations hit the 4,096-token limit'

Appendix F.2 / Table 6: deletion probe shows 'deleting the lowest-VIG sentences is the most damaging condition' on VIG-trained chains (80.92 to 72.36 at 50%), the opposite of a token-importance reading
Limitations: 'VIG measures visual dependence, which is neither visual correctness nor counterfactual necessity... we regard cross-architecture generality as unresolved'
Appendix G / Table 7: VIG training overhead 1.17x vs plain GRPO (37.2 vs 31.8 s/it); break-even after roughly 48K inference requests
Appendix E: full training configuration (G=8, KL 0.04, lr 1e-6, DeepSpeed ZeRO-2, 500 steps) and baseline implementations on identical data/protocol
Appendix D: training mixture of 2,948 samples from MMStar, MathVista, LogicVista; evaluation set sizes for all seven benchmarks

Section 4.2 / Table 3: non-math transfer on RealWorldQA and OCRBench claims only 'VIG preserves accuracy at a substantially lower token cost', with gaps among strong methods acknowledged as within noise
llm_evaluation.rationale: A multimodal CoT-compression paper squarely inside scope: it trains Qwen3-VL reasoning models with GRPO using a per-token conditional-mutual-information reward (visual information gain) computed from two forward passes (with/without image), reframing compression as visual-density maximization rather than length budgeting. Strong match to high-weight preferences (Reasoning/CoT, LLMs, RL, efficiency, multimodal). Novelty is solid: per-token information-theoretic reward for CoT compression is a fresh angle versus textual length penalties (L1, ThinkPrune, TALE) and trajectory-level VPPO, though it builds on established GRPO and information-bottleneck ideas. Rigor is unusually careful: five baselines, three model sizes, six-plus-one benchmarks, reward/masked-image/weight ablations, a confidence-only control arm, text-solvable vs vision-required stratification, paired-bootstrap CIs, and an honest deletion probe (Appendix F.2/Table 6) whose counterintuitive asymmetry the authors interpret rather than hide. Evidence is strong for the core claim (+2.37% ACC, +39.4% efficiency over ThinkPrune at 8B; ablation removes 30% of efficiency gain), and the authors appropriately hedge the 2B block (runaway-length confound, non-significant +0.55), non-math accuracy (within noise), and the mismatched VPPO checkpoint. Deductions: single greedy decoding pass for headline tables, checkpoint-step asymmetry (400 vs 500) across methods, one model family with cross-architecture generality explicitly unresolved, and reward requiring model-specific vision-token separation. Reproducibility is good: code link, Algorithm 1, full hyperparameters, training-data details, licenses, and a cost/break-even analysis (1.17x overhead, ~48K request payback). Minor metadata sloppiness (mismatched author emails) noted but not decisive.

primary_link.title: VIG: Visual Information Gain as a Reward Signal for Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Compression

Existing CoT compression methods optimize output length but never measure whether a reasoning token is actually grounded in the image. We propose \textbf{VIG} (Visual Information Gain), an information-theoretic GRPO reward

links.title: A decodability criterion predicts when hidden-state selection beats majority voting in large language models

evidence: Abstract: decodability predicts the selection-over-voting gain at Pearson r=0.75 held-out with threshold AUC=0.60; CASE gains up to 19 points on medium and 16.8 on hard questions.

Section 6.1: naive random-split CV accuracy 0.610 vs. question-grouped 0.542 and within-question AUC 0.502 (chance) on LogiQA/Qwen2.5-7B; leakage inflation (+0.04 to +0.39, median +0.27) confirmed in all 15 medical settings (Supplementary Table S17).

Section 6.4: in-sample law r=0.96 treated as consistency check only; leave-one-model-out r in [0.941,0.959], dropping the entire OpenBioLLM family keeps r=0.90; held-out calibration-to-deployment r=0.75 (CI [0.51,0.93], 13 settings).
Section 6.5 (Table 4): Byzantine N-scaling, CASE 20.4%→47.3% vs. majority vote 20.4%→6.0% over N=1→16 on the minority-correct subset (+41.3 pp at N=16).
Section 6.7 (Table 7): out-of-domain GPQA transfer; physics settings within 0.7 and 3.8 pp of the medical regression forecast; threshold classifies all six non-medical settings correctly.

Section 6.8 (Table 8): CASE beats self-certainty, sequence log-probability, and predictive entropy in all five settings; TF-IDF text-classifier control at within-question AUC 0.44 vs. 0.70 for the hidden-state gate under identical labels.
Section 6.6: steering across four intervention variants does not improve accuracy (readout-not-lever dissociation); projecting out the correctness direction collapses gate AUC 0.73→0.13.

Code availability: anonymized repository (anonymous.4open.science/r/case-decodability-28D1) for peer review, with public de-anonymized release promised only upon acceptance; Section 5 specifies models in fp16, nucleus sampling τ=0.7, top-p=0.95, 512 new tokens, scikit-learn logistic gate.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper: test-time answer fusion over self-consistency, hidden-state probing, and a pre-deployment diagnostic, not a domain application despite the medical QA benchmarks (which serve as testbeds; GPQA and MATH-500 provide non-medical tests). High topical fit across LLMs, reasoning/test-time compute, and interpretability. Novelty is solid but incremental over existing correctness-probe and latent-verifier work (LiLaVe, SWIFT, CCS-lineage, Cho et al., Seo et al. all acknowledged); the genuinely new pieces are the leakage-free within-question decodability criterion, the question-identity-leakage audit, and the derived threshold law. Rigor is unusually careful: grouped evaluation, permutation nulls, held-out calibration-to-deployment splits (r=0.75), cluster/Deming/jackknife checks, seed replications, and honest caveats that the in-sample r=0.96 is partly structural. Evidence is strong but with real limits the authors admit: headline medium-difficulty gains concentrate in the OpenBioLLM family, some bins are underpowered, and the verifier parity claim is one setting. Generalizability is tested (scale 1.5B-70B, three architecture families, out-of-domain GPQA forecast within 3.8 pp) though the slope requires per-domain recalibration. Reproducibility is good (open-weight models, public benchmarks, precise hyperparameters, anonymous code repo) but artifacts are promised only upon acceptance.
topics: LLM test-time compute and answer fusion

primary_link.title: A decodability criterion predicts when hidden-state selection beats majority voting in large language models

papers.summary: Combining the answers a large language model (LLM) samples for a question into one decision is a test-time information fusion problem, usually solved by majority voting. Voting is unreliable on difficult questions, where the sampled answers share correlated errors, so the wrong answer can win and drawing more samples makes the decision worse. Selecting a candidate by reading a correctness signal from the model's hidden states is a promising alternative, but its accuracy varies across models and
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）回答問題時，常對取樣的多個候選答案做多數決投票（self-consistency）以融合成單一決策；但在困難題目上，各候選的錯誤高度相關，錯誤答案形成穩定共識，增加取樣反而更糟，此即拜占庭（Byzantine）情境。作者提出 CASE（Correctness-Axis Selection），在答案 token 的隱藏狀態上訓練線性閘門，選出內部正確性分數最高的候選，並提出核心貢獻「可解碼性」（within-question AUC）：一個無洩漏指標，衡量閘門能否把同一題的正確候選排在錯誤候選之前。論文先證明天真的線性探針在隨機分割交叉驗證下的準確度其實來自題目身分洩漏，改採題目分組評估後訊號跌至隨機水準。實證顯示，可解碼性可事先預測選擇法相對投票的增益：樣本內 r=0.96，於留出資料上 r=0.75，決策門檻約 AUC=0.60。在對齊的醫療模型上，CASE 於中等難度題最多領先投票 19 點，困難題在 N=16 時領先 16.8 點，正確答案屬少數時更達 41.3 點；訊號取決於模型須回想的對齊知識，而非參數規模，且可跨域推廣至 GPQA（預測誤差 3.8 點內），並以近乎零成本比擬生成式驗證器。該正確性方向僅供讀取，無法用於引導生成。限制包括最強效果集中於醫療領域、公開題庫可能已被記憶、部分中等難度樣本偏小。此診斷讓實務者能在部署前決定採用學習式選擇或多數決投票。

links.title: LLMs Can Predict Failure Risk, But Struggle to Predict Which Collaboration Protocol Pays Off: Cost-Aware Protocol Routing Across Reasoning Tasks

evidence: Abstract: post-answer gpt-oss-120b probe ranks Baseline failures at 0.8847 AUROC (4,151 parseable cases; 95% CI [0.8732, 0.8955]) but only 0.1674 and 0.1041 AUPRC for PER- and Broadcast-specific value.

Section 3 / Table 1: self-confidence gate reaches 78.0% [74.0, 81.8] solve at 45.0K tokens vs. frozen gpt-oss-120b router 73.8% at 71.3K; directional errors reported (gpt-oss router over-escalates 33.3%, Llama/Gemma routers over-escalate 63-71%).
Appendix A.3: 'The model-call file and scoring labels are physically separated... A schema validator rejects forbidden keys, and the saved leakage checks pass in all six settings' (Table S4).

Section 5 / Table S2: fixed-order-oracle coverage exceeds Baseline by 23.2-58.3 points across 10 paired model-condition settings spanning OmniMath 2, JEEBench, SciBench, and LAB-Bench with two solver families.

Section 7 Limitations: 'Each problem-protocol pair has one deterministic realized outcome' and cost is 'primarily in logged tokens,' with CIs quantifying benchmark-problem variation, not fresh-run variability.

Appendix F: companion dataset archive at huggingface.co/datasets/ChihHsuan-Yang/scientific-agent-protocol-traces with anonymized four-protocol traces, plus ancillary CSVs in the arXiv source package; restricted-license problems released as identifiers/reconstruction instructions.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-methodology work on cost-aware routing across multi-agent collaboration protocols (Baseline/Single/PER/Broadcast) for reasoning tasks; squarely within high-weight preferences (LLMs, agents, reasoning). The matched four-protocol design with offline oracle evaluation and the explicit failure-risk vs. protocol-value distinction is a solid, moderately novel empirical contribution; routing/cascades exist (FrugalGPT, RouteLLM, MasRouter) but matched-outcome protocol-level analysis is less common. Rigor is strong: stratified seeded splits, dev-only selection, leakage checks (Appendix A.3), 2,000-resample bootstrap CIs, multiple ablations (tier removal, source holdout, embedding routers, cross-model confidence), and an honest limitations section. Evidence is quantitative and consistent (0.8847 AUROC failure risk vs. 0.1674/0.1041 AUPRC for protocol-specific value; 10 paired settings with 23.2-58.3 point oracle gains), though each problem-protocol pair is a single deterministic realization, limiting outcome-noise coverage. Generalizability is deliberately bounded (main routers on one solver/benchmark; six-setting confidence/router subset); the paper itself frames results as task-dependent, not universal. Reproducibility is high: full prompts, seeds, hyperparameters, compute accounting, HuggingFace trace archive, and ancillary CSVs.

primary_link.title: LLMs Can Predict Failure Risk, But Struggle to Predict Which Collaboration Protocol Pays Off: Cost-Aware Protocol Routing Across Reasoning Tasks

papers.summary: Multi-agent large language model (LLM) systems can improve reasoning by spending more computation, but deployment requires deciding when extra collaboration is worth its cost. We isolate this decision by running every problem under four protocols while holding the solver fixed within each setting: direct solving (Baseline), iterative self-correction (Single), planner-executor-reviewer collaboration (PER), and multi-agent deliberation (Broadcast). The primary benchmark comprises 4,181 competition
papers.summary_zh: 多代理 LLM 系統靠投入更多運算提升推理表現，但部署時必須判斷額外協作是否值得其成本。本文在固定 solver 下對 4,181 道競賽級數學題（Omni-MATH 2 子集）執行四種協定：直接求解（Baseline）、迭代自我修正（Single）、規劃—執行—審查協作（PER）與多代理商議（Broadcast），並比較固定策略、輕量學習與凍結 LLM 路由器及自我信心閘門。作者區分失敗風險預測（Baseline 是否會錯）與協作價值預測（哪個協定值得加價）。答題後探針以 0.8847 AUROC 預測 Baseline 失敗，對「任何協作是否有幫助」仍具參考性（0.7683 AUPRC），但對 PER 或 Broadcast 專屬價值的 AUPRC 驟降至 0.1674 與 0.1041。路由錯誤具方向性：保守策略傾向升級不足，高解題率凍結路由器則過度升級。自我信心閘門以 45K tokens 達 78.0% 解題率，優於凍結路由器的 73.8%，仍落後回溯性固定順序 oracle 的 92.4%。跨 JEEBench、SciBench、LAB-Bench 等四基準與兩種 solver 的十組配對設定中，oracle 較 Baseline 高 23.2–58.3 個百分點；六組保留測試中路由器與 oracle 仍差 18.5–28.9 點。限制包括每題僅單次確定性執行、成本以 tokens 計量、oracle 不可部署。本研究診斷性地分離「是否升級」與「升級到哪」兩個決策，為成本感知路由的後續研究提供可測量目標。

links.title: Fair ASR: Re-Evaluating Black-Box Jailbreaks under Shared Target-Call Budgets

evidence: Section 3.2-3.3: formalizes ASR@B, ASR-budget curves, ATC, and StrongREJECT-based HS under a shared target-call budget B

Section 4.1: 11 attacks across hand-crafted, stochastic (BoN), and LLM-driven families; LlamaGuard4 judges the re-evaluation while GPT-4o with X-Teaming rubric judges ReCode, a cross-phase judge inconsistency
Table 1 (Section 4.2): ReNeLLM avg ASR@100 98.7% with ATC 3.9; CodeAttack avg ASR@K 90.7%; budget-dependent ranking reversal TAP vs BoN at B=5 vs B=100
Table 2 (Section 4.3.2): ReCode avg ASR@20 81.0% with AAC 7.00; GPT-5 85%/7.19; four ablations including ReCode w/ Gate restoring the retry loop
Appendix B.4: 2,000-replicate request-level bootstrap pointwise 95% CIs; overlapping intervals at some budgets acknowledged
Appendix C.3: Claude Sonnet 4.6 filter-rate analysis; removing nesting raises ASR 46%->57% and lowers filter rate 40.4%->15.1%
Appendix A.1-A.3: versioned endpoints (gpt-4o-2024-08-06, gpt-5-2025-08-07), temperature settings, and full baseline hyperparameters
Section 5: limitations state target calls miss token usage/pricing/template-development cost and multi-turn settings are uncovered
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-safety/red-teaming work with direct fit to preferred topics (jailbreak evaluation, LLM-as-target, code-style prompting). Fair-ASR is a sensible but incremental protocol refinement of known budget-dependence findings (BoN, SABER, FLOPs-based compute-aware evals), and ReCode is explicitly a composition of existing primitives (ReNeLLM-style rewrite, BoN perturbation, CodeAttack nesting) with a gate removed; novelty is moderate. Rigor and evidence are strong: 11 attacks, 5+3 targets, two datasets, two attacker models, four ablations, Pareto analysis, and 2,000-replicate bootstrap CIs (Appendix B.4) support the headline claims (budget-dependent rankings in Table B.4; ReCode 85% ASR@20 on GPT-5 at 7.19 attacker calls in Table 2). Caveats: judge changes between phases (LlamaGuard4 for re-evaluation vs GPT-4o X-Teaming rubric for ReCode, Section 4.1), 7B-only attacker scale, no variance estimates for main tables, text-only black-box scope, and a Claude-specific reversal where removing nesting helps (Section C.3), which limits uniform generalizability. Limitations (no token/pricing cost, no multi-turn) are acknowledged in Section 5. Code URL and full hyperparameters/templates in Appendices A, C, E support reproducibility.

primary_link.title: Fair ASR: Re-Evaluating Black-Box Jailbreaks under Shared Target-Call Budgets

papers.summary: Reliable jailbreak evaluation is essential for assessing LLM safety, but most existing studies rely solely on attack success rate (ASR) without accounting for its dependence on attack budgets, resulting in unfair comparisons across methods. Existing compute-aware evaluations reduce heterogeneous resources into FLOPs, which is difficult to estimate for black-box models and fails to capture resource-specific constraints. To provide a comparable evaluation basis, we introduce Fair-ASR, an evaluatio
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）的越獄攻擊評估存在不公問題：多數研究僅報告攻擊成功率（ASR），卻忽略取得該結果所用的攻擊預算，使跨方法比較失真；以 FLOPs 為基礎的運算感知評估，則對 closed-source 黑箱模型難以估計，也無法反映各項資源的不同限制。作者提出 Fair-ASR 評估協定，以「目標模型呼叫次數」作為所有黑箱攻擊共享且可直接觀察的比較軸，在相同預算 B 下報告 ASR@B、ASR–預算曲線與平均目標呼叫數（ATC），並另行追蹤攻擊者模型呼叫以分析效率。團隊重新評估 11 種代表性攻擊，涵蓋手工模板、隨機重複取樣（BoN）與 LLM 驅動方法（如 PAIR、TAP、ReNeLLM）。主要發現：ASR 與方法排名隨預算大幅變動，例如 B=5 時 TAP 領先 BoN，B=100 時反被超越；CodeAttack 等簡單方法在緊縮預算下仍極具競爭力；且沒有任何 LLM 驅動方法能同時在目標呼叫與攻擊者呼叫兩個維度上高效。針對此效率落差，作者提出 ReCode，結合單次去敏感化改寫、不需攻擊者的字元層級擾動與程式碼風格巢狀包裝；在 20 次目標呼叫預算下，ReCode 於 GPT-5 達到 85% ASR，平均每次請求僅需 7.19 次攻擊者呼叫。研究限制包括未涵蓋 token 用量、API 計費與模板開發成本，尚未支援多輪情境，且結果依賴評審模型判定。整體而言，此工作為越獄評估建立公平、可觀察的比較基準，對 LLM 安全測試與資源感知紅隊評估具重要參考價值。
papers.title: Fair ASR: Re-Evaluating Black-Box Jailbreaks under Shared Target-Call Budgets
papers.title_zh: Fair ASR：在共享目標呼叫預算下重新評估黑箱越獄攻擊

links.title: Second-Order Response Laws for LLM Judges: Debiased Estimation of Prompt Instability

evidence: Abstract: 'corrected low-repeat estimates are closer to an independently acquired R=16 reference than plug-in estimates, with the largest gains at small repeat budgets' and '44,112 unique live calls'.

§4 Table 1: five evidence layers (known-law simulation, byte-identical null 4,800 calls, matched evaluation 4,800, independent R=16 reference 9,600, broad audit 17,712, four-configuration panel 7,200 new calls).

§5 Table 2: plug-in bias matches exact 1/R prediction across 12 K-law-R settings, largest discrepancy 1.55e-4; complete estimator lowers MSE by factors 2.57-7.03; 52.7-56.1% of unbiased item estimates negative at boundary target.
§5 Exact live null: plug-in means .0406/.0206/.0126 at R=2/4/8 vs corrected -.0053/-.0008/.0024 under randomized hidden IDs with byte-identical payloads (zero prompt target).

§5 Table 5/6: four-configuration panel shows R=4 corrected prompt estimates Qwen .00521, GPT-OSS -.00123, Gemma .01774, Claude .00986; residual call dominates for Qwen/GPT-OSS, answer order for Gemma/Claude.

§5 Limitations: 'Our experiments cover a fixed census of six formatting wrappers; generalization to validated paraphrases or unseen prompt generators requires additional acquisition'; disjoint high-repeat reference available only for Qwen.
Supp S9/Table S12: two-repeat panel correction lowers MAE at R=2 (.0167) and R=4 (.0043) but raises it by .0005 [-.0041,.0029] at R=8 — negative result reported.
Supp S8/Table S18: 44,112 rows, manifest-to-canonical mismatches 0/2,400 for new configurations, all internal hash checks PASS; SHA-256 hashes for prompt YAML and criterion block given in S5.
Supp S4.1: finite-replication non-identifiability result for the anonymous mixing law at fixed R, bounding what the design can claim.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Directly in-scope LLM evaluation methodology: formalizes prompt instability of LLM judges as a second-order response law and derives exact finite-R plug-in inflation formulas plus design-unbiased agreement-based estimators (Thms 1, S1; Props 1-3, proofs in Supp S2-S3). Novelty is solid rather than breakthrough: the math rests on classical variance decomposition/U-statistics (Fleiss, generalizability theory, Hoeffding), but the exact inflation identities, crossed prompt-by-order design retaining invalid outputs as a fourth category, and byte-identical live null are new for LLM-judge auditing. Rigor is high: assumptions (conditional independence, fixed census) are stated, unclipped negative estimates reported, and limitations honestly acknowledged (§5 Limitations; Supp S9, including that the panel correction raises MAE by .0005 at R=8 in Table S12). Evidence is strong and multi-layered: 200,000-item known-law simulations recover the 1/R bias within 1.55e-4 with 2.57-7.03x MSE gains (Table 2); an exact-zero hidden-factor null shows plug-in inflation (0.0406/0.0206/0.0126) vs corrected ~0 (Table S7); MAE to an independent R=16 reference drops .0365→.0160 at R=2 (Table 3); a 369-item audit and 4-configuration panel (Table 5/6) show configuration-specific inflation and component profiles. Weaknesses: empirical scope is narrow (LLMBar pairwise judging, 50 matched items, six formatting wrappers; R=16 reference only for Qwen), so generalizability beyond the declared census is explicitly unproven. Reproducibility is excellent on paper: SHA-256 hashed prompts (S5), exact model revisions and contracts (Table S4), estimator scripts, zero-mismatch integrity checks (Table S18), though call-level audit tables are external companions not in the archive (S8).

primary_link.title: Second-Order Response Laws for LLM Judges: Debiased Estimation of Prompt Instability

papers.summary: LLM judges are often evaluated with a single prompt and only a few repeated calls. When their verdicts vary, it remains unclear whether the variation comes from sampling noise within a prompt or systematic differences across prompts. We formalize this distinction using a second-order response law: the distribution of prompt-conditioned verdict distributions induced by a declared prompt policy. For a quadratic measure of prompt instability, we show that the usual plug-in estimator is biased upwar
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討以 LLM 作為自動評審時的根本測量問題：當評審對同一題目的裁定不一致時，究竟是單一提示詞內的抽樣雜訊，還是跨提示詞的系統性差異（即「提示不穩定性」）？作者將此區分形式化為「二階反應法則」，即由提示詞條件裁定分布所構成的分布，並證明在有限重複次數 R 下，常用的 plug-in 估計量會把提示內雜訊誤計為提示效應而系統性高估。方法上，論文推導出 plug-in 膨脹的精確公式，並提出由提示內與跨提示一致性差額構成的不偏估計量，涵蓋抽樣提示與固定提示普查兩種設計；在提示×答案順序的交叉設計下，可將總分歧分解為殘餘呼叫、提示、答案順序與交互作用四個成分，並把無效輸出視為明確的第四類結果。實證包含 44,112 次真實呼叫：已知法則模擬重現 1/R 膨脹並大幅降低均方誤差；位元組相同的隱藏因子對照組貼近精確零目標；配對的 Qwen 研究顯示校正後的低重複估計更接近獨立取得的 R=16 參考，R=2 時 MAE 由 .0365 降至 .0160；四組凍結設定的比較顯示膨脹幅度與主導成分因設定而異，Qwen 與 GPT-OSS 以殘餘呼叫變異為主，Gemma 與 Claude 以答案順序為主，校正亦改變設定的不穩定性排序。限制包括僅涵蓋 LLMBar 上六種格式包裝的固定普查、高重複參考僅限 Qwen、假設呼叫條件獨立，且各設定停止合約不同，難以分離模型與執行環境的效果。整體而言，此框架能把提示穩健性與有限呼叫雜訊分開估計，有助於更可靠地設計 LLM 評審實驗與解讀基準分數。
papers.title: Second-Order Response Laws for LLM Judges: Debiased Estimation of Prompt Instability
papers.title_zh: LLM 評審的二階反應法則：提示不穩定性的去偏估計

links.title: Calibrated Enough to Know, Not Calibrated to Act: Fabricated Evidence Makes LLM Agents Commit to the Unknowable

evidence: Abstract: across 12 frontier models commitment rises from 6.5% to 54.0% as evidence escalates; fully fabricated panel lifts commitment from 24.5% to 36.8%, statistically indistinguishable from 37.6% with real data
§3.1: scrambled minus rich is +0.7pp with 90% case-clustered CI [-2.1, +3.1]; restricted to three responsive models the difference is +11.11pp, CI [+4.17, +18.06]
§3.3: three Claude models carry the effect while four models never commit and three always commit; Qwen3.7-plus output unparseable on 75.0% of rows
§5: committed-call AUROC 0.346 (CI [0.280, 0.413]) and Brier Skill Score -0.124 against climatology, while matched answerable controls are answered at 98.6-100% accuracy (0 of 864 declines)
§6.6: tense-balanced control with 48 answerable-future and 54 unknowable-present items; trained 3B declines 0% and 100% of these respectively, within-tense J +97/+100
§8: under the reasoning-suppressing frontier framing, ablation seed 1 commits on 48 of 48 unknowable items with a real probability, and answerable accuracy falls to 50.9-73.8%
§7: trained 3B commits 0.0% at all four evidence levels on the original 40 cases, but frontier baseline was sampled at temperature 0.3 vs. the trained model's greedy decoding
Limitations: weather is the weakest instrument (no sealed outcomes, ensemble rain probability carries real skill), effect rests on one developer's models, intervention tested at one 3B scale

Data and code availability: all raw cached generations, analysis scripts, pre-registration released at github.com/Pranav-1100/confidence-calibration-evaluation, archived at DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22043517
Table 3 note contains contradictory statements about how many checkpoints back 'independent runs' vs 'main recipe' ranges (six/seven vs three/four), an internal editing inconsistency
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong in-scope LLM-agent safety paper: measures when agents act on aleatoric (unknowable) questions under authoritative-looking evidence, isolating presentation vs. information via fabricated panels, then fine-tunes the act/decline gate. Preference match is excellent (agents/tool use, AI safety, calibration/interpretability, LLMs, SFT/DPO training). Novelty is solid: the full-fabrication control answering the v1 confound, action-level (not stated-probability) measurement, and the failure-boundary analysis (reasoning slot required) go beyond the abstention and calibration literature, though adjacent concurrent work (AgentAbstain, Pal et al., Sun et al.) reaches similar localizations. Rigor is unusually careful (matched answerable controls, degenerate-strategy baselines, TOST equivalence, case-clustered bootstrap, tense-balanced and sports-overlap ablations, disclosed post-hoc choices), but is dented by single-sample cells, a temperature mismatch in the headline §7 comparison, editing residue (contradictory range counts under Table 3), and heavy reliance on heterogeneous per-family behavior. Evidence is abundant with sealed outcomes in equity/crypto, but the pivotal fabricated-vs-real equivalence is carried by three models from one developer, and weather lacks sealed outcomes (disclosed). Generalizability is limited: one 3B architecture at one scale, effect concentrated in one model family, and the paper itself flags scale fragility. Reproducibility is excellent: verbatim prompts, cached generations, scripts, pre-registration, and archived DOIs released.

primary_link.title: Calibrated Enough to Know, Not Calibrated to Act: Fabricated Evidence Makes LLM Agents Commit to the Unknowable

papers.summary: An LLM agent shown a professional-looking market panel commits to a directional call on a provably unpredictable question far more often than one asked the bare question: across 12 frontier models, commitment rises from 6.5% to 54.0% as evidence is escalated. It commits just as readily when every number on the panel is invented: fabricating the entire display, so nothing the model can see is true except the question itself, still lifts commitment from 24.5% to 36.8%, statistically indistinguisha
papers.summary_zh: 本論文研究 LLM 代理面對本質上不可預測問題時，在行動層次的校準失敗。作者以封存結果的短期股價方向、加密貨幣價格、體育賽事與天氣預報題目建構不可知性基準，檢驗證據呈現方式如何左右模型的承諾（commitment）行為。結果顯示，12 個前沿模型收到裸問題時僅 6.5% 選擇回答，附上專業技術指標面板後躍升至 54.0%。關鍵的因果控制實驗指出：將面板上六項技術指標全數換成捏造數值，甚至整個面板完全造假，承諾率仍與真實資料統計上無異（36.8% 對 37.6%），證明觸發行動的是權威包裝而非資訊本身。失敗被定位在行動閘門：同批模型對可回答的對照題近乎全對，也能標記題目不可知（90%），但該判斷未被用來抑制回答；陳述機率的 AUROC 僅 0.346，比氣候基準更差。訓練方面，僅用 540 個骰子、硬幣、罐子與計時器等合成案例微調 Qwen2.5-3B，即能把原始案例承諾率降至 0.0% 並轉移到未見領域；但閘門對提示結構脆弱，當輸出格式不留推理空間時即失效，某次消融訓練甚至在 48 題不可知題目上全數承諾並附機率。限制包括天氣域缺乏封存結果、效應集中於單一開發商的模型、訓練僅驗證 3B 規模、殘留詞彙線索未完全排除。本文提醒：代理評估應審計決策而非陳述機率，部署環境中的權威儀表板可能侵蝕模型拒答不可知問題的能力。
papers.title: Calibrated Enough to Know, Not Calibrated to Act: Fabricated Evidence Makes LLM Agents Commit to the Unknowable
papers.title_zh: 校準得足以知道，卻不足以據以行動：捏造的證據使 LLM 代理對不可知問題貿然承諾

links.title: SPADE: Self-Play in Adaptive Synthetic Executable Environments

evidence: Abstract: SPADE improves over the strongest fixed-environment baseline by +5.3 on average across eight held-out math, science, code, and reasoning benchmarks; +5.7 on BFCL v4 multi-turn and +13.9 on ACEBench-Agent at 30B-A3B
Table 1: Qwen3-30B-A3B suite average 58.3 (+8.1 over base 50.2) vs Fixed-env RLVE 53.0 and Fixed-env GRPO 51.4, both retrained per backbone for 400 iterations from the same base model

Table 3 / Section 7.1: removing corpus grounding or memory alone drops suite average to 53.5/53.2; removing both ED training and memory falls to 40.5, 9.7 points below base; static GPT-5.5 pool reaches 53.0
Section 7.2 / Table 6: hint-based regret reaches 58.3 average vs 55.9 for EMA-based learning potential, isolating the designer-reward choice

Appendix F.3.1: reference systems in Table 2 were trained/evaluated on their own harnesses with differing BFCL versions, tau2-bench forks, user simulators, and aggregation rules, so cross-row comparison is not apples-to-apples

Appendix E: Theorem E.5 proves every pure Nash equilibrium yields hint-free optimality, but under idealized assumptions E.2 (articulated hints) and E.3 (internalizability) that do not hold in practice
Appendix I.1.2 / Table 8: Vendi/n 0.68 with corpus vs 0.04 without, replicated under TF-IDF/LSA embeddings (0.53/0.58/0.48/0.05)

Section 9 Limitations: environment complexity bounded by base-model scale, human-designed optimizer (GRPO) not self-modified, no formal optimality of the curriculum, fixed-task evaluation rather than open-ended growth
Appendix F.3: training and evaluation code, configuration files for every run, evaluation output JSONs, and figure scripts are released; full hyperparameters in Table 5 and prompts in Appendix F.1

Section 8 / Figure 13: average gain grows with model size (+5.2 at 4B, +5.7 at 8B, +8.1 at 30B-A3B) while Fixed-env GRPO stays near +1.2; Appendix G Figure 16 shows Nemotron-30B gains only on Reasoning-Gym
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM/agent research: a single LLM both designs executable training environments and learns from them via GRPO, directly matching the highest-weight preferences (LLMs, agents & tool use, reasoning, RL, training optimization). Novelty is meaningful but incremental in a crowded self-play/environment-synthesis space: hint-based regret extends PAIRED's minimax regret, corpus grounding extends SPICE, role-conditioned self-play extends SPIRAL; the claim of being the first RL-trained designer producing full multi-turn MDP environments is credible but the delta over EvoEnv, TTCS, and GenEnv is arguable. Rigor is strong: three backbones (4B/8B/30B-A3B), retrained fixed-environment baselines from the same base checkpoints (Table 1), component-controlled ablations (Table 3: w/o corpus 53.5, w/o memory 53.2, w/o ED training+memory 40.5, GPT-5.5 static pool 53.0 vs full 58.3), a reward ablation isolating hint-regret (58.3) from EMA learning potential (55.9) (Section 7.2, Table 6), curriculum-diversity and scaling analyses, a calibrated Vendi diversity metric with dual-embedding replication, and an equilibrium analysis under explicitly stated idealized assumptions (Appendix E). Evidence weaknesses: tool-use comparisons in Table 2 are transcribed from other papers with differing budgets/protocols (acknowledged in Appendix F.3.1), best-checkpoint selection per variant risks optimistic selection, and the cross-family check (Nemotron) evaluates only Reasoning-Gym (Figure 16). Reproducibility is excellent: code, per-run configs, evaluation JSONs, and figure scripts released, with full prompts and hyperparameters (Appendices F.1-F.3).

primary_link.title: SPADE: Self-Play in Adaptive Synthetic Executable Environments

papers.summary: Continuous self-improvement requires an ever-expanding pool of self-generated, diverse, adaptive goals. For language agents, existing training environment pools (hand-curated, statically synthesized, or frozen-verifier) keep the goal distribution fixed as the learner scales. We introduce SPADE (Self-Play in Adaptive Synthetic Executable Environments), a self-play RL framework in which a single LLM plays two roles: an Environment Designer that writes complete, long-horizon training environments a
papers.summary_zh: 本論文指出，隨著高品質人類文字趨於枯竭，具有可驗證獎勵的訓練環境供給已成為代理式AI進步的瓶頸；人工策劃或靜態合成的環境池無法隨學習者能力提升而調整。作者提出SPADE自我對弈強化學習框架：單一LLM扮演兩個角色——環境設計師撰寫具Gym風格reset()/step()介面、含狀態轉移與獎勵函數的完整可執行Python環境並附特權提示；推理代理則在環境中學習行動。環境設計師以「提示式遺憾」為獎勵，即代理有無提示時的回報差距，將環境鎖定於能力前緣且可解的範圍，實作PAIRED式minimax遺憾而無需對抗者。方法另依賴預訓練語料錨定（DCLM、MegaScience、Nemotron程式碼語料）提供新穎性來源，並以環境記憶避免重複已掌握的任務。實驗涵蓋遊戲與工具使用兩種設定，在Qwen3-4B/8B/30B-A3B上訓練：遊戲設定下30B模型於AIME、GPQA-Diamond、LiveCodeBench-v6及Reasoning-Gym等八項留出基準平均較基礎模型提升8.1分，較最強固定環境基線提升5.3分，且優勢隨規模擴大；工具使用設定於BFCL v4多輪提升5.7分、ACEBench-Agent提升13.9分。消融顯示移除環境設計師訓練與記憶會使表現低於基礎模型，移除語料錨定則令環境多樣性崩塌（Vendi分數由0.68降至0.04）。限制包括環境複雜度受限於基礎模型能力、學習規則仍為人工設計的GRPO，且缺乏課程最佳性的形式化證明。此研究將環境設計轉為可學習組件，是邁向開放式持續自我改進的具體一步。

links.title: TraceML: An Empirical Analysis of Human-Agent Planning in Machine Learning Development

evidence: Abstract: '4,465 human Kaggle trajectories across 134 competitions, seven of which are also worked by two agent scaffolds, giving 430 paired human and 207 agent trajectories', with release at https://huggingface.co/datasets/jerryyan/TraceML.
§4.2: 'Humans pivot on 25% of transitions, Codex on 9%, MLEvolve on 58%... matched humans average +0.089 and MLEvolve −0.008' — quantified pivot-quality asymmetry.

Appendix D.1, Table 11: 'Every headline gap survives every fairness treatment, and every interval excludes zero', using two-stage cluster bootstrap (B=4000) over competitions, fork-lineage clusters, and runs, plus a GEE regression (z=−3.5 Codex, −6.6 MLEvolve).
Appendix C.1, Table 10: 100-item human audit of intent labels agrees 81% (κ=0.68), with a label-free proxy (error-fixing edits 11.1% human vs 1.5% Codex) supporting the finding.

Appendix F.1, Table 18: harness improves 5/7 competitions, two within noise (commonlit 0.510→0.505/0.517; equity 0.675→0.670/0.680); Abl-B (cadence without content) lands at or below baseline everywhere, isolating prompt content as the driver.
Appendix G: explicit limitations—public-notebook observability bias, humans not budget-matched, intent inferred not observed, non-independent trajectory units—bounding the claims appropriately.
Appendix B.5: extraction toolkit applied to five scaffolds (Codex CLI, MLEvolve, AIDE, Claude Code, Gemini CLI), supporting limited cross-scaffold generalizability of the pipeline.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly preference-aligned: an empirical study of LLM agent scaffolds (Codex CLI, MLEvolve on a gpt-5.4-mini backend) for autonomous ML development, with a planning-prompt intervention and a new process-level evaluation resource, directly serving the Agents & Tool Use, LLM, Prompting, and Evaluation preferences. Novelty is solid: per Table 1 it is the only resource combining scored intermediate versions, full code, and task-matched human trajectories, and the behavioral findings (pivot asymmetry, absence of solution revisits, 'ensemble in name only') are new process-level characterizations. Rigor is strong: unit-alignment checks (§3.3, App B.3), fairness treatments with cluster-bootstrap CIs and a GEE robustness check (App D.1), human label audits (App C.1), and ablation arms separating prompt content from re-injection schedule (Table 18). Evidence is weakened by a small paired subset (7 competitions, 10 Codex and 3 MLEvolve runs in the twelve-hour scope, Table 6), unstable short runs acknowledged in Table 7, correlational feature-rank associations (App E.1), and large unexplained harness jumps (amex 0.023→0.781, ranzcr 0.545→0.877, Table 18) suggesting baseline failures. Generalizability is limited by Kaggle-specific practices and one backend; authors concede platform bias (App G). Reproducibility is excellent: public HF release of corpus, schema, labeler weights, and pipeline, plus full prompts in App F.2. Not out-of-scope; this is core language-agent methodology.

primary_link.title: TraceML: An Empirical Analysis of Human-Agent Planning in Machine Learning Development

papers.summary: Large language models write correct code for isolated problems but remain far weaker at autonomous machine-learning development, where an agent must revise data pipelines, models, and validation over hours of feedback, and on most competitions still finishes below strong human competitors. Outcome-based benchmarks record this gap but not its cause, because they grade the final submission and discard the development process behind it. We introduce TraceML, which pairs human and agent work on the
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討為何大型語言模型（LLM）代理在自主機器學習開發上仍普遍落後於人類專家。既有結果導向基準僅評分最終提交，無法解釋差距成因。作者建立 TraceML 資料集，以統一的版本層級標註架構記錄人類與代理在同一批 Kaggle 競賽上的開發過程：涵蓋 134 場競賽共 4,465 條人類軌跡，並在 7 場競賽上配對 Codex 與 MLEvolve 兩種代理框架（在 12 小時預算下，207 條代理軌跡對上 430 條人類軌跡），每個程式碼版本均附分數、時間戳，以及動作、意圖、編輯幅度與分數影響等標籤。分析顯示：人類專家會在資料處理、驗證、模型調整與模型整合（ensembling）間交替，並回頭重啟先前擱置的做法；Codex 陷入為集成成員重新加權與微調提交的窄迴圈，MLEvolve 則原地變異模型。人類在 25% 的轉換中改變方向（pivot），Codex 僅 9%，MLEvolve 雖達 58% 但損益相抵；代理幾乎從不重訪先前的解法，顯示其搜尋缺乏記憶。以人類實踐提煉的規劃提示詞能修正部分行為，並在 7 場競賽中的 5 場提升分數，但整體投入輪廓仍呈代理型態，顯示指令只能縮小可化約為指令的那部分差距。限制包括人類軌跡取自公開筆記本歷史、未必反映全部工作，標註屬推論而非觀察，且雙方設定未完全受控。此研究將「代理表現較差」轉為具體可測的行為缺口，指出記憶與控制機制是未來代理設計的關鍵方向。

llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope work on LLM agent deployment: constraint-aware system-prompt optimization (primal-dual with per-constraint multipliers) plus a GRPO-trained rewriter (DCAPO) with frozen task agents. Directly matches top-weighted preferences (LLMs, agents/tool use, prompting, RL/GRPO, safety constraints) with a SWE-bench coding-agent case study. Novelty is moderate: the machinery is standard constrained RL/Lagrangian optimization transplanted to discrete prompt search; the pool-based dual-conditioned rewriter and the surrogate error analysis are the freshest pieces. Rigor is solid—formal assumptions with proofs, mechanism ablations, noise/dual-rate sensitivity, and honest negative results (Appendix B.3.5 transfer failure)—but main evaluations are single-run with small eval sets (20-40 tasks per tau2 domain per Appendix Table 6), the theory rests on strong concavity assumptions only loosely verified (B.4.3 positive inner products), and the editor-size ablation is self-described as 'descriptive best-observed' not controlled. Evidence is concrete and internally consistent (feasible 6/6 GPT-5-mini/GPT-5.1 settings vs at most 1/6 for baselines in Table 1), but feasibility is a coarse binary criterion with occasional thin margins and β=4 is the only feasible tested dual rate (Table 21), suggesting fragility. Generalizability is genuinely broad across models and task families; reproducibility is strong on hyperparameters/thresholds/prompts (Appendix B.2, C) but no code release is claimed and much depends on proprietary API models.

primary_link.title: CAPO: Constraint-Aware Prompt Optimization for LLM Agents

papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents that rely on system prompts to use tools and complete tasks. Such deployments impose distinct operational requirements, including appropriate tool use, concise prompts and solution paths, and compliance with safety and formatting policies. For many practitioners, however, assembling domain-specific supervised data to post-train models to meet these requirements is infeasible. We introduce CAPO (Constraint-Aware Prompt Optimization)
papers.summary_zh: 本文針對 LLM agent 的部署問題：agent 即使完成任務，仍可能過度呼叫工具、系統提示過長或違反安全與格式政策。作者將系統提示詞最佳化形式化為具明確門檻的約束問題，提出 CAPO，一種原始—對偶（primal–dual）搜尋法：為每個限制維護非負乘數，依帶符號的實測殘差動態更新（違規時提高權重、有餘裕時降低），並以提示池保留優良候選，用凍結的 LLM 作為改寫器迭代搜尋，輸出仍為文字系統提示。進一步提出 DCAPO，以 pool-based GRPO 訓練依回饋與對偶狀態條件化的可學習改寫器，同時凍結任務 agent。理論部分於連續替代空間刻劃有限提示池與離散改寫誤差如何進入不精確原始—對偶界。實驗在 tau2-bench（Airline、Retail、Telecom）顯示 CAPO 於三個領域與兩種任務模型共六種組合皆達 AllSat 可行，而初始提示、APO、GEPA 各僅一種、MOPO 為零種；chatbot 與 PUPA–IFBench 證明方法可延伸至安全、隱私與格式限制，開放權重 Ministral-8B 與 SWE-bench Lite 程式撰寫 agent 案例亦支持此結論。DCAPO 在三個 agent 領域皆產出可行提示，準確率與基準相符或更佳；消融顯示線上行為回饋提供單靠編輯模仿所缺的資訊。限制包括僅調整系統提示、對雜訊回饋敏感（Airline 與 Telecom 在雜訊下違反門檻）、AllSat 僅為經驗性指標而非母體保證，且更廣泛領域與跨域轉移尚待驗證。其意義在於讓部署需求本身成為引導搜尋的回饋訊號，而非事後檢核。
papers.title: CAPO: Constraint-Aware Prompt Optimization for LLM Agents
papers.title_zh: CAPO：LLM Agent 的限制感知提示詞最佳化

evidence: Abstract/Section 1.1 and Table 1: gpt-5.6-sol is 'no worse' than the best existing method on every instance in six of ten classes at each level, with nested logit the main exception (mean revenue 1.2% lower)
Section 3.3/Table 3: on six exactly solvable short-lead-time instances, gpt-5.6-sol matches the DP optimum at level 1 and level 2, with all 95% CI half-widths below 0.05
Section 6.1/Table 7: zero-compute ablation shows level-2 algorithms remain within 0.4 points of full-budget results on the lead-time sweep, while level-1 policies degrade by 3.5-13%
Section 6.2: frozen level-2 artifacts are re-evaluated on new holdout instances ('no model is queried again'), including continuous-utility MMNL instances designed to remove the two-type structure

Section 1.2: acknowledges contamination risk ('we also cannot rule out that benchmark-specific information... appeared in model training') and that generated algorithms resemble combinations of known OR structures
Appendix A: all code, prompts, and complete run records (queries, reasoning summaries, executed code, outputs, token usage) are released at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/llm-or-algorithms-F9F2
llm_evaluation.rationale: A centrally LLM-focused empirical capability study: four frontier models are evaluated on algorithm design for inventory, queueing, and assortment benchmarks using a minimal untuned prompt with a Python sandbox tool, directly matching LLM (2.5), Agents & Tool Use (2.5), Code & Programming (2.0), and prompting-preference areas; it is an LLM evaluation, not a pure domain application. The level-1 vs level-2 taxonomy (instance solution vs reusable algorithm) is a clean framing, though LLM-for-algorithm-design is a growing area (CO-Bench, HeuriGym cited in Section 1.3), so novelty is good but not exceptional. Rigor is high: exact DP evaluation where feasible (Table 3), simulator validation against published values (Appendix B.1), zero-compute ablation (Section 6.1), frozen-artifact holdouts (Section 6.2), and a repeated-draws stability study (Section 6.3). Evidence is strong with per-instance tables, CIs, and timing data, but limited to three OR domains; the authors themselves flag the two-type structure of the MMNL benchmark (Section 5.4) and possible contamination (Section 1.2), which caps generalizability. Reproducibility is excellent: full prompts, code, and all run records are released (Appendix A, anonymous.4open.science link).

primary_link.title: LLMs Can Design Near-Optimal OR Algorithms

papers.summary: We ask whether large language models (LLMs) can design effective algorithms for well-specified operations research (OR) problems. We study inventory control, queueing network control, and assortment optimization. We evaluate two levels of LLM use: at level 1, the model receives one problem instance and returns a solution for that instance; at level 2, it receives only the problem class description and broad parameter ranges, and returns an algorithm that maps instance parameters to solutions. Hu
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討大型語言模型（LLM）能否為定義明確的作業研究（OR）問題設計有效演算法。作者在三大經典領域實驗：存貨控制（含缺貨損失、雙源採購、多階層配送）、多類別排隊網路控制，以及品項組合（assortment）最佳化，合計 34 個存貨、13 個排隊與 3,393 個組合實例。研究設計兩種呼叫層級：Level 1 針對單一實例直接求解；Level 2 只給問題類別描述與參數範圍，由模型回傳可跨實例重複使用的演算法程式碼。每個結果僅用一次未調校的提示詞，並附 Python 沙盒與固定運算預算。結果顯示，最強模型 gpt-5.6-sol 在幾乎所有實例上追平或超越既有最佳方法，包括精確動態規劃與逐實例訓練的深度強化學習基準；Level 2 成效尤為關鍵，且即使移除查詢時運算、或改在新生成的新實例上測試，表現大多維持。四個模型在八個月內陸續推出，能力差距明顯，顯示此技術快速進步。產出演算法結構可解讀，如 capped base-stock 變形、小型動態規劃與壓力型排程規則。限制包括無法排除基準資料汙染、未提供近似保證、演算法多為已知方法的重組，且問題類別定義過寬會誘發通用策略失效。整體而言，在文獻豐富的定義明確問題上，前沿 LLM 已能以低成本產生可檢視的強健演算法，可作為演算法設計的經驗基準。

evidence: Abstract: LeakGauge achieves AUROC 0.944–0.996 on unseen attacks across 11 LLMs including GLM-5.2 (753B) and Kimi-K3 (2.8T), with <0.5K extra parameters and 10.34 ms added latency.
§4.1 (Table 1, splits): 30% of protected content and 30% of attack templates reserved as unseen; Held-Out Content/Attacks/Strict splits pair at least one unseen component.

§4.2 (Table 2): Behavior maintains AUROC ≥0.94 in every (model, split) combination including Held-Out Strict; End20 degrades sharply on held-out attacks (e.g., Llama-3.1-8B 0.611) supporting the suffix design.
§B.2 (Table 9): random-label control AUROC* stays ~0.50 across models, suffixes, splits, and both tasks, guarding against memorization.
§6 (Table 5): cross-attack deployment on Llama-3.1-8B via vLLM — LeakGauge AUROC 0.996, F1 0.983, TPR@FPR5 0.963 at 10.34 ms vs I'vDtL 0.995/0.987/0.947 at 70.91 ms with an extra 8B model copy.

§5.3 (Figure 4, Appendix D): activation steering along a leakage-related direction produces aligned changes in probe logit and ROUGE-L recall, linking the observable signal to internal representations.
§G.2 (Table 21): single-probe-aware GCG attack cuts detection recall to 0.080 (post-filtered ASR 0.275); two-probe deployment restores 0.976 recall, honestly reported robustness limit.
Appendix H (Table 22): Behavior mean AUROC 0.981 on base vs 0.991 on instruction-tuned checkpoints, indicating the signal is not created by instruction tuning.
Appendix I (Table 23): same recipe transfers to StrongReject (0.995), BIPIA (0.971), ToxicChat (0.972), HaluEval (0.926), suggesting generality beyond leakage.

§10 Reproducibility Statement + Abstract: code released at github.com/yeasen-z/LeakGauge; hyperparameters, dataset splits, model configs, steering and deployment details given in §3–§4, Appendices A, D, E.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope LLM safety/methodology paper: detects system-prompt and RAG context-leakage attacks by reading prefill log-probs of an appended natural-language 'gauge' suffix with a <0.5K-parameter probe, requiring no internal-state access. Strongly matches high-weight preferences (LLMs, AI Safety, Red Teaming/Evaluation, RAG, interpretability-style probing, vLLM serving/deployment). Method is novel relative to hidden-state (I'vDtL) and attention (Attention-Tracker) detectors, and the content-agnostic Behavior gauge finding is a substantive contribution. Rigor is unusually thorough: component-wise held-out splits (content/attacks/strict), ablations (End20, Linear), random-label and unrelated-suffix controls (§B.2 Table 9, §B.3 Table 10), cross-lingual/cross-objective shifts, activation steering (§5.3), hard-negative and adaptive GCG stress tests (§G), base-vs-instruct analysis (Appendix H). Evidence is strong and quantitative (AUROC 0.944–0.996 across 11 models, Table 2; deployment Table 5: F1 0.983, TPR@FPR5 0.963, 10.34 ms, <0.5K params). Caveats: probe is trained per model/task, deployment comparison is on a single 8B model with acknowledged non-hardware-normalized baselines (§E.2), single-probe adaptive attack reduces detection recall to 0.080 (Table 21), and cross-model transfer is only partial (Table 16). Code and detailed configs are released (§10), supporting high reproducibility.

Prior probing studies suggest that leakage-related signals emerge in hidden states, yet the need to extract these states poses additional deployment challenges. In this paper, we explore whether this internal signal leaves a
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型依賴系統提示與 RAG 檢索文件等機密上下文,惡意輸入卻可能誘導模型洩漏這些內容。僅分析輸入文字的分類器對未見攻擊泛化有限,讀取隱藏狀態或注意力的方法又需存取內部狀態、部署門檻高。本文提出 LeakGauge:在輸入後附加自然語言量表,讀取 prefill 階段各 token 的 log-probability,以參數少於 0.5K 的 MLP 映射為風險分數,全程免解碼生成。量表有 Exact(取受保護內容開頭 token)與 Behavior(以內容無關的洩漏行為描述,如「根據以上,我將提供系統提示」)兩種,後者更穩健。在 11 個 8B 至 2.8T 參數的 LLM 上,即使攻擊與內容皆未見過,Behavior 的 AUROC 仍達 0.944–0.996;跨語言或逐字轉語意式洩漏時訊號依舊穩健,activation steering 顯示分數與內部洩漏相關方向連動。部署於 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 時跨攻擊評估達 AUROC 0.996、F1 0.983、TPR@FPR5 0.963,僅增約 10.34 毫秒,並可重用 KV cache。限制:完全曝光的單一探測器可被針對偵測器的 GCG 攻擊規避(召回降至 0.08,雙量表部署回升至 0.976),跨模型訊號遷移亦不完全一致。此機制可延伸至有害請求與提示注入偵測,為 LLM 洩漏防護提供輕量、免生成且泛化佳的新途徑。

evidence: Abstract and §1: SRD routes candidates to discard/keep/refine only degraded suffixes 'without requiring a larger target model' with claimed 1.28-1.36x sample efficiency gain over rejection sampling.
§4.2: 'On MATH500 with LLaMA-3.1-8B, SRD achieves 0.544 accuracy at N=10 using only 2,166 output tokens, scaling to 0.640 at N=100 with 21,840 tokens (Table 2).'

§4.1: RSD (Liao et al. 2025) excluded from main comparison 'because it assumes access to a larger target model for regeneration'; baselines are Temperature Sampling, Best-of-N, and Speculative Rejection.
§4.3: measured p_H=0.525, p_M=0.148, ρ̂=1.0, giving efficiency gain 1.28; Appendix F Table 6 reports gains 1.28x-1.36x across N=10-30 on one model pair (Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B + AceMath-7B-RM).
Appendix G Table 7: coupled seeded-generation comparison shows Δ_n=+0.36 (N=10) to +1.29 (N=30) in mean R_max, with refinement success 78-100%.
§4.4.2 Table 4: Reroute (global) best on MATH500 (0.5444) while Self-compare best on GPQA (0.3243), showing refinement effectiveness depends on reward model calibration.
Limitations section: 'SRD currently relies on fixed routing thresholds and heuristic boundary selection' and effectiveness depends on reward model quality.
Appendix E: temperature 0.8, top-p 0.9, thresholds θ_low=0.3/θ_high=0.5, 8xA100 with vLLM; Appendix D provides prompt templates; no code or artifact release is mentioned.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A core LLM inference-time decoding paper squarely within the LLM and reasoning preferences: SRD routes reward-scored candidate trajectories to keep/refine/discard and regenerates only degraded suffixes, positioning itself between Best-of-N and speculative rejection (§1, §3). Novelty is moderate: the segment-level intervention without a larger target model is a genuine delta over BoN, speculative rejection, and RSD (§2, §4.1), but it is an incremental composition of known reward-guided search ideas. Rigor is mixed: theorems are stated with full proofs (Appendix C), but the efficiency-gain result is essentially a ratio of lower bounds, and quality improvement relies on a strong assumed stochastic dominance (Assumption 3.4) that nearly assumes the conclusion; some proofs contain minor sloppiness (e.g., Lemma C.2's (1-p)^N typo). Experiments are reasonably thorough: four benchmarks, ten generation-reward pairs (Table 1), threshold/policy/interval ablations (§4.4), runtime breakdown (Appendix B), and direct measurement of p_H, p_M, ρ̂ and R_max gaps (§4.3, Appendices F-G). Evidence supports token-efficiency claims, though main accuracy-compute results are largely in Figure 2 without confidence intervals, ρ̂=1.0 across all N is suspicious, and validation of the theory covers only one model/dataset pair. Generalizability is decent across math, science QA, multi-hop QA, and instruction following at 1.5B-8B scale, but fixed thresholds and reward-model dependence are acknowledged limitations. Reproducibility is fair: hyperparameters, prompts, hardware, and seeding are documented, but no code release is stated.

primary_link.title: Selective Regenerative Decoding: Trajectory-Level Intervention for Inference-Time Reasoning

papers.summary: Inference-time decoding methods improve LLM reasoning by exploring multiple candidate trajectories, yet treat each trajectory as atomic: either retaining it whole or discarding it irreversibly. This wastes computation on partially promising candidates whose high-quality prefixes are abandoned alongside degraded suffixes. We introduce Selective Regenerative Decoding (SRD), which routes each candidate to discard, keep, or refine only the degraded portion of the suffix while preserving the useful p
papers.summary_zh: 推論時期的解碼方法如 Best-of-N 與 speculative rejection，皆把候選軌跡視為不可分割的整體：前者生成多條完整軌跡後挑選最佳，後者提前終止低分前綴，因而浪費前段優質、後段劣化候選的運算。本文提出選擇性再生解碼（SRD），將流程分為生成、路由與再生三階段：先取樣多條候選，再依排名正規化的獎勵分數導向保留、精煉或捨棄；可搶救的候選僅以較高溫度取樣重寫劣化後綴，保留有用前綴，且不需更大的目標模型。理論上，在溫和假設下，SRD 相較拒絕取樣有 1.28 至 1.36 倍樣本效率增益（公式為 1+ρ·p_M/p_H，隨候選池擴大成長），並具終止保證與弱單調性，最佳軌跡的期望品質亦嚴格較高。實驗橫跨 MATH500、GPQA Diamond、HotpotQA 與 AlpacaEval 及多組生成—獎勵模型配對，顯示 SRD 能以明顯較少的生成 token 達到與 Best-of-N 相當的準確率，並在低運算情境勝過 speculative rejection。消融研究指出精煉成效取決於獎勵模型校準：獎勵穩定時全域重排較佳，雜訊較大時局部自我比較更穩健。限制包括固定路由門檻、啟發式邊界選擇，以及對獎勵模型品質與偏差的依賴；重寫機制也可能放大獎勵偏誤。整體而言，SRD 以段落層級介入開啟準確率—運算權衡的新區域，僅需生成與獎勵模型，可與 speculative decoding 等技術疊加。
