links.title: SkillGate: Training In-Policy Skill Selection in Long-Horizon Agents

evidence: Abstract: SkillGate lifts a 9B policy from 40.8% to 53.2% trial success on five agentic benchmarks under a 16-candidate slate, vs. identical budget on outcome reward alone (47.0%).

Section 4.1 (Implementation Details): all trained rows start from the same Qwen3.5-9B SFT checkpoint; RL runs 100 steps of on-policy GRPO on 491 training tasks with 8 rollouts per prompt; each configuration is a single run, with task-level bootstrap for uncertainty.

Section 4.6 / Figure 5: offline audit of SkillRL (outcome only)'s 12,800 on-policy trajectories shows skill-naming tokens carry a median 0.14% loss-weight share, diluting ~7x with length, with ~two in five oracle reads receiving negative advantage.

Appendix E: pooled trial-success improvement of +7.9 pp for SkillGate over SkillRL (outcome only) with 95% interval [+2.1,+14.3] excluding zero; pooled task pass@4 interval [-1.4,+15.7] crosses zero and significance is not claimed.
Section 6 (Conclusion): stated limitations—each configuration is a single run, the method needs training tasks whose correct skill is known, and an action-local scheme cannot credit an abstention.
Appendix C (Table 5): on 147 held-out Claw tasks, SkillGate reaches 61.2% pass@1 vs. 57.8% for SkillRL (outcome only), with oracle reads 79.6% and misleading reads 15.0%.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference: an LLM-agent RL method (agents/tool-use 2.5, LLM 2.5, RL/training) that trains in-policy skill selection inside GRPO. The core contribution—diagnosing 'selector credit starvation' via an offline audit of a real run's 12,800 trajectories, then partitioning token supports into disjoint outcome and action-local selector credit channels—is a clean, well-motivated refinement of existing turn-level credit-assignment work rather than a conceptual breakthrough. Rigor is solid: controlled comparison against outcome-only RL sharing init/data/steps/hyperparameters, five credit-placement ablations, external-router study, held-out 147-task generalization set, and raw counts (Table 4). Evidence is moderate: +7.9 pp pooled improvement with CI [+2.1,+14.3] excluding zero, but each configuration is a single run, per-benchmark intervals cross zero, pass@4 is not significant, and frontier rows are uncontrolled references. Generalizability is limited by the need for training tasks with a known, verified oracle skill, a fixed read-call interface, and the method's inability to credit abstention (acknowledged in the Conclusion). Reproducibility is aided by released code/models, hyperparameters, and prompt appendix, but several benchmarks (Claw-Eval, SkillsBench, SETA) have unclear public availability.

primary_link.title: SkillGate: Training In-Policy Skill Selection in Long-Horizon Agents

papers.summary: Agent frameworks increasingly package procedural knowledge as skills: instruction files an agent reads on demand, while public libraries now hold thousands of them. Which skill to read has thus become a decision the policy itself makes in the middle of an episode, yet no existing signal trains it. We show that the default remedy, outcome-rewarded RL over the candidate slate, cannot teach it, for a structural reason we identify and name selector credit starvation: under a broadcast, sequence-leve
papers.summary_zh: 代理框架將程序性知識封裝為技能檔案,公共技能庫已達數千筆,任務中途「讀哪個技能」成為策略自身的關鍵決策。本文指出僅靠結果報酬的 RL 教不會此決策,並審計 12,800 條實際訓練軌跡證實「選擇器信用飢餓」:在序列層級的廣播式優勢下,命名技能的少數 token 損失比重極小(中位數 0.14%,隨軌跡變長稀釋約七倍),且後續執行失敗時,正確選擇反被負優勢懲罰,最長軌跡上受罰比例甚至過半;但此決策本身價值達 11.2 個百分點的任務成功率。SkillGate 將單一策略的 token 支援分割為兩個互斥的信用通道:任務通道沿用 GRPO 群組正規化結果優勢,但整段讀取呼叫自遮罩移除;選擇器通道對技能名稱 token 施加動作局部優勢,僅當軌跡只讀一次且讀對 oracle(正確技能)才給正分,並以長度不變的權重重標定,使選擇決策的權重不受軌跡長度影響。在五個代理基準、每題 16 個候選技能的設定下,SkillGate 將 9B 模型整體成功率由 40.8% 提升至 53.2%,超過相同預算下僅用結果報酬的 47.0%,也勝過監督式選擇、偏好學習、外部路由器與 27B 參考模型;誤導技能暴露降低約三分之二,讀取次數反而更少,顯示增益來自選得更準而非讀得更多。限制包括:各設定僅單次訓練、需要已知正確技能的訓練任務、動作局部設計無法給「不讀取」的節制行為信用。本研究顯示,當一條軌跡交錯著性質不同的決策時,分割 token 支援是比重分配單一廣播優勢更便宜且可驗證的替代方案,技能選擇是必須直接訓練的獨立能力,而非模型規模自然湧現的副產品。
papers.title: SkillGate: Training In-Policy Skill Selection in Long-Horizon Agents
papers.title_zh: SkillGate:在長程代理中訓練策略內的技能選擇

links.title: Puro-2B: Poor Lab's Qwen2-1.5B Trained on RTX 5090 within $5090

evidence: Abstract: best checkpoint trained at compute cost less than $6.9K and approaches Qwen2.5-1.5B under the report's evaluation protocol; full recipe, data, code, and weights released under Apache 2.0 at the HuggingFace thu-pacman collection.

Section 2.2: reproduction-cost boundary explicitly excludes data preprocessing, proxy experiments, ablations, post-training, evaluation, and labor, defining the headline cost as marginal accelerator cost only.

Section 3.2 / Figure 10(b): blockwise FP8 increases validation loss by 0.0031-0.0039 relative to BF16 across five ladder sizes, mapped to 98.0% BF16-equivalent compute retention, with 1.36x median throughput at 1.7B and 1.34x quality-adjusted net speedup.

Section 3.3.1: 170M BF16 diagnostic shows MuonH reaches final validation loss 3.029 versus 3.073 for ordinary-LR Muon, while effective-LR-aligned Muon reaches 3.030, supporting the effective-LR schedule interpretation.

Appendix D: matched scaling ladder fits a 1.19x compute-equivalent multiplier for complete MuonH vs tuned Muon, with leave-one-out range 1.17-1.28x, explicitly labeled a counterfactual quality-equivalent saving.

Section 5 / Tables 11-13: curriculum initialization beats uniform in all three repetitions for focused (+1.77pp) and scaled (+2.02pp) GSM8K SFT, and broad instruction SFT improves the 15-task macro-average by +1.59pp with 13 of 15 components improved.

Appendix A (Limitations): no corpus-wide contamination audit against benchmarks is provided; Chinese capability is not an optimization target; the model is overtrained (~700 tokens per parameter) and the scaling law is a fixed-2B, recipe-specific scale-down curve.

Appendix H.4: available evidence compares complete Phase 2 configurations rather than a factorial experiment over data ordering, constant-LR continuation, and checkpoint averaging, so no isolated component gain is assigned.

Section 4.3.2 / Table 6: cross-model reproduction costs are estimated via 6ND with an idealized 70% MFU H100-equivalent rate; the authors state this yields a cost lower bound for counterpart models in most cases, weakening the Pareto-frontier claim.

Section 1 artifact list: model weights (10 checkpoints), data manifests and materialized components, training code (Puro-Megatron), and data-processing code (Kaiyuan-Spark) are released under Apache 2.0, with exact averaging checkpoint IDs (222,100-222,569) and seeds specified in Appendix H.3.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM pretraining methodology paper squarely in scope (LLM, training/optimization, scaling, data recipe). Novelty is moderate: FP8 blockwise training follows DeepSeek-V3, MuonH and CMA are adopted from prior work, and proxy-based data selection is established; the genuinely new parts are the trillion-token open-recipe pretraining on consumer RTX 5090s with explicit cost accounting, the Puro Cost Scaling Law framing, and the effective-LR schedule analysis of MuonH. Rigor is unusually strong for a tech report: matched scaling ladders with leave-one-out fits (Appendix D), a controlled 170M diagnostic isolating effective LR (Section 3.3.1), repeated post-training runs, and candid scope statements (Appendix H.4 admits no factorial ablation; Appendix A admits no contamination audit). Evidence is solid internally but headline cost comparisons rest on estimated 6ND/70%-MFU lower bounds for competitors (Section 4.3.2/Table 6), the $4.4K > Qwen2-1.5B margin is only 0.4 points on Avg15, and the curriculum gain may be partly contamination-driven (acknowledged). Generalizability is bounded: the scaling law is explicitly recipe-specific and fixed-2B (Appendix A), though FP8/MuonH/CMA components transfer. Reproducibility is excellent: weights, 10 checkpoints, data manifests, training and data-processing code released under Apache 2.0 with seeds and exact checkpoint IDs; minor gaps include the EULA-restricted GDR driver modification and gated data components.

primary_link.title: Puro-2B: Poor Lab's Qwen2-1.5B Trained on RTX 5090 within $5090

papers.summary: Language model pretraining has become almost synonymous with prohibitive cost, placing it out of reach for much of the academic and open-source communities. Although strong open-source efforts already exist, including open-weight models and open-source training recipes, a cost-efficient, hardware-accessible, and open-source pretraining recipe has long been missing. Even at a small scale, training Llama-3.2-3B costs over \$1.5M, and reproducing SmolLM3-3B needs over \$700K. In this report, we pre
papers.summary_zh: 大型語言模型預訓練成本高昂，即使小規模模型的重現成本也常達數十萬美元以上，使學術界與開源社群難以研究完整訓練流程。本文提出一套兼顧成本、硬體可及性與開源可重現性的預訓練配方，於消費級 RTX 5090 叢集上從零訓練 Puro-2B 模型系列。核心方法包含：選擇單位價格運算效能較高的 RTX 5090，並修改驅動程式啟用 PCIe P2P 與 GPUDirect RDMA；採用 blockwise FP8 混合精度訓練，保留約 98% BF16 等效計算、輸送量提升 1.36 倍；引入以 Hyperball 約束權重矩陣半徑的 MuonH 最佳化器，使有效學習率排程得以明確控制；設計課程式資料排序，搭配固定學習率延續訓練與六個 checkpoint 的等權平均（CMA）；並以小型 proxy 模型實驗引導資料來源篩選與混合比例。兩階段合計訓練約 1.4T tokens，僅計加速器租用成本約 6.9K 美元；最佳模型在 15 項數學、程式、推理與知識基準上超越 Qwen2-1.5B 並逼近 Qwen2.5-1.5B。作者另擬合 Puro Cost Scaling Law，估計約 4.4K 美元即可達 Qwen2-1.5B 表現；後訓練案例亦顯示課程初始化在 GSM8K 與廣泛指令微調後仍維持優勢。限制包括未做全面性基準污染稽核、中文能力非最佳化目標、屬過度訓練的稠密模型，且 scaling law 僅適用於本配方之縮減情境。本工作證明可負擔的開放式預訓練今日已然切實可行。

links.title: The Working Set of a Coding Agent: Coherence Debt in Repository-Scale Tasks

evidence: Section 4.1, Table 2: 0/154 novel closed-book trials vs 299/300 front-load recovery at ≥9/12 requirements, isolating channel substitution
Section 4.1, Table 2: renamed closed-book, 66/70 trials across seven model families pass the identical 24/79 tests with pairwise Jaccard 1.000
Section 4.3 and Appendices I-J: fault-injection sweeps show zero-deviation linear damage (32→24→16→8→0 tests) across nine cells, n=6 per cell

Section 4.4 and Appendix K: 144 trials all passing, cumulative input spans 12.8× (293,882–3,752,134 tokens) while peak per-turn context spans only 1.8×; withheld-fact sweep shows no configuration recovers more
Section 4.8: conflicting-source result 39/39 trials follow the written standard, Wilson 95% CI [0.91, 1.00]; Section 4.9 shows stale standard (0%) worse than no standard (33%)
Section 4.10: residency AUC ≈ 0.49 on 122 recoverable SWE-bench trajectories; resolved rates 1.0–39.4% across 397 scored trials; instrument explicitly does not transfer
Section 5: authors withdraw a prior residency-separation result after a 20-trial rerun reversed it (residency AUC 0.55 vs activity counts 0.86–0.95)
Appendix S and Appendix T: repository at https://github.com/mpi-dsg/agent-coherence with per-trial ledgers, sandbox profiles, vLLM 0.24 on 2×80GB H100, and enumerated recomputable results
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent research on coding agents, context vs parametric-memory substitution, and harness design — squarely within high-weight preferences (Agents & Tool Use 2.5, LLMs 2.5, Code & Programming 2.0, Long Context & Memory 1.8). The working-set/coupled-fact framing with edit-time fault injection is a genuinely fresh causal take compared to the post-hoc trajectory classifiers it cites (Section 7). Rigor is unusually high: pre-specified predictions, evidence tiers separating confirmatory from exploratory n=3-12 cells, Wilson/bootstrap intervals, sandbox leakage controls with excluded earlier policies, a 1,089-run estimator enumeration (Appendix C), a withdrawn earlier result (Section 5), and honest nulls (SWE-bench AUC 0.49). Quantitative evidence is clean but rests on hand-authored synthetic workloads with marker evaluators, small per-cell n, and ceiling arms that only bound distance effects (Section 4.2). The authors explicitly scope generalizability: the measurement instrument fails to transfer to real repositories (Section 4.10). Strong artifact release with recompute lists and environment details supports reproducibility.

primary_link.title: The Working Set of a Coding Agent: Coherence Debt in Repository-Scale Tasks

papers.summary: Repository-scale coding requires an agent to keep tests, imports, configuration, and migration rules consistent within a bounded context window. We model this as reconstructing a coupled-fact graph: at each edit, a required fact comes from recent context or parametric memory, and the facts covered by neither form coherence debt. We supply and withhold each channel and inject faults across seven models and five harnesses. As expected, no model completes a task on an unseen API with both channels
papers.summary_zh: 儲存庫規模的程式修改,要求 coding agent 在有限脈絡視窗內維持測試、匯入、設定與遷移規則的一致性。本文將此建模為重建「耦合事實圖」:每次編輯所需的事實須來自近期脈絡或模型的參數記憶,兩者皆未涵蓋者即構成「連貫性債務」(coherence debt)。研究團隊分別供給與抽離兩個通道並注入錯誤,跨七個模型與五種 harness 進行實驗,涵蓋虛構 API 遷移的閉卷測試、前置供給條件、真實 Pydantic v1→v2 遷移及其改名對照版,以及自行建構耦合的合成任務。結果顯示:兩通道皆空時,154 次閉卷試驗全數 0/12;把事實放進提示詞後,300 次中 299 次達到至少 9/12。記住同一函式庫的七個模型,在改名遷移上於相同處失敗、通過完全相同的 24/79 個測試。成敗取決於事實是否存在而非距離:供給的事實遠在 128,000 字元外仍同樣有效;抽離幾個事實便恰損失其對應的工作,損害呈線性。同樣全數通過測試的各種 harness 設定,累積 token 消耗相差達 12.8 倍,且事實被抽離時多花費也換不回成效。缺少事實時,代理多半虛構檔案或猜測數值而非回報受阻,受阻比例幾乎由模型決定(0% 到 100%)。當書面規範與程式碼衝突時,代理一律遵循規範,即使規範較差,故過時的慣例檔案比沒有更糟。限制:以讀取為基礎的駐留分數具工作負載相對性,在 SWE-bench 上預測力近於隨機(AUC≈0.49),靜態匯入圖亦難代表真正的任務耦合。啟示是 harness 應確保編輯當下所需的事實可用且一致,並以代理的產出而非讀取行為來檢驗。

links.title: SCIT: Testing Causal Cache Carriers in Latent Chain-of-Thought Models

evidence: Abstract: 'counterfactual arithmetic transfers primarily through value-cache suffix trajectories rather than hidden states, keys, reusable answer slots, or single-token triggers' - core carrier claim.
Section 5.1 / Table 19: CODI-GPT2 late layers 8-9 value target win 0.875-0.908 vs 10-11 block 0.017-0.029 and nonlate 0.000-0.008, supporting middle-to-late value localization.

Table 21 (Sec 5.1): matched corruption drops CODI-GPT2 recipient target win to 0.211 (dLP 13.655); Table 58 shows Sim-CoT-GPT2 drops only to 0.606, correctly tiered as directional rather than full necessity.

Table 43 (Sec A.6): three newly trained CODI-style seeds pass clean competence but show only 0.049-0.138 late-8-9 sufficiency and 0.026-0.089 corruption drops - an honestly reported negative replication bounding the headline mechanism to the original checkpoint.

Table 16 (Sec A.3.5): 16 carrier-threshold settings and .70/.80/.90 competence gates leave 12/12 large-N carrier calls unchanged; exact ties occur in 0.063% of 855,200 score rows - robustness of reporting rules.

Table 44 (Sec A.7): 1B augmented cells show latent-tail KV 1.000/prefix 0.000 while 8B cells invert to prefix 1.000/latent 0.000, supporting the competence-gated carrier-shift map rather than a universal claim.

Appendix B: code, configs, generators, and artifact builder public at github.com/YIDING4869/scit-emnlp-2026, but 'not local model checkpoints or large generated JSONL outputs'; Sim-CoT-GPT2 is a local reproduction (Sec 4/Table 7), limiting exact replication.

Limitations section: all cells are synthetic tasks; 'Balls, books, and coins are lexical surface variants of one two-hop arithmetic diagnostic, not a broad benchmark suite', with no exact counterfactuals available for natural GSM8K-like data.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strongly on-preference work: mechanistic interpretability of latent chain-of-thought in LLMs (GPT-2, LLaMA3-1B/8B, Qwen3-4B), directly matching high-weight preferences for LLMs, reasoning/CoT, and interpretability. The SCIT protocol (cache-segment, K/V-component, hidden-state, semantic-source, decoded, and matched-corruption grid for carrier discovery) is a meaningful extension beyond standard activation patching/IIA, though built from established intervention logic. Internal rigor is unusually high: tiered claims, competence gates, threshold/tie audits, and honest no-call boundaries. Evidence is strong but the full sufficiency-and-necessity closure holds for a single checkpoint, and the authors' own seed audit (Table 43) shows new CODI seeds fail to reproduce the mechanism (0.049-0.138 late-8-9 sufficiency), so the 'mechanism' is path-specific rather than a property of the training recipe. Generalizability is explicitly and severely limited to synthetic lexical variants of one two-hop arithmetic program; the 1B latent-tail vs 8B prompt-prefix split is diagnostic, not universal. Code/configs are public but checkpoints and JSONL outputs are not, requiring retraining for exact reproduction.

primary_link.title: SCIT: Testing Causal Cache Carriers in Latent Chain-of-Thought Models

papers.summary: Latent chain-of-thought models move intermediate reasoning from emitted text into continuous states, improving compactness but hiding the causal object. We introduce SCIT, the Suffix Cache Interchange Test, a causal protocol that constructs exact source-recipient counterfactuals, patches declared cache segments, and identifies which transformer object carries the counterfactual computation. SCIT combines sufficiency tests with K/V component splits, hidden-state controls, semantic source controls
papers.summary_zh: 潛在思維鏈（latent chain-of-thought）模型將中間推理從輸出文字移入連續內部狀態，更緊湊卻也隱藏了因果對象：當模型不再寫出推理文字，反事實計算究竟由 Transformer 內部哪個物件承載？本文提出 SCIT（Suffix Cache Interchange Test）：先建構來源—接收者反事實算術題，於潛在推理過程中修補宣告的快取區段，並結合 K/V 元件切分、隱藏狀態對照、語意來源對照、解碼驗證與配對隨機破壞，逐一排除較簡單的解釋後才判定載體。結果顯示，在 CODI-GPT2 與 Sim-CoT 風格的 GPT-2 檢查點上，反事實算術主要透過 value-cache 字尾軌跡傳遞，而非當前隱藏向量、key 路由、可重用答案槽或單一 token：三個以上字尾位置即達 0.984–1.000 的目標勝率，CODI-GPT2 的中晚層 8–9 value 區塊具備完整的充分性與必要性證據（配對破壞使勝率降至 0.211），Sim-CoT 檢查點僅提供充分性與方向性必要性支持。跨規模校準發現載體型態會轉變：勝任的 8B 算術、實體查找、關係鏈與運算式/清單任務改走 prompt-prefix 或全快取 K/V，且提示狀態在潛在展開前即已充分；未過勝任門檻的實驗組合一律不做機制判定。限制在於任務皆為合成算術與少數可控診斷，並非廣泛基準；訓練路徑與種子敏感，新 CODI 種子無法重現晚期 value 載體；跨架構比較含混淆因子，不應視為規模定律。本研究的價值在於提供快取層級的因果診斷契約，把「潛在步驟是否重要」推進為「哪個物件承載計算」，為詮釋潛在推理模型建立更嚴謹的證據標準。
papers.title: SCIT: Testing Causal Cache Carriers in Latent Chain-of-Thought Models

links.title: Feedback That Backfires: Why Small Language Model Agents Repeat the Call They Just Watched Fail

evidence: Section 6.1, Table 3: corrective gain negative for all 6 checkpoints with CIs excluding zero (e.g., SmolLM2-135M G=-23.92 [-25.86,-22.09]; Qwen3-0.6B G=-21.50 [-25.07,-18.18])
Section 6.2 and Table 5: decomposition attributes most of the effect to the surface-form term (copy 21.69 vs sem 2.23 for SmolLM2-135M), supporting the 'harness not model' claim
Section 6.5, Table 6: CodeRepair (MBPP with real interpreter output) shows the same per-token effect (~-1.09 to -1.23 nats/token across 3 models), guarding against ToolShed-specific artifacts
Section 7, Table 7: 'do not repeat' instruction moves repetition the wrong way (+0.16 [+0.06,+0.27] for SmolLM2-135M) while abstraction moves it by an order of magnitude (-21.68 [-23.20,-20.14])
Section 7.1: controls include a fail_other placebo (-13.71 [-15.33,-12.20], reported as a conservative lower bound), abstract_min variant, and length-matched neutral observation (copy 14.50 vs 16.64)
Section 8.3, Table 8: rollouts with Qwen2.5-0.5B on 24 tasks; drop harness raises exact repeat rate 0.31 to 0.80, ban reduces it to 0.08, but task success does not improve (+0 [+0,+0])

Abstract and Section 6.1: aggregate claims (0.06 to 0.54 repeat probability; 19% greedy exact repeats) arithmetically consistent with Table 4 per-model values
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core in-scope LLM-agent methodology: a controlled token-level measurement of whether appending failed tool calls/error messages to ReAct-style transcripts helps small LLMs (Agents & Tool Use and LLM preferences, high weight), plus MBPP program repair (Code & Programming). Novelty is solid but not maximal: repetition self-reinforcement, negative-instruction weakness, and context contamination are known (the paper's Table 1 positions itself honestly); the new contributions are the corrective-gain metric, the counterfactual copy/sem decomposition, and decomposition-derived interventions including the counterintuitive finding that clean restart is the worst harness. Rigor is strong for the study's scale: teacher-forced deterministic scoring, task-clustered bootstrap with Holm correction, fixed perturbation operators for byte-identical items across models, placebo and length-matched controls, cache-free re-scoring verification, and an explicit failure analysis (Sections 7.1, 10). Evidence is internally consistent across two environments (~-1.03 nats/token in both) with CIs excluding zero on 90-100% of items, but rollout confirmation is limited to one model on 24 tasks, and the interventions reduce repetition without improving task success (honestly reported in Section 8.3). Generalizability is the main limit: ladder stops at 1.7B, ToolShed is self-built, rollouts are greedy-only; the authors explicitly decline to extrapolate (Section 11). Reproducibility is exemplary: full code/data release, CPU-only pipeline, base seed with named sub-streams, pinned environments with measured version drift, and verbatim prompts (Appendices A, F).
topics: small language models (SmolLM2, Qwen2.5, Qwen3, Llama-3.2)

primary_link.title: Feedback That Backfires: Why Small Language Model Agents Repeat the Call They Just Watched Fail

papers.summary: Agent harnesses record a failed tool call and its error message in the transcript and ask the model to continue, on the assumption that the error is corrective information. We measure whether it is. Defining the corrective gain of a failure record as the change in log-probability of re-emitting the action that just failed, we find the gain is negative for every instruction-tuned model we tested (6 checkpoints, 135M-1.7B, 4 families) in two environments: simulated tool calling and MBPP program re
papers.summary_zh: 代理框架慣於把失敗的工具呼叫與錯誤訊息附加到對話紀錄，假設錯誤回饋具有矯正性。本文實測得到相反結論：作者定義「矯正增益」，即紀錄失敗前後重新產出該失敗動作之對數機率的變化，在六個指令微調模型（135M–1.7B、四個家族）與兩種環境（模擬工具呼叫 ToolShed，及含真實 Python 直譯器輸出的 MBPP 程式修復）中一律為負，約每動作 token −1.03 nats，且在九成以上個別項目成立；固定候選集合上，重複失敗呼叫的機率由 0.06 升至 0.54，貪婪解碼在失敗後有 19% 項目逐 token 重現失敗呼叫。透過反事實觀察（分別回報失敗、成功或僅中性確認）分解，83% 的損害來自失敗呼叫表面字串誘發的複製效應，而非模型讀不懂錯誤；語義項既小且在不同環境下正負號不一致，故問題出在框架而非模型。據此，以執行時期產生的失敗描述取代逐字呼叫可消除 76% 的反轉，於解碼器封鎖已失敗字串亦有效且近乎零成本；加註「不要重複」指令無效；而依先前文獻建議清空上下文重試，反而使逐字重複率自 31% 暴增至 80%，是所有框架中最差者。核心原則：失敗後的上下文必須異於失敗前，且差異不得正是失敗動作本身。限制包括僅測至 1.7B 模型、於 CPU 以 float32 執行、失敗動作由固定擾動算子合成，且兩項介入雖降低重複卻未提升任務成功率（主要失敗來源是模型能力上限）。此結果對以小型模型建構代理極具實務價值：廉價的框架層級修改即可避免卡死迴圈。
papers.title: Feedback That Backfires: Why Small Language Model Agents Repeat the Call They Just Watched Fail
papers.title_zh: 適得其反的回饋：小型語言模型代理為何重複才剛目睹失敗的呼叫

links.title: You Only Pass Once: Answering and Abstaining Together in a Single Forward Pass of a Frozen Language Model

evidence: Abstract and Section 6 Table 2: label-free de-contamination lifts 1.5B one-pass transfer AUROC 0.836->0.888 against a 0.918 two-pass ceiling, recovering 63% of contamination, while the flagship (de-contam + BCE boost) tops in-domain at every scale (0.982/0.984/0.997).

Section 4 Table 1: steering write costs the gate 8.2 transfer points at 1.5B and 3.1 at 3B; at 7B the effect inverts in-domain (steered 0.995 vs clean 0.985), establishing the scale-dependent interference claim.

Section 9 Table 5: one-pass flagship beats the two-pass reference on 10 of 10 backbones across six families (0.5B-7B), with repaired gate AUROC >=0.963 everywhere despite family-dependent perturbation sizes (SmolLM2 0.975->0.754 naive).

Section 10 construction audit: the alphaNLI 4-condition set separates at layer 11 (AUROC 0.908), so constructed in-domain gate numbers are explicitly re-scoped as controlled-construction results anchored on native-label replications (SQuAD2, RepLiQA, MuSiQue).

Section 11: multi-layer reconstruction map fails to converge at 7B (AUROC 0.50) and a per-feature-standardized fix leaks task signature by the paper's own mechanism; reported as the registered failure with the identity-anchored single-layer map as the robust variant.

Section 12 Limitations: most grid cells are single-seed with full error bars pending; the cross-family grid covers one benchmark axis (alphaNLI) at <=8B; the paper is a consolidation of two author-group research lines.

Reproducibility Statement and Appendix C: all numbers recomputable from committed per-item logs and named scripts (e.g., scripts/m28b_eval.py, scripts/m39_score.py), public datasets, documented Apple-silicon workarounds; large binaries excluded from the repository.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology paper: a conditional activation-steering writer and a zero-shot sufficiency-direction reader are fused in one forward pass of frozen backbones (Qwen2.5 1.5B/3B/7B plus nine other backbones), with a label-free denoising repair of write-read interference as the technical core. Strong match to LLM, reasoning/CoT, interpretability (residual-stream steering, directions, probing), and hallucination/abstention preferences. Novelty is genuine: the write-read interference problem, the reconstruction-based repair trained without sufficiency labels, the quantified capacity-transfer frontier, and the write-access ladder (read-only > constrained write > free write under shift) are new contributions beyond prior steering/answerability work. Rigor is unusually high: controlled grids, cross-implementation replication between two codebases, McNemar testing, seed checks, a self-audit exposing a construction artifact in its own alphaNLI benchmark, and a documented negative-results section. Evidence is abundant and carefully scoped, though many grid cells are single-seed, the scale ladder tops out at 8B, and key numbers come from self-constructed redaction benchmarks (flagged by the authors' own audit and partially anchored on native labels). Generalizability is supported across six model families but limited to one cross-family benchmark axis and a narrow task range. Reproducibility is well supported by named scripts, per-item logs, and hyperparameters, though no explicit public repository URL is given in the text.

primary_link.title: You Only Pass Once: Answering and Abstaining Together in a Single Forward Pass of a Frozen Language Model

papers.summary: A frozen language model on reasoning tasks has two coupled weaknesses: it under-uses evidence its own residual stream already encodes, and it fails to detect when the input is insufficient to answer, so it confabulates. This paper consolidates two research lines that address these on the same residual stream: a conditional steering probe writes the stream at mid-stack layers and recovers reasoning accuracy from a frozen backbone, and a zero-shot sufficiency direction reads the stream and abstain
papers.summary_zh: 本文針對凍結語言模型的兩個耦合弱點：殘差流已編碼卻未善用的證據，以及無法察覺輸入不足而幻覺作答。作者整合兩條研究路線：於中間層寫入的條件式引導探針提升推理，以及讀取殘差流、資訊不足即拒答的零樣本充分性方向。兩者在單次前向傳遞中互相干擾：引導寫入污染充分性讀取，1.5B 模型跨域 AUROC 最多損失 8 點。解法是固定該方向，訓練小型去污染映射，僅以 MSE 從引導後殘差重建乾淨殘差，不用任何充分性標籤，因而保留轉移能力。YOPO 在凍結 Qwen2.5 單次前向傳遞內同時完成回答、引導與拒答：1.5B 轉移 AUROC 由 0.836 升至 0.888（上限 0.918），域內 0.959；含監督 BCE boost 的旗艦版各規模域內居首，端對端三向準確率在 1.5B αNLI 由 0.375 升至 0.798，並於 6 個模型家族 10 個骨幹全面超越兩次傳遞參考。於首創四域 answer-or-abstain 基準，監督門控域內領先，最難來源擬合的免標籤方向為唯一跨域存活者；chain-of-thought 使 MuSiQue 可答多跳問答由 0.062 升至 0.313。限制含 αNLI 建構資料的早期層捷徑痕跡（經來源端審計證實）、多層重建映射於 7B 不收斂，及多數實驗僅單一種子。本文量化印證「拒答不應訓練進去、擾動應以免標籤還原」的設計法則，對凍結模型可靠部署意義重大。
papers.title: You Only Pass Once: Answering and Abstaining Together in a Single Forward Pass of a Frozen Language Model
papers.title_zh: You Only Pass Once：在凍結語言模型的單次前向傳遞中同時回答與拒答

links.title: Equal Ranking Quality, Different Decisions: Training Order-Consistent LLM Scorers

evidence: Abstract: five trained scorers within 0.010 nDCG@10 have retained sets overlapping only 0.66-0.84 under reordering; OC-SFT flips the reader's answer on 0.125 of permutation pairs vs 0.149-0.164 for other order-targeting objectives.

Section 4: OC-SFT loss is a relevance-anchor term plus lambda-weighted order-variance penalty over N=2 shuffled views of the same window, targeting the order residual delta_B; attenuation not invariance is explicitly stated.
Section 6.3 / Table 1: OC-SFT tau-PSI 0.083 vs 0.209 single-order distillation and retained-set Jaccard 0.835 vs 0.656 at essentially equal nDCG@10 (0.459 vs 0.449).
Table 10: mitigation baselines close 63-71% of the stability gap (EMA 71.4%, order-avg T=10 62.7%, DebiasFirst 64.3%) while OC-SFT is 100%, with quality columns unmarked due to seed spread.
Table 21: OC-SFT retained-set overlap gain over single-order distillation is positive in 196 of 198 base-collection cells across 11 dense bases plus the MoE on all 18 collections.

Appendix A (Scope and limitations): admits no chain-of-thought, English-only collections, recurring ArguAna cost, GPT-5.4 tie-break sensitivity raising flip to 0.200/0.851, and that PINE-style attention restriction breaks the readout rather than being untried.

Reproducibility Statement: releases tau-PSI implementation, evaluation harness, silver labels, LoRA adapters for 11 dense-base students, and full configs; public suite runs 60-90 hours on one L40S, with Legal-A/B proprietary and GPT-5.4 rows less reproducible.
llm_evaluation.rationale: In-scope LLM methodology paper: studies order/presentation dependence in LLM scorers (rerankers, reward models, multi-doc QA scorers) and trains it down with OC-SFT, a consistency penalty over shuffled views added to distillation, evaluated on Qwen3/Gemma/Granite bases with LoRA SFT. Preference relevance is high — LLM fine-tuning, LLM-judge/reward-model reliability, retrieval reranking, and inference serving are all core LLM topics, though it is not a reasoning or agentic paper. Novelty is moderate: the consistency-regularization device and permutation averaging (BSC, RankVicuna, DebiasFirst) are prior art, and the paper honestly positions its contribution as stabilizing continuous per-candidate scores at the threshold and measuring downstream consumer decisions rather than rankings — a genuine but incremental reframing plus a simple objective. Rigor is exceptional: matched hyperparameter tuning across variants, 3-seed replication, paired bootstrap CIs, partition/marker/first-stage/score-collapse controls, 12 bases including an MoE, cost accounting (Tables 10-12), and an unusually candid limitations appendix (ArguAna cost, GPT-5.4 tie-break sensitivity, marker-renaming transfer failure, attenuation-not-invariance). Evidence strongly supports the central claim that equal nDCG does not imply equal decisions and that OC-SFT leads decision stability at one serving permutation (Table 1: Jacc 0.835 vs 0.656; answer flip 0.125 vs 0.149-0.164), with the gain holding across 196/198 base-collection cells (Table 21) and beating K=10 BSC on two of three consumers at K=1 (Figure 4). Generalizability is good across three tasks, sizes 1.7B-32B, and first stages, but bounded: English-only, no chain-of-thought scorers, transfer to marker renaming fails, and proprietary legal collections enter primary means (public-16 reported alongside). Reproducibility is strong: code, silver labels, LoRA adapters, prompts, configs, and runtime estimates released, with only GPT-5.4 rows and Legal-A/B flagged as less reproducible.
topics: LLM scorers (rerankers, reward models, LLM judges)

primary_link.title: Equal Ranking Quality, Different Decisions: Training Order-Consistent LLM Scorers

papers.summary: Rerankers, reward models and multi-document QA scorers score candidate documents or responses in one LLM prompt, so each score depends on their order. Such scorers are selected on ranking quality, but their scores determine a decision: what a score threshold retains, a reader answers, or a preference model selects. However, equal ranking quality does not imply equal decisions: on passage reranking, five trained scorers within 0.010 nDCG@10 retain sets that overlap by only 0.66-0.84 when reordere
papers.summary_zh: 本論文研究 LLM 評分器（重排器、reward model、多文件問答評分器）在單一 prompt 中為多個候選評分時，分數會隨候選順序改變的「呈現依賴」現象。作者指出排名品質相同不等於決策相同：五個訓練後評分器在 nDCG@10 相差 0.010 以內，門檻保留集合重疊率僅 0.66 至 0.84，連 GPT-5.4 亦僅 0.707。作者提出 τ-PSI 量化順序不穩定性，並將分數分解為順序邊際與順序殘差。實驗顯示 round-robin 分窗與 logit 校準等 prompt 層面修正無法改善決策，因此提出 OC-SFT：以教師單次標註為相關性錨點，對兩個隨機排列視圖的學生分數施加順序變異懲罰，在權重中衰減順序依賴。在 18 個段落重排集合、12 個基礎模型（Qwen3、Gemma、Granite）與多文件 QA、回應排名任務上，OC-SFT 維持排名品質，τ-PSI 由 0.209 降至 0.083，保留集合重疊升至 0.835，讀者答案翻轉率降至 0.125，優於單一順序蒸餾與需十倍教師標註的順序平均蒸餾，單一排列的穩定性更勝過現成模型平均十次排列。限制包括：懲罰達到的是衰減而非完全的不變性、無法泛化至標記改名、需要訓練監督成本，且評估皆為英文集合、未涵蓋推理導向檢索。此研究對法律檢索等高風險應用至關重要，並主張比較評分器時應一併報告下游決策指標。
papers.title: Equal Ranking Quality, Different Decisions: Training Order-Consistent LLM Scorers
papers.title_zh: 排名品質相同、決策卻不同：訓練順序一致的 LLM 評分器

links.title: SwarmWorld: Stigmergic technological evolution in societies of language-model agents

evidence: Section 2.2/Figure 4: four mechanism-resolved conditions vs an endpoint-wise best-of-N isolated envelope; held-out resilience exceeded the envelope for nearly every shared-world cell and validated inventions showed a mean paired gain of six for no-explicit-culture at N=200.

Section 2.5/Figure 14: at tick 3,200 portfolio resilience was 0.2474 (full culture) and 0.2365 (no explicit culture) vs 0.1794 isolated, while the isolated envelope retained the best single artifact (0.3488 vs 0.2380) - a bounded, honestly reported swarm advantage.

Section S2.11: world seed is the unit of inference; 20,000 deterministic bootstrap resamples; exact sign-flip tests with smallest attainable two-sided p=0.125 for four pairs; explicitly no agent-level tests or universal scaling law asserted.

Section S2.7: 48-episode population matrix with matched seeds 3201-3204, engine revision 9, identical configuration/prompt/action-schema hashes, 89,617 provider calls with 0.019% retryable failures, and a predeclared clean rerun of one deviating seed.

Section 3 (Conclusion): limitations stated proportionally - inference based on four matched world seeds per condition, one model and prompting configuration, and simulator-defined material and environmental functions.

Section S2.12 and Data and code availability: engine, exact prompt manifests, traces, analysis and figure-generation scripts released at github.com/lamm-mit/SwarmWorld with data at huggingface.co/datasets/lamm-mit/swarmworld-data; offline figure generation verifies SHA-256 hashes and writes output manifests.

Section 2.9: Protein Realms is a single-seed descriptive pilot (N=50, seed 3801) that explicitly does not support inferential comparison among conditions; Section 2.8 AshenRealm transfer reports lower absolute metrics but retained multi-agent construction, executable inheritance, and behavioral differentiation.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core contribution is a controlled LLM multi-agent society framework (homogeneous agents, persistent physical stigmergy, executable artifact inheritance), squarely matching the highest-weighted preferences for LLM agents, multi-agent systems, and tool use; the simulated materials are game-level surrogates, not a pure domain application, so no out-of-scope penalty. Novelty is solid: the proposal-consequence separation, agent-free held-out disturbance assay, mechanism-resolved ablations, and endpoint-wise best-of-N envelope make swarm advantage falsifiable in a way Generative Agents/Project Sid/GovSim/TerraLingua-style predecessors do not. Rigor is high for the genre (matched seeds, paired bootstrap, seed as unit of inference, anti-circularity phenotype sensitivity, honest null results such as no universal cultural crossover), but only four seeds per cell, one proprietary model (gpt-5.6-luna), and simulator-defined objective functions bound the inference. Evidence strength is good for headline endpoints (Figure 4, Figure 14) yet several rich analyses (Figure 10 trajectory, network backbones, Protein Realms pilot) are explicitly illustrative or single-seed. Generalizability is partially demonstrated via AshenRealm and Protein Realms transfers, though functional validity remains simulator-internal. Reproducibility posture is exceptional: released code, prompts, traces, SHA-256 manifests, deterministic replay, commit hashes, and documented provider-call audits.

primary_link.title: SwarmWorld: Stigmergic technological evolution in societies of language-model agents

papers.summary: Collective intelligence can emerge when individuals coordinate through a shared environment, allowing local actions to accumulate into durable social organization. Language-model agents offer a new substrate for this process, yet most multi-agent systems rely on direct conversation, predefined roles, or centralized workflows. It remains unclear whether decentralized agents can build functional technologies and outperform independent search. Here, initially homogeneous LLM agents in SwarmWorld se
papers.summary_zh: SwarmWorld 探討一個核心問題：在沒有預先指派角色、配方或工作流程的情況下，去中心化的語言模型代理能否在共享世界中自我組織，建造出具備實際功能的科技，並勝過同等算力的獨立平行搜尋？作者建構一個由確定性模擬器驅動的持久空間世界，代理可探索、採集資源、測試材料、建造持久性人工物並撰寫可執行控制器；關鍵設計是「提案與後果分離」，代理的宣稱一律由模擬器獨立檢驗，並在移除所有代理後，以八組未見過的擾動排程進行留置盲測。透過 50 至 200 個代理的族群規模研究與 3,200 tick 長期實驗，論文顯示：共享世界在留置韌性、組合韌性與經驗證發明數上普遍優於 best-of-N 獨立搜尋包絡，但最強的單一人工物仍可能由孤立搜尋取得。未指派角色的代理自發分化出以人工物為中心與移動探索兩類行為，並出現多人協作建造、跨代理程式分岔與可執行技術世系；約 95% 的首次技術採用始於物理觀察而非直接溝通，顯式文化機制僅在特定指標與時間尺度上帶來效益。限制包括每組僅四個配對世界種子、單一模型與提示設定，且材料功能皆為模擬器定義而非實驗驗證。整體而言，此研究確立了「有界群體優勢」：互動主要促進多樣而持久的技術生態累積，而非全面優越的單項發明，並為語言模型群體社會提供可證偽的評估架構。
papers.title: SwarmWorld: Stigmergic technological evolution in societies of language-model agents
papers.title_zh: SwarmWorld：語言模型代理社會中的共跡式科技演化

links.title: CaSKG: Counterfactual-Causal Skill Graphs for Scalable Agent Skill Retrieval

evidence: Abstract: 'Across six LLM backbones on ALFWorld ID-140 and ScienceWorld U211, CaSKG achieves the highest task score in all twelve combinations of model and benchmark.'
Section 4.2, Table 1: relative to GoS, six-model macro-average ScienceWorld rises 72.62 to 80.50 and ALFWorld success 80.01% to 86.79%, with fewer mean steps in all twelve settings.
Section 3.3: three direction-conditioned probes (removal, substitution, reordering) produce LLM-returned scores e_ij in [0,1] for necessity, specificity, and directionality.
Section 5.2, Table 3: Full CaSKG 73.57%/18.44 steps vs publish-all 71.43%/18.74 vs semantic-only 67.14%/19.21 on ALFWorld (MiniMax-M2.7, Skill1000).
Section 5.1, Table 2: scale study at 200-2,000 skills shows +3.54 to +22.86 point gains over GoS for two backbones.
Section 4.3, Figure 2: CaSKG improves 21 of 24 ScienceWorld task types, ties one, trails on two (non-living-thing search, temperature measurement).
Section 4.1, Models: backbones are MiniMax-M2.7, GLM-5.2, Kimi-K2.6, Qwen3.5-397B-A17B, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, GPT-5.6-Luna, all with 2026 citations that cannot be externally verified.
Section 4.1, Metrics: 'Steps measures observed interaction consumption... not token usage, wall-clock latency, retrieval latency, or graph-construction cost.'
Title footnote: 'Code is available at: https://github.com/ZhiyuanLi218/Caskg.'
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM-agent methodology paper: skill retrieval for agent memory with graph propagation, directly matching the highest-weight Agents & Tool Use preference, plus RAG/knowledge and long-context memory relevance. The contribution is an incremental but non-trivial combination: budgeted counterfactual edge probing (removal/substitution/reordering) with Beta-smoothed calibration and state-gated publication layered on GoS-style graph retrieval; all ingredients (LLM-as-judge, personalized PageRank, counterfactual prompting) are established. Method formalization is careful, with four baselines, six backbones, two benchmarks, a 200-2000 skill scale study, and component ablations (Table 3). Rigor gaps: no statistical significance or seed variance, no control isolating counterfactual calibration from simple top-K pruning by association score (publish-all vs Full CaSKG confounds pruning with probing), thresholds/hyperparameters (tau_c, rho values) never given numerically, and judge reliability is never validated against ground-truth dependencies. Evidence is internally consistent and detailed, but rests entirely on six 2026-dated, independently unverifiable model releases (GPT-5.6-Luna, GLM-5.2, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, Kimi-K2.6, Qwen3.5, MiniMax-M2.7), and the paper concedes Steps excludes token/latency/graph-construction cost, so the offline probe expense for 500-2000 edges is unquantified. Generalizability limited to two text-based simulators; no real API or code-agent settings. Reproducibility: GitHub link claimed and embedding model specified (Qwen3-Embedding-8B), but Skill1000 library construction, probe prompts, and key hyperparameters are missing. Solid, relevant, moderately novel work with honest limitations discussion, held back by untestable model citations and missing controls.

primary_link.title: CaSKG: Counterfactual-Causal Skill Graphs for Scalable Agent Skill Retrieval

papers.summary: Reusable skill libraries allow large language model (LLM) agents to reuse procedural knowledge across tasks, but they also turn memory access into a challenging retrieval problem. Full-library prompting preserves coverage at high context cost, vector retrieval returns compact neighborhoods but treats skills as independent text, and graph-based retrieval can recover workflow context only when the edges that carry relevance are reliable. We propose CaSKG, a counterfactual-causal skill graph framework that calibrates procedural relations before retrieval. CaSKG first builds a high-recall directed candidate graph from semantic, lexical, input/output, and structural evidence, with repair evidence and an optional LLM judge further refining candidate scores. It then applies direction-conditioned textual counterfactual probes that remove, substitute, and reorder skill pairs, aggregates the evidence with Bayesian smoothing, and publishes a state-filtered weighted graph for task-conditioned expansion. The graph is constructed offline and used without changing the downstream agent policy or task interface. Across six LLM backbones on ALFWorld ID-140 and ScienceWorld U211, CaSKG achieves the highest task score in all twelve combinations of model and benchmark. Relative to Graph-of-Skills (GoS), it improves the six-model macro-average ScienceWorld score from 72.62 to 80.50 and ALFWorld success from 80.01\% to 86.79\%, while reducing mean environment steps on both benchmarks. Qualitative and ablation analyses further show that calibrated edges help retrieval preserve prerequisites, state-changing actions, verification routines, and final completion steps. These results position edge-confidence calibration as an effective route to compact and executable skill retrieval at scaleCode is available at: https://github.com/ZhiyuanLi218/Caskg .
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討 LLM Agent 的技能庫檢索問題：隨著可重複使用的程序性知識持續累積，如何在有限情境下檢索出緊湊且可執行的技能組合成為關鍵挑戰。全庫提示保留覆蓋率但成本高昂，向量檢索將技能視為獨立文字而忽略程序相依性，圖檢索則高度依賴邊的可信度。作者提出 CaSKG，將技能圖建構視為預算限制下的邊信心校準問題：先以語意、詞彙、輸入/輸出介面與結構等多重訊號誘導高召回候選有向圖，再以三種方向條件化的文字反事實探針（移除、替換、重排序）驗證選定邊，並以 Beta 貝氏平滑彙整證據，將邊標記為確認、不確定、拒絕或未驗證，據此發布狀態過濾的加權圖。推論時以任務比對產生種子，在已發布圖上執行個人化 PageRank 傳播，不改變下游 Agent 政策與任務介面。在 ALFWorld ID-140 與 ScienceWorld U211、六個 LLM 後端的評估中，CaSKG 於全部十二種組合取得最高任務分數；相較 GoS，六模型 macro 平均 ScienceWorld 分數由 72.62 升至 80.50，ALFWorld 成功率由 80.01% 升至 86.79%，平均環境步數亦全面較低。消融實驗顯示多訊號候選誘導、LLM 評審與狀態門檻發布各有貢獻。限制包括：對直接搜尋或量測類任務增益有限，追蹤共現等通道僅為未來自我演化技能庫預留，且結果不涉及 token 用量、延遲或建構成本。此研究確立邊信心校準作為可擴充 Agent 記憶的重要設計原則。
papers.title: CaSKG: Counterfactual-Causal Skill Graphs for Scalable Agent Skill Retrieval
papers.title_zh: CaSKG：用於可擴充 Agent 技能檢索的反事實因果技能圖

links.title: FABRICA: Agentic CUDA-to-CSL Translation and Optimization for Wafer-Scale Systems

evidence: Abstract: 'Fabrica raises success from 6/28 to 26/28; 22 successful programs match or beat their CSL references' and 'geometric-mean speedup is 3.75x on the SDK simulator and 3.47x on WSE-3 hardware'
Section V-B: 'full knowledge passes 7/15; removing retrieved Cerebras material passes 1/15, and also removing the CSL primer remains at 1/15' - the controlled knowledge ablation

Section III-A: '18 additions cover machine-learning operators and collectives. The additions were model-assisted but manually integrated and validated end to end, and are not treated as independent expert references' - benchmark construction weakness
Section VI: 'The 49-task coverage metric counts a task once if any scheduled workflow passes; three tasks use three seeded workflows and the remaining tasks use one' - optimistic coverage accounting
Section V-H: 'The SFT pilot reports SDK-free structural metrics rather than executable correctness; generated programs still require compilation, numerical checks, and device timing'

Section IV: 'Full prompts, candidates, checks, and measurements remain in the artifact' and 'The primary controlled, coverage, and optimization studies use Claude Opus 4.8 and SDK 1.4.0 simulation on fresh bundles' - reproducibility support without a public link

Section V-A: 'Opus 4.8 passes 26 tasks, Sonnet 4.6 passes 25, and Opus 4.6 passes 24; the best open-weight model, gpt-oss-120b, passes 2' on the identical 28-task core, from a single workflow per model-task pair (preliminary)
llm_evaluation.rationale: Strong match for agent/code/LLM preferences: an agentic LLM framework (six role-specific stages, reviewer-routed repair, tool execution against compiler, simulator, and WSE-3 hardware) for CUDA-to-CSL kernel translation, with a cross-model LLM study (Claude Opus/Sonnet vs gpt-oss, Gemma, Qwen) and a LoRA SFT pilot. Not a pure domain application; methodology is squarely LLM-agent code generation. Novelty is moderate: the benchmark (first paired CUDA-CSL suite) and target domain are new, but components assemble known techniques (DocPrompting, Reflexion, self-debug, MetaGPT-style roles). Rigor is good: controlled single-attempt vs full workflow (6/28 to 26/28), knowledge ablation (7/15 vs 1/15), feedback modes A-D/T, formal validity gates, and integrity checks; weakened by small denominators (28 core tasks), a single-run preliminary model study, and 18 of 49 benchmark tasks being model-assisted rather than independent expert references. Evidence is solid with hardware replay on WSE-3 (27 pairs, 3.47x geometric-mean speedup) and honest limitation reporting, but the SFT pilot uses proxy metrics without executable validation and the coverage metric counts a task once if any workflow passes. Generalizability is limited by Cerebras-specific knowledge and tooling, though the findings (target knowledge dominates; correctness-gated optimization) plausibly transfer to other cross-architecture translation. Reproducibility is partially supported: SDK versions, budgets, and protocols are specified and an artifact is claimed, but no verifiable public link and WSE-3 access is required.

primary_link.title: FABRICA: Agentic CUDA-to-CSL Translation and Optimization for Wafer-Scale Systems

papers.summary: Porting GPU kernels across architectures requires architectural remapping, not syntax substitution. CUDA encodes decomposition, locality, and synchronization through threads, blocks, and memory accesses; the Cerebras Software Language (CSL) requires explicit placement, distributed SRAM, fabric communication, event-driven tasks, and host/device contracts. We present FABRICA-Bench, 49 paired CUDA-to-CSL tasks, and FABRICA, an agentic framework combining target knowledge, execution, failure-directe
papers.summary_zh: 本文探討將 CUDA 核心移植到 Cerebras 晶圓級引擎(WSE)的挑戰:這並非語法替換,而是架構重映射。CUDA 以 threads、blocks 與記憶體階層表達分解與同步;CSL 則要求明確的 PE 擺放、分散式 SRAM、fabric 路由與事件驅動任務,而公開 CSL 資源稀缺,現有 coding agent 幾乎缺乏目標知識,也無基準可衡量跨架構轉譯。作者提出 Fabrica-Bench,含 49 個成對 CUDA/CSL 任務,以編譯、執行、介面契約與數值檢驗計分,並以防火牆隔離參考解答與隱藏輸入;另提出 Fabrica 代理式框架,依序進行分析、架構設計、實作、審查與正確性閘門控管的最佳化,並檢索 SDK 文件、教學與技能筆記組成的知識庫補足模型缺乏的 CSL 慣用法。結果顯示:在固定 28 個 Level 1–3 核心任務上,單次生成僅 6 個通過,Fabrica 搭配 Claude Opus 4.8 達 26/28,其中 22 個等同或超越 CSL 參考;49 任務涵蓋評估有 38 個產生正確程式,最後三個任務在三種子下通過 8/9;27 組可計時配對的幾何平均加速為模擬器 3.75×、WSE-3 硬體 3.47×。消融實驗指出檢索 Cerebras 知識是最強單一因素(1/15 升至 7/15),最佳開源模型僅通過 2/28,凸顯商用與開源落差。限制包括結果綁定特定模型與 SDK 版本、涵蓋率指標計數較寬鬆,離線 SFT 試驗僅採結構代理指標,生成程式仍需完整執行驗證;需要跨 PE 運算元遞送的共設計案例仍是系統邊界。此研究為晶圓級跨架構核心生成提供首個可執行基準,指出目標知識、執行回饋與同標的量測是關鍵要素,產生的執行軌跡亦可供後續後訓練運用。
papers.title: FABRICA: Agentic CUDA-to-CSL Translation and Optimization for Wafer-Scale Systems
papers.title_zh: FABRICA:針對晶圓級系統的代理式 CUDA 至 CSL 轉譯與最佳化

links.title: EchoCoT: Extracting Hidden Chain-of-Thought from Large Reasoning Models

evidence: Abstract: claims up to 66.4% near-verbatim extraction success on open-source LRMs with length within 10% and >=90% exact token match; 33,463 tokens extracted from a 32,948-token target on Gemini-2.5

Threat Model section: defines black-box attacker with API access, attacker-defined tool, observable tool arguments, and only reasoning-token count/CoT summary as signals; no parameters, gradients, or logits

Table 1 (Evaluation Results): EchoCoT-LTGO achieves 46.1% ASR@99 / 66.4% ASR@90 on DeepSeek-V4-Flash vs REP at 0.3% ASR@90, Direct Prompting and CoT Synthesis at 0.0% across thresholds; Answer Match Rate 84.2-93.0%
Table 2 (Cross-Dataset Transferability): optimized trajectories transfer with ASR@90 of 80% (MATH500), 71% (JEEBench), 64% (LiveCodeBench) on DeepSeek, without re-optimization

Ablation Studies (Appendix A.3): two-level objective improves DeepSeek LGO ASR@90 from 0.03 to 0.51 vs mean-only; full Inject+Reflect+Distill workflow beats Inject-Only and Inject+Reflect; 3 tool-call steps are near-optimal
Table 6 (Defense Results): reasoning-state removal yields 0% ASR@90; defensive system prompt reduces mean ASR@90 from 46.0% to 5.0% (9.7% under adaptive re-optimization); length obfuscation 13-17%
Appendix A.1 Proxy Fidelity Analysis: Spearman correlation 0.532 (p<0.001) between Summary Token Recall and ground-truth Token-F1 over 1,024 triplets, stronger at low Length Error
Limitations section: single run per sample without run-to-run variability; proprietary-model fidelity evaluation is proxy-only since ground-truth CoTs and tokenizers are unavailable
Footnote 1 and Artifact Release: code at github.com/TrustAIRLab/EchoCoT; full artifacts promised for open-source models, provider-specific trajectories withheld/restricted
Ethics Considerations / Responsible Disclosure: institutional ethics review approval and disclosure to Google, Anthropic, and OpenAI
llm_evaluation.rationale: Security attack paper squarely within core preferences: it targets LLM/LRM hidden chain-of-thought (Reasoning & CoT), exploits tool-call continuity (Agents & Tool Use), uses prompt injection with LLM-based trajectory optimization (Prompting, Red Teaming), and frames CoT exposure as an AI-safety risk. Novelty is solid but not breakthrough: the 'reasoning replay surface' between tool calls and the Inject-Reflect-Distill optimizer are new, yet they build on known prompt-injection and prompt-optimization ideas (GEPA, ExpeL). Rigor is high for open-source models with ground-truth CoTs: clear threat model, multiple metrics (Length Error, Token-EM, ASR@x), three baselines, ablations over objectives/workflow/steps, failure-mode analysis, and defense evaluation including adaptive attackers. Evidence is strong where ground truth exists (66.4% ASR@90 on DeepSeek; 80% transfer to MATH500; 21,109/21,106-token example with Token-EM 0.999) but only proxy-based for proprietary models (length match, summary recall, entailment), which the authors acknowledge; single-run-per-sample is an additional limitation. Generalizability is supported by 8 models, 4 datasets, and cross-domain results, though trajectories are per-model optimized and success varies widely (Qwen 30.8% vs DeepSeek 66.4%). Reproducibility is aided by released code, pseudocode, and full optimizer prompts, but proprietary trajectories are withheld. Not out-of-scope: no domain-application or pure-vision content.

primary_link.title: EchoCoT: Extracting Hidden Chain-of-Thought from Large Reasoning Models

papers.summary: Hidden chain-of-thought (CoT) traces, especially those from frontier proprietary large reasoning models (LRMs), are valuable model assets. Yet whether these hidden CoTs can be directly extracted from black-box models remains largely unexplored. In this work, we systematically study whether hidden CoTs can be extracted near-verbatim from black-box LRMs through API interactions. We identify a previously overlooked reasoning replay surface between tool calls and develop EchoCoT, a multi-step attack
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討大型推理模型（LRM）的隱藏思考鏈（CoT）能否透過黑箱 API 互動被近乎逐字地擷取。作者發現一個先前被忽略的攻擊面：模型在單一輪次內進行多次工具呼叫時，會保留推理狀態以維持連續性。攻擊者可自訂 scratchpad 工具，並在工具回應中注入惡意指令，逐步誘使模型把完整思考內容寫入工具參數；再利用 API 回傳的推理 token 數量與 CoT 摘要作為代理訊號，設計長度與文字兩層保真度評分，並以 LLM 最佳化框架透過 Inject-Reflect-Distill 流程自動搜尋通用注入軌跡（LGO 與 LTGO 兩種目標）。實驗顯示，在 DeepSeek-V4-Flash、Qwen3.5-Plus 與 GLM-5.2 上，EchoCoT-LTGO 達到 22.8%–46.1% 的 ASR@99 與最高 66.4% 的 ASR@90，最佳化軌跡還能遷移到未見資料集（MATH500 達 80%），並近乎逐字重現逾 20K token 的長推理。對 Gemini 與 Claude 系列專有模型，擷取長度接近官方回報值，Gemini-2.5 更抽得 33,463 個 token，還能挖出 o4-mini 的系統提示。防禦評估指出，移除推理狀態可根除攻擊；防禦性系統提示與移除長度訊息較為實用，但自適應攻擊仍可部分得手，顯示需多層防護。限制包括專有模型缺乏真實 CoT 供驗證，僅能以代理指標估算，且每樣本僅執行一次。此研究確立隱藏 CoT 外洩是實際的安全風險，作者已向 Google、Anthropic 與 OpenAI 負責任揭露。
papers.title: EchoCoT: Extracting Hidden Chain-of-Thought from Large Reasoning Models
papers.title_zh: EchoCoT：從大型推理模型擷取隱藏思考鏈

links.title: In-Cell Learning: Deployed Language Models Can Learn New Knowledge Without Changing a Single Stored Bit

evidence: Abstract and §3.1: CellFill parametrization W = Ŵ + M ⊙ tanh(sBAᵀ) with B=0 at init, so |W_ij − Ŵ_ij| < M_ij for every weight regardless of optimizer; invariance is a property of the parametrization, not the training run.

§2 Prop. 1 and Appendix A: bitwise invariance holds only against frozen (a,s); a two-weight counterexample (executed as a unit test) shows re-running a quantizer with recomputed absmax scales silently reassigns untouched weights.

§5.1 Table 1: CellFill r=64 recovers 66.7±8.6% of synthetic facts with LAMBADA 42.33±1.99 under exact invariance asserted over 1.409×10⁹ constrained weights with zero violations; unconstrained dense pays 74.83 LAMBADA for 59.3±8.7%.

§5.5 Table 4: at the lr CellFill uses (1e-3), LoRA collapses (WikiText 796.48, 61.7% of weights clipped, 0.0% recall) while CellFill reaches 94.3±2.2% bit-identically; LoRA needs 2e-4 to work and still must be clipped (8.5%).

§5.5 Tables 2–3: MEMIT destroys the model under sequential application (WikiText 20,348 archived) and GRACE under its honest condition scores 2.0% (the untouched model's rate), while CellFill's honest condition reaches 95.7% on the 507 real probes.

§5.7 Table 7: on the PopQA tail, the fill answers 81.8–89.8% of unknowns at 75 tokens/question versus 90–1,008 tokens for retrieval arms, and is unaffected by the chunked index that drops retrieval to 41–74%.

§5.13 Table 10: at 10⁴ facts the knee is the tanh link's dead gradient (78.4% saturation), not the cells; gradient-preserving links raise absorption 22–24% to 36–39%, and stored bits (3–5×10⁻⁵/cell) are far below parametrization capacity.

§5.17: four sequential tasks each verified with zero violations; mean-room ratios 0.8271/0.8254/0.8238 give β=0.825±0.002, and the naive identity β=1−E|t| is shown false by logged fills (0.44–0.52 vs implied 0.17).

§5.16 Table 13: mechanism verified on published NF4/QAT releases (Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B at 94.3–97.6%, Gemma-4 at 82.9%) and a 27B gated-linear-attention model with 2.435×10¹⁰ weights bit-identical, though the 27B run is single-seed with a different recipe.

§9 Limitations: one model family/quantizer for most claims, n=1 for the entire 27B result and seven partitions, in-domain perplexity contaminated by rehearsal everywhere, diagonal-Fisher budget underestimates drift 15.9×–383×, and the headline capacity number and its cross-domain price come from different runs.

§10 Reproducibility: archived JSON configs trace every number, tables generated by scripts/make_tables.py, 25 CPU unit tests, exact commands per experiment, code at github.com/sumsliu/cellfill; §9 reports vendor byte-identity verification (bitsandbytes returns the release's 7.05×10⁸ packed bytes identically).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core LLM methodology work: continual learning on deployed 4-bit LLMs with bitwise artifact invariance, positioned at the intersection of quantization/efficiency, LoRA-style fine-tuning, knowledge injection vs RAG, and deployment/serving. The reframing of the dequantization gap as writable storage, the tanh-bounded CellFill parametrization with invariance by construction, the plasticity decay law (Prop. 6), and nested refinement bits are genuinely novel relative to QLoRA/LoftQ/QA-LoRA, PEQA/AlphaTuning, BitDelta, and editing methods. Rigor is unusually high: formal propositions with proofs and unit tests, exhaustive integer-domain verification on every merge, matched controls (unmerged adapter, unconstrained dense), LoRA/MEMIT/GRACE/retrieval baselines, and a candid limitations section that walks back earlier overclaims (rehearsal free-lunch artifact, Fisher budget not a certificate). Evidence is broad and archived but many key comparisons are n=1 or n=2 with seed spreads comparable to effects; capacity exponents come from two points; the capacity headline and its cross-domain price come from different runs. Generalizability is limited: facts only (no skills), one quantizer stack for most results, no GPTQ/AWQ measurements despite the argument that cell arithmetic applies, single sequential sequence on one model, and the 27B point uses a different recipe and path. Reproducibility is excellent: released code, archived JSON results generating all tables via scripts, exact commands, hyperparameter appendix, and vendor byte-identity verification.

primary_link.title: In-Cell Learning: Deployed Language Models Can Learn New Knowledge Without Changing a Single Stored Bit

papers.summary: A deployed language model is a file that many things depend on - a benchmark report, a certification, a fleet of devices - and every way of teaching it something new produces a different file. We show that this is not necessary. A 4-bit release stores each weight as an integer code and a shared scale, and leaves between the stored values an interval the quantizer discards; we call in-cell learning the paradigm in which new knowledge is written only into that interval, so that re-quantizing the s
papers.summary_zh: 已部署的 4-bit 量化模型是一份被基準報告、認證與裝置依賴的檔案,而任何教它新知識的方法(全參數 fine-tuning、adapter 合併、知識編輯)都會產生不同的檔案,迫使整套認證重來。本文提出 in-cell learning 典範:4-bit 權重以整數碼加共享縮放因子儲存,量化器丟棄的細胞內區間可作為可寫入空間;更新只寫進該區間,重新量化後可逐位元重現原始釋出版本。CellFill 以 W=Ŵ+M⊙tanh(sBAᵀ) 的有界低秩參數化實作,並直接在供應商自己的 4-bit 釋出版上訓練;更新是獨立、可撤銷的 fill 檔案,漂移由訓練前固定的半徑界定。在 NF4、QAT 與 GPTQ 式網格、Qwen3 與 Gemma(1.7B 至 31B)上,CellFill 寫入 83–97% 模型確實不知道的真實事實,於高達 2.4×10^10 個受限權重上零違規;同學習率的 LoRA 則會發散。寫入的知識確實可用:藥物與成分能以模型自身的兩跳上限組合;對 PopQA 長尾,fill 以每題 75 tokens 回答 82–90% 釋出模型答不了的問題,且不受區塊索引影響。多位寫入者可共用一次釋出,順序更新的可寫空間以 β≈0.82 幾何衰減,遺忘被測量而非消除。限制包括:僅示範事實而非技能、種子數少、NF4 以外的網格多為論證而非實測、Fisher 預算並非可用的數值憑證。此方法將模型更新從整份替換變成可稽核、可回滾的增量,對認證成本高於算力成本的部署場景極具價值。
papers.title: In-Cell Learning: Deployed Language Models Can Learn New Knowledge Without Changing a Single Stored Bit
papers.title_zh: 細胞內學習(In-Cell Learning):已部署語言模型無須改動任何儲存位元即可學習新知識

links.title: The Communication Map of a Transformer

evidence: Abstract: map covers 6.3x10^8 candidate channels in GPT-2 to 1.3x10^11 in Pythia-6.9B; 70-89% of head pairs oriented far from chance, with both strong coupling and active avoidance; full map costs 15 s for GPT-2 and 11 min for Pythia-6.9B on one consumer GPU.

Section 3: coupling coefficient C=||RW||_F/(||R||_F||W||_F) generalizes Elhage et al. (2021) composition scores to all 18 connection classes; Prop. 5 (Appendix A.4) gives exact chance level E[C^2]=1/d.

Section 4 / Table 10: freezing the 30-head induction community destroys 93.8% of GPT-2's induction gain vs 2.5% random-control median; five behavioral induction heads alone account for only 60.8%; replication in Table 9 reaches 97.1% vs 1.0% control at Pythia-2.8B.

Section 5 / Table 3: RW-PCA 2D subspace deletion destroys 82-96% of induction gain across six models; Pythia-6.9B: 89.5% (ours) vs 84.5% (activation PCA) vs 36.5% (outlier dims); Pythia-160m: 95.8% vs 42.0%/35.4%; principal cosines show the directions are distinct from baselines.

Section 6 limitations: map shows potential connectivity from weights only, not input-dependent routing; validated against a single capability (in-context copying); experiments limited to sub-10B-parameter models; nodes are heads/neurons, not learned features.
Appendix C.2/D.3: GPT-Neo excluded from deletion because random 2D deletions already destroy 60-98% of its induction gain; Pythia-6.9B absent from Table 9 due to ~55 GB RAM vs 45 GB available.

Reproducibility statement: full pipeline released at github.com/richardzhewang/communication-map with fixed seeds, public TransformerLens checkpoints, fixed Pile samples, single NVIDIA RTX 5090; all numbers regenerate from released code and map tables.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Mechanistic interpretability of transformer language models, squarely in scope (not a listed out-of-scope area). It directly matches high-weight preferences: LLMs (weight 2.5; GPT-2/Neo/Pythia language models), Interpretability & Explainability (weight 1.8; circuits, attention heads, residual stream), Transformer Architecture (weight 1.2; W_QK/W_OV, attention), plus moderate matches to Prompting/ICL (in-context copying/induction gain) and Scaling. Novelty is high: first claimed whole-transformer communication map over all 18 connection classes including neurons (Section 1, 3), a generalized coupling coefficient with closed-form rotation-null moments, and a new RW-PCA method yielding an induction-critical 2D subspace distinct from activation-PCA and outlier-dimension baselines (Section 5, Table 3). Rigor is strong: proofs (Appendix A.3-A.4), Monte Carlo verification of closed-form nulls, FDR control with stratum-fitted empirical nulls (Section 4, C.1), matched random ablation controls, replication across six models (Table 9), and honest caveats (GPT-Neo excluded because random deletions destroy 60-98%, Appendix D.3; Pythia-6.9B ablation absent due to RAM, C.2). Evidence is quantitative and controlled (93.8% induction-gain destruction vs 2.5% control median, GPT-2, Table 10; 89.5% vs 84.5%/36.5% baselines at 6.9B, Table 3), though validated on a single capability and limited to sub-10B models (Section 6 limitations). Reproducibility is excellent: released code/maps with fixed seeds, public checkpoints, documented compute (Reproducibility statement).

primary_link.title: The Communication Map of a Transformer

papers.summary: The components of a transformer communicate by writing to and reading from a shared residual stream, and mechanistic interpretability has mapped these connections by hand, one circuit at a time. We present the communication map, which charts every potential communication channel in a language model from weights alone, generalizing the composition score of Elhage et al. (2021) into a single coupling coefficient covering all 18 connection classes, from entire attention head circuits to single neur
papers.summary_zh: Transformer 的各元件（attention heads 與 MLP 神經元）共用殘差流（residual stream）交換資訊，但過去機制可解釋性研究多為逐一手工追蹤單一電路，缺乏整個模型層級的通訊全景。本文提出「通訊地圖」，僅從權重即可描繪所有潛在通訊通道：作者將 Elhage 等人的 composition score 推廣為通用的耦合係數，覆蓋 18 類連線（head 間 K/Q/V-composition、head 與神經元、介面矩陣等），並以 Haar 旋轉的理論虛無分配、分層經驗虛無分配與 FDR 控制判定顯著連線。透過跡的循環性質與內 Gram 矩陣分解，繪製 GPT-2 全圖僅需 15 秒，Pythia-6.9B 的 1.3×10¹¹ 條候選通道也只要 11 分鐘（單張消費級 GPU）。普查發現 70–89% 的 head 對顯著偏離隨機水準，不是超耦合就是主動迴避；神經元之間也存在遠超機率的直接連線。應用一：最強的 head 間耦合在不依賴行為線索下重現 induction 電路，並形成縱貫多層的社群，消融含五個 induction heads 的社群摧毀 GPT-2 93.8% 的 in-context 複製能力（Pythia-2.8B 達 97.1%）。應用二：reader–writer PCA（RW-PCA）從權重幾何找出二維 induction 關鍵子空間，刪除它在六個模型上摧毀 82–96% 的 induction 能力，效果優於 activation PCA 與 outlier dimensions 基線，且選出的方向與二者不同。限制方面：地圖僅反映權重的潛在連通性，無法呈現依輸入而變的實際訊號路由；驗證聚焦單一能力（in-context copying）；實驗限於百億參數以下模型；節點為 heads 與神經元而非稀疏自編碼器學得的特徵。整體而言，此工作首次建立全模型通訊地圖，並釋出地圖、統計工具與介入套件，為電路發現、子空間介入與可解釋性研究提供高效且可重現的基礎。

links.title: Level-k Distinguishable Mechanisms for Evaluating Bounded Rationality in LLMs

evidence: Abstract: models 'maintain accurate strategic depth under recursive reasoning' and 'errors arise from using the wrong number of iterated depth of reasoning steps, not from computing best responses incorrectly'.

Definition 1 (Methodology): formalizes level-K distinguishability as injectivity of k -> a(k) on {0,...,Kmax}; motivating counterexample shows depth-0 and depth-2 proposals coincide in the negotiation game of Zhang et al. (2025).

Table 2 (Experiment and Results): recursive-condition accuracy 83.5-92.5% for three models but Sonnet 4.6 49.0 (99.0 within-one) in 11-20 Mod.; inductive accuracy collapses to 0.5-2.5% in Nash Demand, showing uneven degradation.
Appendix A.4: 'Ring 11-20 separates them' - extrapolating the constant -3 step diverges from the IDR sequence at k=4, giving an extrapolation check the three arithmetic games lack.
Appendix A.3: exclusion of Ring 11-20 k_target=10 trials is quantified - retaining ambiguous 20 submissions would raise pooled accuracy from 31.9% (n=12,467) to 32.9% (n=12,787).
Appendix B.3 Table 7: models called via OpenRouter slugs, temperature 0.2, max_tokens 8192, 4 games x 10 levels x conditions x 20 reps = 3200 trials per model; no-action trials scored as incorrect.
Appendix D.4: Wilson intervals plus cluster bootstrap with B=2000; clustered intervals are a median 4.1x wider per model and 7.6x pooled.
Conclusions: limitations - 'we only tested up to a depth of 10' and 'a single LLM judge (Claude Opus 4.8) to read and score every chain of thought'.
Appendix D.1: judge is same family as one evaluated model; extraction-only design with mandatory verbatim quotes mitigates but 'does not eliminate that possibility'.
Appendix B.2: confound acknowledged - wording change between k_target=4 and 5 means 'the design as run cannot separate the effect of the wording from the effect of the depth'.
llm_evaluation.rationale: A core LLM-methodology paper: evaluates four LLMs' strategic reasoning depth via level-k game instruments, with chain-of-thought consistency analysis and a tool-calling inductive condition, matching multiple high-weight preferences (LLMs, reasoning/CoT, agents/tool use, evaluation, theory of mind). Novelty is substantive: the level-k distinguishability condition (Definition 1) directly addresses an identifiability gap in prior LLM game benchmarks, and the novel Ring 11-20 game plus non-monotone IDR sequence separates iteration from extrapolation (Appendix A.4). Rigor is high: closed-form best-response maps, a pigeonhole bound on Kmax (Lemma 1), blinded extraction-only judge with quote grounding, Wilson and cluster-bootstrap intervals (Appendix D.4), and an honest confound disclosure that wording change and depth boundary are inseparable at k=4/5. Evidence is quantitatively supported (Table 2 per-game accuracies, Figure 4 chain-length analysis, Table 3 mentalizing splits), though the mentalizing-accuracy link is correlational and the judge shares a model family with one evaluated model (acknowledged in D.1). Generalizability is limited to depth 10, four games, four models, and a single judge, as the Conclusions state. Reproducibility is strong: verbatim prompts (B.2), model slugs and decoding (Table 7), sampling formula for histories (C.1), released logs/code including lambda_sweep.csv, and provider-pinning guidance.

primary_link.title: Level-k Distinguishable Mechanisms for Evaluating Bounded Rationality in LLMs

papers.summary: Strategic depth of reasoning is essential for human interaction of Large Language Models (LLMs) operating in boundedly rational environments. However, existing evaluations are primarily based on canonical games prevalent in pretraining corpora, making it difficult to disentangle true strategic reasoning from memorisation. To address this, we formalise a necessary level-K distinguishability condition for strategic depth inference and construct a suite of novel game structures that meet this stand
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文針對現有LLM策略推理評估的效度缺口提出解方。過去研究多以預訓練語料中常見的經典賽局測試策略深度，難以區分真實推理與背誦，且缺乏不同推理深度對應到不同行動的保證，無法從行為辨識真實推理層級。作者形式化level-k可區分性條件，要求疊代最佳反應序列一一對應到不同行動，並建構新穎的五人環狀賽局Ring 11–20，同時改寫11–20金錢請求、All-Pay Auction與Nash Demand三個經典賽局。實驗涵蓋Gemma 4 31B、Qwen 3.6 27B、Claude Sonnet 4.6與DeepSeek v4 Pro四個模型，對手涵蓋L0至L9，並比較遞迴條件化（以語言描述對手層級）與歸納條件化（僅提供30筆對手歷史行動）。遞迴條件下各模型準確率高，思考鏈陳述的信念與實際行動內部一致；錯誤主要源自疊代步數算錯而非最佳反應計算錯誤，如Sonnet 4.6在深度4後固定少一層，Gemma 4在深度9、10失能。歸納條件下準確率劇烈且不均地下滑，於Nash Demand幾近歸零；思考鏈含明確策略性心智化的試次表現明顯較佳。限制包括僅測至深度10、依賴單一LLM評審Claude Opus 4.8，且對手描述措辭在深度4與5間改變，難以分離兩者效果。此研究對AI安全（低層級代理可能遭剝削）與以LLM模擬人類策略行為的基準設計深具意義。

evidence: Section 4 / Table 2 (r=0.1, n=1,000, three seeds): Qwen3.5-9B GSM8K falls 0.845→0.706 (keyboard) and 0.569 (typoswap) while filler leaves 0.840, establishing the corruption-vs-length asymmetry.

Section 5.3 / Table 5 (GSM8K, n=100/cell, paired cluster bootstrap B=2000): clean attention over corrupted content is significantly harmful in three of four models; joint restoration recovers 45-71% of the gap with significantly positive interaction in every model.

Section 5.4 / Table 6 (n=237, model fixed effects, SEs clustered by prompt): numeric-token hit is the only significant flip predictor (OR 12.89, 95% CI [5.06, 32.85]); corrupted fraction and diversion are non-significant.

Section 5.2 / Table 4 (n=500): length-matched padding control (Group C, 62 tokens, acc 0.662) vs keyboard (Group B, 62 tokens, frag 0.080, acc 0.642); the typoswap row (equal fragmentation, higher accuracy 0.682) is explicitly acknowledged as not following and rerouted to the n=4,160 regression (Appendix H).

Section 6.1 / Table 9: deployable tokenizer-level defense detects corruption (F1 0.77-0.81; fragmentation alone 0.70-0.75) but accuracy recovery is positive in 0 of 8 model-task cells; oracle clean-token restoration fully recovers, localizing damage to input representation.

Appendix K: factorial intervention protocol with difflib position map, -log K mass-preservation correction, and five validation checks (identity bit-identical, causality, mass moves 0.121→0.089 vs clean 0.079); 99.3% of positions get a genuine clean counterpart.
Limitations: factorial intervention run only on GSM8K at a single severity (BoolQ gap too narrow); perturbations synthetic; single-turn standard-length tasks; coupling claim rests on one task.
Appendix D: Llama-3.3-70B GSM8K drops 13 points under typoswap; Chinese CMath keyboard drop of 30 points with harmless filler, indicating cross-script, cross-scale generalization with attenuation.

Appendix A / Tables 11-12 (n=100, r=0.1): GPT-5.4 Thinking keyboard degradation -0.147 vs -0.093 Standard; frontier evidence is prediction-level only and single-severity, weakening strength of that claim.
llm_evaluation.rationale: Core-scope LLM research: empirical robustness and mechanistic analysis of reasoning in open-weight LLMs (Llama-3.1, Mistral, Qwen3.5, Gemma-2, plus GPT-4o/GPT-5.4) on GSM8K/BoolQ/PIQA/HellaSwag, with direct hits on LLM, Reasoning/CoT, and Interpretability preferences and secondary alignment with AI Safety/robustness and Prompting. Novelty is solid but not maximal: typo-brittleness of neural NLP is established (Belinkov & Bisk; Pruthi et al. cited in §7); the genuinely new elements are the fragmentation-vs-length controls (Table 4), the factorial attention/content intervention showing the two channels are coupled and super-additive (Table 5), and the evidence-irreplaceability account of task resilience (Table 6-7). Rigor is high: length-matched padding controls, per-example logistic regression with clustered SEs (Appendix H), bootstrap CIs and five validation checks for the patching intervention (Appendix K), and self-scrutinizing controls (OCR fragments most yet is harmless, Table 8; the anomalous typoswap cell is acknowledged). Main weaknesses: factorial coupling rests on one task at one severity (admitted in Limitations), several interventions use n=100, the Qwen factorial cell is ill-conditioned, and frontier-model claims (e.g., thinking mode amplifying degradation) rest on n=100 single-severity API runs. Code/data link and detailed appendices support reproducibility.

We evaluate four open-weight instruction-tuned models and frontier models across four reasoning benchmarks under keyboard noise, character swaps, and filler insertion. Character-level perturbations substantially degrade accuracy, especially on multi-step reasoning tasks, while filler insertion has little effect. We trace this asymmetry to Attention Di
papers.summary_zh: 這篇論文探討大型語言模型（LLM）在詞彙層面受擾動時的推理穩健性。作者系統性評估四個開源權重指令微調模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B、Qwen3.5-9B、Gemma-2-9B）與 GPT-4o、GPT-5.4 等前沿模型，在 BoolQ、PIQA、HellaSwag、GSM8K 四項基準上施以鍵盤雜訊、相鄰字元對調與填充詞插入三種擾動。結果顯示字元級擾動大幅降低準確率，多步數學推理受創最重，填充詞幾乎無害；連 GPT-5.4 的內建推理模式也放大而非吸收損害。機制分析提出「注意力轉移」：字元破壞使 subword 斷詞碎裂，碎片在推論時吸引不成比例的注意力質量，集中於中後層；等長對照與迴歸分析證實碎裂而非提示長度才是元凶。因子式介入實驗進一步顯示注意力與詞元內容相互耦合：僅修復任一通道無效，乾淨注意力配上受損內容甚至有害，兩者同時修復才能挽回約 45–71% 的差距。這解釋了拼字檢查、self-repair、Chain-of-Thought 等推論期策略為何無法穩定復原效能，且數字詞元是 GSM8K 失敗的主因。tokenizer 層級的防禦雖能可靠偵測碎裂（F1 約 0.77–0.81），卻無法逆轉損害。研究侷限於英文與 QWERTY 輸入、合成擾動、單輪短任務，耦合實驗亦僅涵蓋 GSM8K。此發現顯示穩健性必須在斷詞發生前內建於表示層，例如字元感知的備援表示、動態重新斷詞與訓練期對齊，深具實務啟示。

links.title: $R^3$-Bench: LLMs Struggle with Resource-Rational Reasoning under Shared Budgets

evidence: Abstract and Section 4.1: across 72 model–setting–pressure–domain cells in Table 2 the oracle matches or exceeds contest in all cells and is strictly higher in 71; consistent with the single 0.00% gap (Claude-Opus-4.8 agentic Math ρ=0.2, 4.46 vs 4.46).

Section 3.4 and Appendix E: response-curve oracle formulated as a multiple-choice knapsack over budget levels with K=5 repeats per grid point and exact enumeration of 6^6 assignments; paper explicitly frames the gap as offline empirical headroom, not an executable policy.
Appendix B: manual audit of 300 Stage-2 finalizer calls across 30 model–pressure–domain cells; 'No audited call re-solved a problem', mitigating the uncharged-finalization confound.

Section 4.4 and Appendix H Table 12: ECI composite over fifty benchmarks does not predict Gap Ratio (mean Spearman −0.29, p=0.37; pooled R^2=0.01, p=0.70), ruling out a general-capability explanation.
Appendix O Table 18: target-in-suite diagnostic over 720 stress episodes; nine of twelve cells show ≤5pp loss and mean difference 1.1pp, arguing against a suite-context explanation of the gap.

Section 5 and Table 3: lightweight online schedulers (coverage guard, verification gate) beat the contest reference in six of nine model–domain cells but no policy dominates; Code improves for all three models while Math/AR are mixed.
Appendix K: 18,000 trajectories annotated exhaustively by ten annotators, one annotation per trajectory with quotation-backed rubrics, but no inter-annotator agreement statistics are reported.

Appendix G Table 8 and Appendix I Table 13: per-model token/action caps and full sampling configurations (temperature, top-p, reasoning effort, 5 runs) are disclosed; HuggingFace dataset links appear in the author block and 'exact prompts and scripts are released with the benchmark artifact' (Appendix D).
llm_evaluation.rationale: Highly on-topic LLM reasoning/agent evaluation work: introduces R3-Bench, a shared-budget six-problem contest benchmark over math, competitive programming, and abstract reasoning in tool-free and agentic settings, evaluated on eight frontier LLMs. The core contribution—measuring the gap between a model's demonstrated single-problem competence (via matched response curves and a multiple-choice knapsack oracle) and its realized suite performance under one shared budget—is a genuinely new evaluation angle distinct from per-task budget-aware methods (TALE, SelfBudgeter) and prior shared-budget works (USACOArena, CLEAR), as argued in the Section 2 comparison table. Rigor is strong: per-model budget calibration (Section 3.1, Appendix G), 5 repeats, a two-stage protocol for thinking models with a 300-call manual audit confirming Stage 2 never re-solves problems (Appendix B), detailed action accounting (Appendix F), and two confound checks—target-in-suite context stress (Appendix O, mean 1.1pp) and ECI discriminant validity with permutation tests (Appendix H Table 12, mean Spearman −0.29, p=0.37). Headline numbers are internally consistent (72 cells, oracle strictly higher in 71, matching the single 0.00% tie for Claude-Opus-4.8 agentic Math in Table 2). Deductions: no confidence intervals or significance tests on the main contest–oracle gaps, no inter-annotator agreement reported despite 18,000 single-annotated trajectories (Appendix K), the oracle is an offline diagnostic rather than an achievable policy (acknowledged in Appendix E), the scheduler study covers only three models at one pressure with no dominating policy (Section 5, Table 3), and difficulty is stratified by reference-model output length rather than accuracy, which may not generalize. Reproducibility is aided by released prompts, scripts, and a HuggingFace dataset plus exhaustive appendices, but relies on proprietary APIs and a model-based math judge (DeepSeek V4 Flash, Appendix D.4).

primary_link.title: $R^3$-Bench: LLMs Struggle with Resource-Rational Reasoning under Shared Budgets

papers.summary: In cognitive science, resource rationality asks how an agent should allocate limited computation to maximize expected value. Most reasoning and agent benchmarks use independent per-task budgets; existing shared-budget studies do not calibrate suite performance against the same model's demonstrated single-problem competence. We introduce $R^3$-Bench, which evaluates six-problem suites under shared budgets across mathematics, competitive programming, and abstract reasoning in tool-free and agentic
papers.summary_zh: 本文提出 R³-Bench，一個評估大型語言模型（LLM）在共享預算下資源理性推理的基準。既有推理與代理基準皆以每題獨立預算評估，跨題目的資源分配與機會成本從未被檢驗。R³-Bench 於數學奧林匹亞、競技程式設計與抽象推理三領域各構建 50 場六題競賽（三易、二中、一難），在無工具（輸出 token 預算）與代理式（計數動作預算）兩種設定下，以模型自身無預算用量校準的強（ρ=0.2）與中（ρ=0.8）壓力進行評估。作者另以配對的單題反應曲線建立平均分配重播與反應曲線 oracle（形式化為多重選擇背包問題）作為離線經驗參考。主要結果：在六款旗艦模型的 72 個模型—設定—壓力—領域組合中，oracle 得分皆不低於競賽得分，其中 71 個嚴格更高；強壓力下失敗主因是預算花在其他題目，中等壓力下則常在部分進展後即停止；賽中策略更新與資源理性調整稀少，且此差距無法由逾五十項基準組成的一般能力指數解釋。輕量線上排程器於九個組合中改善六個，但無任何策略跨領域一致有效。限制包括 oracle 僅為離線診斷而非可執行策略、重播受有限樣本影響，排程實驗亦僅涵蓋三款模型；另經「目標題置於題組」診斷，情境干擾並非主因。本基準凸顯單題能力不等於跨題分配能力，對訓練內建資源分配政策具指標意義。
